programme.title: The Kentuckian
programme.desc: Eli Wakefield (Burt Lancaster) and his son are Kentucky adventurers longing for life on the Texas frontier. They learn, however, that their greatest challenge lies not in the uncharted wilderness, but in the people they meet along the way.

programme.title: John Sturges' The Hallelujah Trail
programme.desc: Chaos reigns on the wide open plains as Burt Lancaster and Lee Remick let loose in this comedy that spoofs nearly every convention of movie westerns.

programme.title: The Unforgiven
programme.desc: John Huston directs Audrey Hepburn in this thrilling, romantic western about a woman who becomes the target of lawless racism and brutality when it is discovered that she was born to the Kiowa tribe but secretly adopted by a white frontier family.

programme.title: The Scalphunters
programme.desc: Sydney Pollack directs Burt Lancaster, Shelley Winters, Ossie Davis and Telly Savalas in this lively and ribald western about a frontier-wise fur trapper who loses his pelts to a band of Kiowas in exchange for a slave he doesn't want.

programme.title: Vera Cruz
programme.desc: In this epic Western, two shady mercenaries (Gary Cooper, Burt Lancaster) in Mexico during the 1866 revolution are hired to escort a Countess and her gold to the Mexican army in Vera Cruz and find themselves at odds with the army... and each other!

programme.title: Lawman
programme.desc: In Michael Winner's unique take on the western, a sheriff (Burt Lancaster) is determined to bring to justice a rancher (Lee J. Cobb) and his hands who accidentally killed an old man during a drunken spree. Robert Ryan and Robert Duvall co-star.

programme.title: Valdez Is Coming
programme.desc: In this rousing Western, when a greedy rancher causes the death of an innocent man, former sheriff Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) orders him to provide financial support for the widow. But when he refuses, Valdez vows to exact justice at any cost!

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster, Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane star in this offbeat western about two aspiring outlaws who join what's left of the Doolin-Dalton gang.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: Zane Grey Western of outlaw gangs fighting for control of ranchland.

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Rod Cameron plays a Western explorer with a unique scheme--to open a new desert route by using camels as pack animals. His trek is imperiled by a phony law-avoiding doctor (John Ireland) and his woman (Joanne Dru), a search for water and attacking Indians.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five Civil War outlaws must brave hostile Comanche territory - and a cunning woman - to hijack a stagecoach carrying a traitor...and $30,000 in gold!

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: A fast-shooting gunman and an insurance agent track down the murdering robbers of a train hijacking and the stolen money.

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programme.title: Man Of The East
programme.desc: East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

programme.title: Death Rides A Horse
programme.desc: Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

programme.title: Navajo Joe
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds, Aldo Sambrell and Fernando Rey star in this lusty, gutsy action western about a fearless Indian with a relentless vendetta against the band of outlaws that killed his people. Directed by Spaghetti Western legend Sergio Corbucci.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

programme.title: A Fistful Of Dynamite
programme.desc: The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

programme.title: The Hunting Party (1971)
programme.desc: To cattle baron Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman), his stunning wife (Candice Bergen) is just one of his possessions. So when a notorious bandit kidnaps her, an enraged Ruger organizes a posse to recover his property dead or alive in the searing western!

programme.title: Wild Bill
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges stars as Wild Bill Hickok, the hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who lived on the edge. Hickok's amazing story is told with a stunning visual style, illuminating one of the most exciting heroes of the American West.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) thinks he's been hired to kill wild dogs in Australia. But a wealthy cattle baron (Alan Rickman) has far more nefarious plans for the sharpshooter. Laura San Giacomo also stars in this stylish western.

programme.title: The Wonderful Country
programme.desc: In this action-packed western, ex-pat Martin Brady (Robert Mitchum) travels to Texas to broker an arms deal for Mexican Governor Castro (Pedro Armendariz). But things get complicated when the the guns he was returning to Mexico are stolen.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: In this gun-slinging adventure, an aging lawman (Robert Mitchum) teams up with Young Billy Young (Robert Walker), a fast-draw outlaw on the run. But it's an alliance that explodes when the lawman discovers a secret that could rip two towns apart!

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: In this hilarious western spoof, insurance broker Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) unwittingly sells a life insurance policy worth $100,000 to the infamous Jesse James. Now, he has to figure out how to keep the deadliest outlaw in history alive!

programme.title: The King And Four Queens
programme.desc: Clark Gable is a smooth as ever in this unique blend of action, comedy and western intrigue as he romances the stunning Eleanor Parker -- and three other women -- in the hopes that one of them knows the location of a hidden cache of stolen gold.

programme.title: ¡Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that's a fiesta of fun.

programme.title: The Honkers
programme.desc: James Coburn portrays an aging, philandering rodeo cowboy who returns to his hometown. He must do battle not only in the rodeo arena, but with his desire for personal independence and his contradictory desire to win the respect of his wife and son.

programme.title: Comes A Horseman
programme.desc: Set in the American West of the 1940s, a pair of little-guy ranchers join forces against the depredations of a ruthless land baron determined to expand his empire at whatever cost. Starring Jane Fonda, James Caan, and Jason Robards.

programme.title: This Horse Has Horsepower
programme.desc: It's time to triple the horsepower in our 1990 Mustang! Project Fast Lane Fox Body is getting a new heart, as Tommy and Peyton make final adjustments to their pony car's new Windsor motor. Plus we'll show you how to install a new fuel injector pump with a pro from Edelbrock.

programme.title: 427ci LSx Part 1
programme.desc: We kick off a brand new, ground up build for a Music City Trucks project, featuring a scratch built 427ci pump gas LSx. With awesome hot rod power and durability in mind, we start with a new Summit Racing Pro LS block and prep this beast for serious short-bed C10 service.

programme.title: Transforming a Honda Civic Hatchback Into The Ultimate Rally Car Part 1
programme.desc: We find a parked Honda Civic and try to get it back on the road. Then take it to the shop and start planning what to build.

programme.title: JL Rubicon: Strength
programme.desc: Our Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon gets a stronger axle, and a custom built bumper. Plus, how you can build your own rack for trail tools.

programme.title: 2011 Diesel Denali Gets Lowered

When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy.

programme.title: Santa's New Gig

programme.title: Elves vs. Reindeer

programme.title: Surprise Holiday Parade

programme.title: Santa to the Rescue!
programme.desc: Five teams of cake and sugar artists must imagine what happens outside the North Pole and make a creation symbolizing Santa Claus as a world hero.

programme.title: The Great Turkey Escape
programme.desc: Five teams of master cake and sugar artists create what happens when all the Thanksgiving turkeys decide to make a break for it.

programme.title: When Toys Come Alive

programme.title: Critter Christmas
programme.desc: The four remaining teams of cake and sugar artists must create the most bizarre visions of a Christmas party in the animal kingdom.

programme.title: North Pole Wedding

Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.desc: A sharp look at the cutting-edge tool that changed history, including a bank of six circular saws spinning at 1,750 RPM to a diamond-coated belt saw that can slice through limestone like butter.

programme.desc: An underground subway system transforms the bustling metropolis of Athens, Greece, alleviating chronic traffic problems, meeting the needs of the 2004 Olympics and uncovering thousands of invaluable artifacts.

programme.desc: The U.S. Navy's most lethal fighter, the F-14, soars at supersonic speeds.

programme.title: Construction Machines
programme.desc: Earthmoving equipment story spans simple spades to powerful steam shovels; meet legendary giants John Deere, Jerome Case, and Caterpillar founders who forged America's construction industry, plus specialized trucks and space equipment.

programme.desc: Wartime research and development have revolutionized communication, transportation, and medicine; from Spam to nuclear power to hairspray and cell phones, life as we know it ironically owes a lot to war.

programme.title: Pocket Tools
programme.desc: Episode takes a look at the items found in peoples' pockets all across America; not cell phones, which everybody has, but more intimate items, personal things, both valuable and cheap.

programme.title: The Exterminator
programme.desc: Termites, mosquitos, rats, mice, ants and cockroaches have spread damage, disease and death for millions of years.

programme.title: A Holiday in Harlem
programme.desc: Fortune 500 business executive Jazmin Carter is known for two things: turning fledgling businesses into profit producers at record-breaking speeds and avoiding Christmas in Harlem, the neighborhood where she grew up. However, one spur of the moment trip to her sprite and vivacious grandmother Mama Belle's yoga class changes everything.

programme.title: A Nutcracker Christmas
programme.desc: A rising ballet star is ready to take the stage in her dream role when she receives the shocking news that her sister has died. Years later, she has vowed never to dance again, but a chance encounter with an old flame may change her mind.

programme.title: It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas
programme.desc: Rival mayors Gavin and Stella compete to make their neighboring New Hampshire towns the most festive in a Christmas decorating contest. As their rivalry heats up, they discover the true meaning of Christmas and fall in love.

programme.title: Looks Like Christmas
programme.desc: When two type-A single parents battle it out for control of the Christmas holiday at their kid's middle school, they get more than they bargained for when they learn a little something about the true meaning of Christmas, while opening themselves up for the possibility of a new romance. Stars Anne Heche and Dylan Neal.

programme.title: A Christmas Duet
programme.desc: Well-loved music duo AVERIE DAVIS and JESSE COLLINS, famous for their duet "Wouldn't Be Christmas," haven't played together since they went their separate ways years ago. Averie gave up music and opened a beautiful lodge in a snowy...

programme.title: The Wishing Tree
programme.desc: With guidance from a widowed professor (Jason Gedrick), a troubled teen (Richard Harmon) becomes a volunteer during the holidays.

programme.title: Christmas Everlasting
programme.desc: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays employed at New York's top corporate law firm are about to pay off now that Lucy Toomey will be made partner after the New Year. However, when her older sister with special needs, Alice, unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning back to Nilson's Bay, Wisconsin to handle her sister's estate.

programme.title: A Heavenly Christmas
programme.desc: From Hallmark Hall of Fame. Eve Morgan, a workaholic finds herself tethered to her guardian angel, Pearl, as she learns to become a Christmas angel in Heaven. Despite being the worst recruit in the history of Christmas, Eve is assigned...

programme.title: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Host Tamera Mowry-Housley greets ten family pairs of bakers at the holiday baking barn, where they first must prove themselves with pie, and then heat things up with some exquisite yule logs.

programme.title: My Christmas Love
programme.desc: A hopeless romantic receives anonymous gifts inspired by the "12 Days of Christmas" and sets out to uncover her mystery admirer, wondering if he could be the man of her dreams.

programme.title: A Rose for Christmas
programme.desc: Andy is a passionate artist whose family has been building Rose Parade floats for generations. When her Dad gets sick, Andy is forced to take the helm and supervise the construction and decoration of their client's float. And to make...

programme.desc: The annual Chicago Thanksgiving Day parade has to cut costs or it's going to be cancelled this year. When the city brings in consultant Henry Baldwin to analyze the books, he goes to toe to toe with parade manager Emily Rogers who thinks Henry only..

programme.title: A Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Emma, an aspiring writer, teams up with photographer Marcus to find a real-life Christmas miracle for a magazine cover story. As they investigate a mysterious street performer, they discover unexpected love and holiday magic.

programme.title: A Dog Named Christmas
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Noel Fisher) embarks on a mission to find homes for dogs during the holidays.

programme.title: Christmas at Cartwright's
programme.desc: Nicky is a single mom, unemployed and broke at Christmas and desperate to find a job in order to make her young daughter's holiday a happy one. With the aide of an angel, she gets a job as a department store Santa and also happens to...

programme.title: Christmas at the Palace
programme.desc: When former figure skater turned choreographer Katie agrees to help put on a skating pageant for the Christmas obsessed kingdom of San Senova, her contagious holiday joy brings Christmas spirit to the royal family while she rediscovers herlove of skating - and falls for the king.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season for Love
programme.desc: An out-of-work actress returns to her quaint hometown where a Christmas romance proves the life she once left behind could turn out to be even better than Broadway. Stars Sarah Lancaster, Brendan Penny and Gwynyth Walsh.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge
programme.desc: The sweeping tale of Molly Callens and Ryan Kelly, two young students who share a profound friendship their first semester in college. At their favorite bookstore and coffee shop, The Bridge, they spend countless hours studying and inspiring the other to dream their 10-year goal. They bond with the owners of The Bridge, Charlie (McGinley) and Donna Barton (Ford), a couple who designed the bookstore as a place where people can connect and be part of an extended family.

programme.title: A Song for Christmas
programme.desc: Popstar Adelaide Kay gets stranded in Virginia after sneaking off her tour bus and is welcomed by the Lapp family, who share their Christmas traditions and help her rediscover the magic of the holidays.

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: Three days before Christmas, a woman who has never known her father receives a clue concerning his whereabouts. She follows the trail to a beautiful New England town where she meets a handsome young man willing to help with the search.

programme.title: Love at the Thanksgiving Day Parade
programme.desc: The annual Chicago Thanksgiving Day parade has to cut costs or it's going to be cancelled this year. When the city brings in consultant Henry Baldwin to analyze the books, he goes to toe to toe with parade manager Emily Rogers who thinks Henry only..

programme.title: The Hunt for Mr. Christmas
programme.desc: Ten unknown talents compete for the role of a lifetimeÄîa leading role in a Hallmark Christmas movie. Host Jonathan Bennett invites Erin Cahill to be their first scene partner.With Jonathan Bennett, Melissa Peterman, & Erin Cahill.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season
programme.desc: When Kate's best friends sign her up for a holiday-themed dating service, she reluctantly joins, but has no idea just how much her life is about to change. Stars Mae Whitman, Julian Morris, Jane Seymour, and Mary McDonnell.

programme.title: A Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Emma, an aspiring writer, teams up with photographer Marcus to find a real-life Christmas miracle for a magazine cover story. As they investigate a mysterious street performer, they discover unexpected love and holiday magic.

programme.title: All Yours
programme.desc: Cass, a high-powered attorney and single mother of two, is on the hunt for a new nanny after her precocious kids ran off the last one. Meet Matthew, a world traveler who cannot settle down, until his father challenges him to plant roots.

programme.title: Journey
programme.desc: In this drama based on a novel by Patricia MacLachlan, 11-year-old Journey is heartbroken when his mother, Min, skips town, leaving him and his sister, Cat, alone. Then they are sent to live on the family farm with their grandmother Lottie and grandfather Marcus. It's a difficult transition, but over time Journey gets used to his new life, especially when Marcus helps him develop an interest in photography.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge Part 2
programme.desc: Based on Karen Kingsbury's bestselling novel, The Bridge, Molly and Ryan, college students from two different worlds, fell in love at Belmont University their freshman year. After unknowingly being manipulated to break up by Molly's controlling, media mogul father, they are reunited seven years later to save the bookstore that changed their lives. Stars Wyatt Nash, Katie Findlay, Faith Ford and Ted McGinley.

programme.title: Christmas at Graceland
programme.desc: Chicago mom Laurel takes her kids to Graceland for Christmas, where she reconnects with ex-flame Clay. Encouraged to audition for the Christmas concert, she rediscovers her passion for singing while helping Clay revive his songwriting dreams.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

programme.title: Memories of Christmas
programme.desc: After inheriting her mother's house, Noelle meets Dave, a Christmas decorator who helps her rediscover holiday joy. She embraces her mother's legacy, keeps the house and becomes Dave's business and life partner.

programme.title: The Beginning
programme.desc: Families reunite for the holidays, bringing romance, surprises and misunderstandings. From a rekindled high school crush to family mix-ups and a Christmas light feud, the neighborhood shares the chaos and joy of the season.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season
programme.desc: When Kate's best friends sign her up for a holiday-themed dating service, she reluctantly joins, but has no idea just how much her life is about to change. Stars Mae Whitman, Julian Morris, Jane Seymour, and Mary McDonnell.

programme.title: The Hunt for Mr. Christmas
programme.desc: Ten unknown talents compete for the role of a lifetimeÄîa leading role in a Hallmark Christmas movie. Host Jonathan Bennett invites Erin Cahill to be their first scene partner.With Jonathan Bennett, Melissa Peterman, & Erin Cahill.

programme.title: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Host Tamera Mowry-Housley greets ten family pairs of bakers at the holiday baking barn, where they first must prove themselves with pie, and then heat things up with some exquisite yule logs.

programme.title: Merry Cruise-mas!
programme.desc: The Hallmark Christmas Cruise begins with festive fun, star meet-and-greets and a magical tree lighting at sea, as passengers share big news, embrace new adventures and plan special surprises for loved ones.

programme.title: Christmas in Evergreen: Bells Are Ringing
programme.desc: As her wedding to Thomas approaches, Michelle hires Hannah to oversee the newly-built Evergreen museum, which includes a storytelling project interviewing the citizens of Evergreen (think StoryCorps). Hannah sees this as an opportunity...

programme.title: Cancel Christmas
programme.desc: Santa Claus discovers children have become too greedy and must prove otherwise if he doesn't want his favorite holiday canceled. His mission is to teach two incorrigible children the importance of charity. Enlisting their help to aid a handicapped boy inspires the magic of the holiday season, and the children's joy in giving ensures Christmas is going to be better than ever this year. Stars Judd Nelson and Natalie Brown.

programme.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered for Christmas
programme.desc: The magic of Christmas is in full swing as our Postables in the Dead Letter Office - Oliver, Shane, Rita and Norman - work together to help fulfil a young child's wish on Christmas Eve. And with the guidance from a unique postal supervisor,Oliver is given a very special letter to deliver, one that may be more difficult to accomplish than he realizes.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: To The Gates!
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: The Dead
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: The Wanderer
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Warrior's Fate
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Scarred
programme.desc: The victorious Wessex/Viking forces return to Wessex but there is rancour in the Viking camp - Floki is angry over the alliance with Ecbert and is resentful the influence that he feels Athelstan has over Ragnar. Princess Kwenthrith makes some calculating political moves following the battle at the Hill of the Ash in Mercia. Visitors from the past arrive in Hederby, at Kalf's invitation.

programme.title: The Usurper
programme.desc: The fleet returns to Kattegat to find tragic circumstances await. Lagertha learns that her Earldom has been usurped and convinces Ragnar to travel to Hederby with her in an effort to reclaim her title. Ragnar causes great surprise when he announces the next raid. The Seer has interesting prophecies for Rollo.

programme.title: Born Again
programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.desc: Preparations for the Paris raid pick up pace, and Rollo ponders the Seer's prophecy about his destiny. Ragnar is informed of Aethelwulf's massacre at the settlement in Wessex, and Kalf arrives in Kattegat with some new allies and some familiar faces. Porunn and Judith both deliver children; but with new life there is also death.

programme.title: Paris
programme.desc: The appearance of the Viking fleet causes panic among the population of Paris. The defense of Paris is in the hands of its Commander, Count Odo, who is confident that the city is prepared for the attack. The Emperor Charles, urged by his daughter Gisla, announces in Court he will remain in the city. The Vikings establish camp downriver from the city and plan their attack.

programme.title: To The Gates!
programme.desc: The Viking army embarks and Paris goes into lockdown as the army prepares the defense, overseen by Count Odo. The Vikings are determined to make it through the gates of Paris and conquer the city; they will stop at nothing to succeed.

programme.title: Breaking Point
programme.desc: The Vikings go all out for a second assault on Paris. Recognizing the desperate state of affairs for his city, Emperor Charles must make a difficult decision. In Wessex, Judith is compelled to make a difficult decision of her own.

programme.title: The Dead
programme.desc: Rollo's destiny is recognized and Bjorn steps up as a leader. With one last chance to take Paris, Ragnar and his Vikings troops take a daring chance.

programme.title: Mercenary
programme.desc: Ragnar and Lagertha's fleets depart Kattegat once more for Wessex and this time they bring a group to colonize there. King Ecbert hosts the Norsemen and proposes a deal. Despite the misgivings of some of the other leaders, Ragnar leads his forces into battle once more, but this time as allies of Wessex.

programme.title: The Wanderer
programme.desc: Lagertha and Athelstan help to establish the Viking settlement in Wessex. Harbard, a mysterious wanderer, arrives in Kattegat, realizing the forewarned dreams of Aslaug, Siggy and Helga.

programme.title: Warrior's Fate
programme.desc: King Ecbert visits the developing Viking settlement as the first harvest is sown and rebuffs criticism from his leading nobles. The Wessex/Viking forces charge into battle with Mercia. In Kattegat, Harbard arrives in to the Great Hall and his mysterious aura fascinates Aslaug and Helga but Siggy remains suspicious. There are strange and tragic happenings in Kattegat and Siggy suspects Harbard is the cause.

programme.title: Colours - Green
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Colours - Blue
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Christening
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Feeding Sheep in Winter
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Hanukah
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Washing Up
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Number 5
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Christmas Tree
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Making Christmas Cards
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Crackers
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Carol Singing
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Snowy Day
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.title: Level Crossing
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.

programme.title: Becky & Jed Find Eggs
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play a slide game before watching Becky and Jed look for eggs on their farm. Then their mum cooks them for their tea. In Teletubbyland, the Lion and Bear play their hide and seek game.

programme.title: Rocking Chair
programme.desc: Alex Pascall and some children sing to their dolls to rock them to sleep. Laa-Laa wants to sing a lovely song, but Tinky Winky is crunching his Tubby Toast too loudly!

programme.title: Colours - Pink
programme.desc: The Teletubbies march up and down a hill and then they watch some children explore the colour pink. Tinky Winky doesn't know how to make Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Living in Flats
programme.desc: Laa-Laa dances with her ball. A little boy tells us why he likes to live in his block of flats. A balloon appears in Teletubbyland. The Teletubbies follow a balloon.

programme.title: Urban Walk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies giggle as they play their 'Through the Arch' game. The windmill stops them to watch a little girl and her dad go for a walk in the town.

programme.title: Our Calf Treacle
programme.desc: The Teletubbies line up to say 'Eh-oh' and then watch Matthew and Mark feed a baby calf. The Teletubbies play a game to see who can eat their Tubby Custard the slowest, but Po can't wait and eats her Tubby Custard very fast.

programme.title: Naughty Pig
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the Naughty Pig. Dipsy's hat keeps blowing away and he has to chase it all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Washing the Car
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Handy Hands
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Playing Ball
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Irish Dancing
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Numbers 2
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Giraffes
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Amy's House
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Naughty Sock Returns
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Penguins
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Ned's Geraniums
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Crabs - Digging in the Sand
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Samira's Gymnastics
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Milking Cows
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Flamenco Dancing
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Café Eggs
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Drumming with Norris
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Making Fantastic Animals
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Feeding the Monkeys
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Naughty Hat
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Gingerbread Boy
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Rabbits
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Painting Easter Eggs
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Finding Chocolate Eggs
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Turban
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: My Dad's a Tram Driver
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Football
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Naughty Sausage
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Animals - Snails
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Number 3

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Return of Mr. Grimm
programme.desc: During an arrest, Cheyenne shoots and kills the lawless son of Nathanael Grimm, a wealthy man who controls the town. Cheyenne faces a murder charge, and the townspeople are out of work when Grimm closes his mine in revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Beholden
programme.desc: Cheyenne arrives in Winslow with a letter recommending him for the marshal's job. As he delivers it to the banker the next morning, Elijah McGuire and his men rob the bank, and Cheyenne finds himself caught in the middle.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Stand-In
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain Ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas refuses since they are taking a murderer named Rudy Croft to be hanged in Yuma. Later, Croft escapes and the guards take Lucas as their prisoner.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Journey Back
programme.desc: Mark takes a job on new neighbor Will Temple's ranch but is taken back by Temple's badly scarred face. When a cavalry officer stops by the McCain Ranch looking for a deserter who committed murder, both Mark and Lucas question who Temple really is.

programme.title: Maverick - The Troubled Heir
programme.desc: When Bart Maverick's friend, Pearly Gates, steals money in a poker game, an outlaw threatens to kill Pearly. To save his life, Bart is forced to concoct a fake inheritance scheme to get money and pay off the outlaw.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: When a gunslinger with a bad disposition is nursed back to health and desired by a Quaker girl, he finds himself having to choose between his lawless life or the peaceful world of his newfound love.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Stranger at Night
programme.desc: Coming home from school, Mark stumbles upon a dead man's body. Lucas discovers he was stabbed and the only clue is a belt with the initials R.M. Lucas leaves Mark with Artemus Quarles, a cousin who is visiting. Quarles, however, is not who he seems.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Raid
programme.desc: A renegade Apache named Chaqua raids the McCain Ranch and kidnaps Mark. Lucas gathers a group of men to get Mark back, but Chaqua plans to make him an Apache warrior since he lost his own son. Lucas will stop at nothing to get his son back to safety.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Border Showdown
programme.desc: Cheyenne and Smitty travel to Mexico to bring a gang of outlaws accused of killing Cheyenne's close friend to justice. However, after they arrive, they discover that the small Mexican town is under the rule of the gang's leader.

programme.title: Cheyenne - The Last Train West
programme.desc: Cheyenne is on the run from the law after being falsely accused of murder. He boards a west-bound train for California, but a reverend's daughter interrupts his plans when she threatens to turn him in.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Spiked Rifle
programme.desc: Lucas agrees to ride shotgun on a stagecoach carrying $20,000 in gold for North Fork banker John Hamilton after a man fails to show up. When three men rob the stage and take Mark hostage, Lucas must get both the gold and Mark back safely.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Smoke Screen
programme.desc: A beautiful headstrong young woman named Marge Crandell doesn't like to be told what to do by anyone. Several men vie for her attention and when Lucas finds her dead, one of the men becomes a prime suspect due to a simple clue, a half-smoked cigar.

programme.title: Maverick - Stage West
programme.desc: Bret Maverick meets Linda Harris, who has come West after her husband struck gold. However, a violent rancher and his sons have already murdered her husband. They take Bret and Linda hostage to find the mine's location. Maverick jumps into action.

programme.title: Maverick - Duel at Sundown
programme.desc: While traveling to a high-stakes poker game, Bret Maverick's friend asks him to visit his ranch. Bret finds himself caught up in his friend's desire to end his daughter's relationship with a gunslinger.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: During the early days of the Oklahoma oil boom, a greedy, self-assured oilman and a quiet, yet determined cowboy fight for the rights to oil on Indian land. All the while a pretty schoolteacher steals both men's hearts.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Big Ghost Basin
programme.desc: Cheyenne finds a dead man's body and strange signs from the mysterious killer on a trail to Crowheart. When he arrives in town with the body, the townspeople suspect him to be a member of the rustler gang that's responsible.

programme.title: Maverick - The Money Machine
programme.desc: Bart Maverick travels to Kansas City to collect money from his cousin, Jackie, to pay off a family debt. However, Jackie has been conned into buying a counterfeit money printing machine with it. Bart must find the swindlers and recoup the money.

programme.desc: On his way to Nevada, Adam rides up on some Indians wanting to harm a white woman they believe is a mountain spirit. They escape but Adam is wounded. The woman nurses him back to health but the tribe is on their trail.

programme.title: Bonanza - Silent Thunder
programme.desc: Angry at the way a young deaf woman is treated by her father, Little Joe decides to teach her sign language so they can communicate better. However, his plan backfires when she falls in love with him.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: A cattle baron awaits the return of his daughter from school and is surprised that his wife has returned to take their daughter away. He tries to keep the peace and do what is best for everyone.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Guest
programme.desc: A charming man named Mario Rosati arrives at the McCain Ranch and introduces himself as an acquaintance of an old family friend. Lucas and Mark offer him a place to stay for a few days, but they learn that he has an ulterior motive: to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Maverick - The Sheriff of Duck 'n' Shoot
programme.desc: Bret Maverick is blackmailed into becoming sheriff of the wild town of Duck 'n' Shoot. He deals with outlaws and somehow tames the town. However, after getting involved with a crooked woman, Bret ends up in his own jail, forcing Bart to bail him out.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: When a card shark receives a letter from a distant and troubled son, he travels to rescue the boy and his mother. During a train ride, the gambler meets a friendly, prideful young card player and shares his wisdom.

programme.desc: After a young woman loses her husband in a frontier land dispute, she opens her heart and home to aid a gravely injured gunslinger. Can she restore him to health, resist his affections and face down her conservative community?

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: When a frontier woman's husband is severely wounded from gunshots, she learns a vicious gang is hot on his trail and headed to their ranch. With her estranged past fiancé by her side, the two prepare for a violent showdown that consumes them.

programme.title: Maverick - High Card Hangs
programme.desc: Bart Maverick and his friend Dandy Jim Buckley arrive at a mining camp where a prospector is murdered. The newcomers are suspected of the crime since the prospector had won money off them. Bart must find the real killer.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Land Beyond the Law
programme.desc: Cheyenne is on the run from the law for a crime that he did not commit in Lone Butte. To clear his name, he must infiltrate the Ellwood Gang to find the killer. His only clues are the killer's hideout and unusual belt buckle.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Test of Courage
programme.desc: A frustrated Army post commander court-martials Cheyenne for cowardice after he abandons a herd of needed Army horses. The commander wants answers and orders Cheyenne to take them to a desolate cavalry base used during enemy strikes.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Stubborn Grandpa Fogerty lives in a rundown house with his grandson, Woody. Lucas tries to get the old man to send the boy to school. The ladies of North Fork want Woody removed from the home and ask Lucas to help them.

programme.title: The Rifleman - The Shattered Idol
programme.desc: Famous writer Mark Twain visits North Fork and Mark, who idolizes him, is hurt by his rudeness. Lucas intervenes and discovers the source of Twain's bitterness comes from personal tragedy. Later, both Marks become friends.

programme.title: Drums in the Deep South
programme.desc: When two friends from West Point find themselves on opposite sides during the Civil War, and in a deadly battle atop a mountain, a woman in love with one of the men desperately tries to stop them both from killing each other.

programme.title: Mischief Night
programme.desc: Emily, blind since a car accident killed her mother, has to protect herself and loved ones from an intruder.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A film student (Jason Scott Campbell) finds a video camera that contains footage of himself committing murder.

programme.title: Would You Rather
programme.desc: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

programme.title: Freeway Killer
programme.desc: Californian serial killer William Bonin (Scott Anthony Leet) searches for victims on the state's highways.

programme.desc: A New York detective investigates the death of his daughter, who was murdered while on her honeymoon in London, the victim of an apparent serial killer.

programme.desc: Jackie and Jules are a couple celebrating their first anniversary at a secluded cabin in the woods belonging to Jackie's family. programme.desc: Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

programme.title: VFW
programme.desc: A typical night for veterans at a VFW turns into an all-out battle for survival when a desperate teen runs into the bar with a bag of stolen drugs. When a gang of violent punks come looking for her, the vets use every weapon at their disposal to protect the girl and themselves from an unrelenting attack.

programme.title: Magic
programme.desc: Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Nobody Gets Out Alive
programme.desc: Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.

programme.title: All Hallows' Eve 2
programme.desc: A woman finds a VHS tape that shows a series of gruesome tales.

programme.title: Spree
programme.desc: Thirsty for a following, a rideshare driver has figured out a deadly plan to go viral.

programme.title: Beneath the Darkness
programme.desc: Teenagers discover a terrible secret when they break into the home of a mortician whose wife died two years earlier.

programme.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.

programme.title: Trespassers
programme.desc: Two couples, each working through relationship issues, rent a gorgeous house in the desert for a sex- and drug-fueled escape from reality. As tensions escalate throughout a debaucherous night, things take an unexpected turn when a woman claiming to be a neighbor with car trouble shows up at the door. She seems harmless enough, or so they think.

programme.title: Welcome to Willits
programme.desc: Deep in the woods of Northern California lies the off-the-grid town of Willits, a haven for marijuana growers, meth addicts and conspiracy theorists. When a gaggle of vacationing teens unknowingly set up their campsite on the property of Willits' most disturbed resident, a psychotic, drug-addled pot farmer who is convinced that extraterrestrials are out to get him, they're in for one hell of a bad time.

programme.title: Cabin Fever: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Vacationers think they've found the perfect place for a bachelor party, but a deadly, flesh-eating virus is waiting to infect them.

programme.title: Bone Tomahawk
programme.desc: In the Old West, a sheriff (Kurt Russell), his deputy (Richard Jenkins), a gunslinger (Matthew Fox), and a cowboy (Patrick Wilson) embark on a mission to rescue three people from a savage group of cave dwellers.

programme.title: Almost Human
programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

programme.title: A Wounded Fawn
programme.desc: A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

programme.title: Puppet Master: The Littlest Reich
programme.desc: A man sells a nefarious-looking puppet at a small-town convention for some quick cash. Terror soon strikes when an ancient evil animates the other puppets and sends them on a bloody killing spree.

programme.title: Best of Family Feud
programme.desc: The Funniest Clips and the best laughs from Family Feud.

programme.title: Cheap 4x4 Challenge!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich settle who has the better cheap 4x4.

programme.title: Budget Drag Build and Battle!
programme.desc: The guys have a build off and race like no other; Tony transforms a shell of an '85 Monte Carlo into a beast, while Finnegan makes Newbern's Nova run with ramp truck parts; it's three days of wrenching, two tracks and one unbelievable race.

programme.title: Barn Find Firebird Rescue!
programme.desc: Mike Finnegan and David Newbern rescue a mint '67 Pontiac Firebird that has been stowed in a barn for almost two decades; the guys battle old parts, downpours and other issues in order to get this old drag car racing down the track once again.

programme.title: Road Trippin' the Wreck Runner!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Dulcich hit the road in the '68 Wreck Runner, a four-speed, 383ci clone made from the scraps of a '68 Road Runner and a '68 Satellite; it only has a few little issues; they hit the road to sort 'em out.

programme.title: Barnfind Firebird vs. Crusher Camaro!
programme.desc: Finnegan and Newbern take the barn-find '67 Firebird on an 800-mile road trip to race Freiburger and Dulcich in the Crusher Camaro.

programme.title: Dirt Track Rally Shootout!
programme.desc: Freiburger and Finnegan race Dulcich and Newbern in a dirt-track shootout.

programme.title: No-Prep Drag Race Mustangs!
programme.desc: The guys try their hand at no-prep drag racing against Lyle Barnett and his turbocharged 1,500-hp Beer Money Mustang.

programme.title: Two Legends Become One
programme.desc: For years, Pigpen, the junkyard rescued 1950 GMC truck, has sat dormant; the guys awaken a monster by donating the chassis of their own legendary 1985 S-15 in a body swap for the ages, then take on Randy Pobst at Atlanta Motor Speedway.

programme.title: Dirt Track Racing Mini-Honda!
programme.desc: Everyone wants their car to be better, faster, stronger, but a difference is hard to make on a budget; David Newbern and Mike Cotten may not have all the answers, but they're willing to give it a run by mixing affordable upgrades with sweat equity.

programme.title: Crown Victorious
programme.desc: The guys uncover a cop car racing series around the Ford Crown Victoria P71 Police Interceptor; with a handful of bolt-on upgrades, they turn their former police auction find into a road race ripper around Willow Springs.

programme.title: Baja Bug V-8 Swap!
programme.desc: The guys take on off-road Baja legend Cameron Steele on a brutal desert off-road course with a Baja Bug; they may be outmatched by Cameron's unlimited racing rig, but the addition of a 350 V-8 to their Bug closes a big gap.

programme.title: Lifted Lambo Mud Truck!
programme.desc: The guys take their V-8-powered Pontiac Fiero-based Lamborghini Countach kit car known as the Scamborghini and give it a 6-foot lift to take on an insane wheelie-popping mud truck through what's known as a bounty hole.

programme.title: '57 Chevy Two-Day Turnaround!
programme.desc: The guys take a big-block '57 Bel Air to compete in the autocross at Cruisin' the Coast in Miss.; with a complete overhaul of the suspension in the event's parking lot, the guys find out how much lap time they can shave in a weekend.

programme.title: V-8 Baja Bug Suspension
programme.desc: Off-road legend Cameron Steele warned the guys that a V-8 swap wouldn't cut as much time as a long-travel suspension could; now Newbern and Cotten finally heed his advice, going all-out with major suspension upgrades to their Baja-inspired VW Beetle.

programme.title: Drag Racing Model A!
programme.desc: The guys take on Clay Millican by transforming a Model A from the ground up; with a new chassis, suspension and fresh 400-hp 347ci V-8, the Ford is improved in every way.

programme.title: Turbocharged Eagle Rally Racer
programme.desc: Newbern and Cotten discover a gem which is not a typical American muscle with a turbocharged Eagle Talon; Shea Seefeldt challenges the guys on a rally course with his LS-swapped Subaru.

programme.title: Monte Carlo Surprise!
programme.desc: Newbern surprises Cotten with a mint 1984 G-body and an '80s-style, stock-car-inspired build to take on an actual former cup car around the circle track.

programme.title: Pro Street Mirada Makeover!
programme.desc: Cotten's Pro Street big-block 1980 Dodge Mirada's engine dies on Roadkill; things don't go as planned as the guys attempt to add a giant blower and bigger tires, and bring the car back to its 1990s-era glory.

programme.title: Funny Car Dirt Drags!
programme.desc: The guys transform a '73 Opel funny car into a dirt-roosting machine.

programme.title: Vette Kart vs. 700hp Truck!
programme.desc: The dream of long travel suspension on Roadkill's slightly modified Vette Kart finally comes true for the guys; Brad DeBerti helps them figure out how to not taco the front end as they take on a Pro2 truck on an off-road short course.

programme.title: Waterless Boat Racing!
programme.desc: Newbern, Cotten, and Finnegan participate in an unusual race that requires their boat to survive the competitors' attacks on a dirt track.

programme.title: Drift Pinto: Ford vs. Ferrari!
programme.desc: Newbern and Cotten surprise Finnegan with a 2.3L 1980 Pinto wagon and drift lessons from pro Formula Drift driver Federico Sceriffo; they add a 396ci stroker engine and suspension mods before taking on a 1,000-plus-hp Ferrari 599 GTB.

programme.title: Motorhome Wheelies!
programme.desc: Finnegan, Newbern and Cotten do some wheelie R&D to find out what it takes to put a 1978 GMC Class C motorhome's tires in the air; with the help of pro wheelstander Mike Mantel, the guys take on the challenge of making dreams become reality.

programme.title: Motorhome vs. Firetruck!
programme.desc: The '78 GMC motorhome takes on Mike Mantel's Little Red Firetruck.

programme.title: Thundering C10
programme.desc: It takes a lot to faze Joe Martin, but when his next job pulls into MSB it looks more like a truck load of spare parts than a 1970 C10; Joe knows exactly what he wants to do; new frame, running gear, and a supercharged LSA engine.

programme.title: El Chili
programme.desc: Gary Hopper, a longtime friend of Joe, brings a '55 Chevy Bel Air to the shop; because this '55 has sentimental value to Gary's family, the pressure is on to do this build right; but missing pieces and a dented hood throw a wrench into the job.

programme.title: Instant Classic
programme.desc: Joe Martin is excited to see a straight '63 Impala with a four speed and legendary 409 engine under the hood; the owner wants to keep it original with the main mods under the body, new frame, suspension and big wheels.

programme.title: Mint Condition
programme.desc: A new customer, comes into the shop with an exceptional 1963 Cadillac; this car screams luxury but needs an upgrade; with Shane giving the MBC team creative freedom on the build, Joe gets to work on a plan; new engine, new wheels and a new interior.

programme.title: Flaming '56
programme.desc: Return customer Lee Farris comes to Martin Bros with a 1956 Chevy Bel Air, his first car that he wants to bring back to life; the first thing Joe notices is the outdated flame paint job.

programme.title: Chop Top - Part 1
programme.desc: Joe Martin loves to push the limits; when a customer rolls into the shop with a 1950 Mercury Coupe, Joe Martin knows he needs to chop the top.

programme.title: Chop Top - Part 2
programme.desc: With the 1950 Mercury successfully chopped, the rest of the work can begin; the MBC team now has to marry the old roof with the new geometry of the newly chopped body; there are angles everywhere, and they are all out of whack.

programme.title: Ramble On
programme.desc: Joe Martin gets some unusual cars coming through the door of his work shop, but when a customer from California arrives with a '63 Rambler wagon and tells Joe he can do what he wants with it, he decides to go to town with a radical custom job.

programme.title: Brother's Nova - Part 1
programme.desc: Joe Martin loves Novas and his eyes light up when a new customer, Eric, wants him to customize a 1972 as a tribute to his brother, if they can find one; Shag and Amanda hunt down a '71, in what appears to be mint condition.

programme.title: Brother's Nova - Part 2
programme.desc: Joe Martin and his crew are always under the gun, but their latest build, a '71 Nova, is well behind schedule, and they have a ton of work to do; Joe is really going to town on the metal work on this car, inside and out.

programme.title: 2018 Chevrolet Camaro SS 1LE vs. 2018 Ford Mustang GT
programme.desc: The guys take another crack at a 50-year-old question: Mustang or Camaro?

programme.title: 2018 Chevrolet ZR2 vs. 2017 Ram Power Wagon: Who Needs a Ford Raptor?
programme.desc: Two of the toughest off-road trucks available duke it out in the desert.

programme.title: 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT R vs. 2018 Porsche 911 GT3
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro take a look at two of the best German sports cars ever.

programme.title: Hot Rod Porsches!
programme.desc: One Cali-built custom Porsche 911 is a dancer, the other a sledgehammer.

programme.title: 2017 Ariel Atom 3.5R vs. 2017 Caterham 620R
programme.desc: Jethro brings Jonny to the UK for a British sports car baptism by fire.

programme.title: 2018 Mercedes-AMG E63 S 4Matic+ Wagon vs. 2018 Porsche Panamera Turbo Sport
programme.desc: The guys check out fast German station wagons from Mercedes and Porsche.

programme.title: 2018 Aston Martin Vantage vs. 2018 Audi R8 RWS
programme.desc: The guys check out two cars that are part sports car, part supercar.

programme.title: 2018 Dodge Challenger Hellcat Widebody vs. 2018 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1
programme.desc: The guys pit Chevy's and Dodge's modern-day muscle cars against each other.

programme.title: 2018 Audi TT RS vs. 2018 Porsche 718 Cayman GTS
programme.desc: Jethro and Jonny examine the Audi TT RS and the Porsche 718 Cayman GTS.

programme.title: 2018 Jaguar XJR575 vs. 2018 Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro drive from LA to Las Vegas in a Jaguar and a Maserati.

programme.title: 2018 Ferrari 812 Superfast vs. 2019 Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro visit the nearly 800 horsepower club. The Ferrari 812 Superfast and Dodge Challenger Hellcat Redeye might seem worlds apart on paper, but they are only separated by eight horsepower.

programme.title: 2019 McLaren 600LT vs. 2019 Porsche GT3 RS
programme.desc: The 2019 McLaren 600LT faces off against the 2019 Porsche GT3 RS.

programme.title: Shotgun Versus Scalpel! BMW 2019 M2 vs. 2019 Alpine A110
programme.desc: Jethro and Jonny pit BMW's mighty M2 against the ultralight Alpine A110.

programme.title: Jeep Wrangler Rubicon vs. Mercedes-Benz G550
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro look at two of the last true hardcore production SUVs.

programme.title: 2019 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio vs 2019 Jaguar Project 8
programme.desc: The Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio is up against the Jaguar Project 8.

programme.title: 2019 MAT New Stratos vs. 2019 Superformance GT40 vs. 2019 Nissan GT-R
programme.desc: The MAT New Stratos and Superformance GT40 have one foot in the past.

programme.title: Who Knew $600,000 Could Be This Much Fun?
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro live out their touring fantasies in two British beasts.

programme.title: 2019 Ford Mustang Shelby GT350 vs. 2020 Toyota GR Supra
programme.desc: The guys pit the legendary Shelby GT350 against the new Toyota Supra.

programme.title: Drive It Like You Stole It! 2019 Civic Type R vs. 2020 Veloster N
programme.desc: The 2019 Honda Civic Type R does battle with the 2020 Hyundai Veloster N.

programme.title: Clash of the Odd Couple! '19 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE vs '20 Lotus Evora GT
programme.desc: The '19 Camaro ZL1 1LE goes up against the 2020 Lotus Evora.

programme.title: Holiday Hammer Down! 2019 BMW M5 Competition vs. 2019 Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S
programme.desc: Jonny and Jethro drive the BMW M5 Competition and the Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S.

programme.title: Let the Chef Cook
programme.desc: Dave and the crew start on a 1966 Corvette, but his client doesn't want the color to be anywhere close to its original green.

programme.title: Let's Make Green Great Again
programme.desc: Dave comes up with a shade of green that finally gets the client on board.

programme.title: Easy Does It
programme.desc: A past client returns with a 1965 Mustang Fastback, and though he likes the stock look, he wants to upgrade the drivetrain, instrumentation and as many modern amenities as possible; the assembly team gets a crash course in engine tuning.

programme.title: Thank You for Your Service
programme.desc: The crew strives to finish an active-duty serviceman's '51 Ford pickup.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: The 1951 Ford pickup is painted and ready for final assembly; the team encounters many problems trying to get it ready for a serviceman who is returning from a year away in a war zone.

programme.title: Fireproof
programme.desc: After recovering from a terrible accident where his '32 Ford caught fire, a local business owner wants to see the car fixed as well; diagnosing the fire damage and what caused it is a priority; a 1967 Mustang arrives with a nasty engine vibration.

programme.title: Fastback Fever
programme.desc: Dave designs a Mustang for the ages to compete in the Optima Challenge; the build includes a new front fascia and hood and redesigning the rear end.

programme.title: Challenge Complete
programme.desc: The 1965 Mustang makes its way through the metal shop and is now ready for paint and final assembly; making it function will test even the Kindig crew.

programme.title: Once in a Lifetime
programme.desc: Dave has decided that the time is right to design his own concept car from scratch; it's a huge job that involves all the different departments in the shop.

programme.title: It's Alive!!
programme.desc: All the Concept Corvette's elements are built and assembled, but Dave needs to find a buyer; a rock 'n' roll icon brings his '34 Ford coupe to the shop.

programme.title: Just a Couple Heres and Theres
programme.desc: A simple repaint of a 1964 Corvette careens into much more after Dave upsells the client on a couple of design features, and the crew finds some damage underneath the original paint; the owner of an iconic Ford GTX1 tasks Dave with solving a dilemma.

programme.title: Back From the Dead
programme.desc: An abandoned 1967 C10 that has been sitting for years has been sold to a client who wants a few new touches, but closer inspection reveals more work is needed.

programme.title: That's Never Been Done
programme.desc: Dave convinces the client to make the 1967 C10 truck into a convertible; Kevin takes on a new personal project with a Cadillac Escalade.

programme.title: The Convertible C10
programme.desc: The engineering on the convertible C10 works in theory, but making it work in practice is the next step; a team brings in a replica 1967 Cobra with a bad engine.

programme.title: 'Mueller? 'Mueller?
programme.desc: Of all the different years and generations of the VW Bug, there is one that stands out among the rest -- the Hebmüller; there are maybe 200 of them left, so in addition to being hard to find, they are truly the holy grail of VWs.

programme.title: The Holy Grail, But Customized
programme.desc: The build continues, and the challenge is to keep what makes the car a Hebmueller intact, while taking steps to turn it into a hot rod; Dave keeps the traditional two-tone exterior, but modifying it to an automatic is a challenge for the shop.

programme.title: Meet Judge KevDogg
programme.desc: Normally when Kindig-It Design attends a car show, their cars are the ones being judged; this time around, Dave and Kev hold the keys and have to select the top 10 builders out of the hundreds of cars that arrive for the show.

programme.title: Restorations? We're Talking 'Bout Restorations?
programme.desc: Dave's clients have owned a car since they got married 25 years ago and want it restored so they can enjoy it for another 25; while the shop isn't really into straight restorations, adding some custom pieces and paint makes them say yes to the pro.

programme.title: It's a Barn Door Deluxe, Of Course
programme.desc: Dave is thrilled with the latest build, while KevDogg is barely lukewarm; Dave has done double-cab VWs, Bugs and Karmann Ghias, but now he is taking on something completely different, and even more rare.

programme.title: The Big Brother
