programme.title: Closer Than a Brother
programme.desc: Lucas looks for answers when recovering alcoholic Micah Torrence returns to the bottle and turns in his badge.

programme.title: The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
programme.desc: Lucas, Mark and Micah tangle with the Newman family and learn the secret of a town's 20-year-old mystery.

programme.title: Dark Day at North Fork
programme.desc: Blinded in an explosion, Lucas fights despair as he prepares for a meeting with a gun-toting enemy.

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: A deranged ex-prisoner of war, cruelly abused in a Northern army prison, captures Lucas, locks him in a cage and vows to make him suffer for his part in the Civil War.

programme.title: Assault
programme.desc: A traveling salesman can't talk his way out of an assault charge.

programme.title: Short Rope for a Tall Man
programme.desc: Lucas is threatened with hanging by a lynch party when some horses he has purchased in a neighboring town turn out to be stolen.

programme.title: The Clarence Bibs Story
programme.desc: A janitor-turned-gunfighter's reputation hangs on one lucky shot and a lot of gall. The handyman finds himself in trouble when he accidentally kills another gunfighter.

programme.title: The Score Is Even
programme.desc: Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: The Mescalaro Curse
programme.desc: After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.

programme.title: Stopover
programme.desc: Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whisky salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.

programme.title: The Lonesome Bride
programme.desc: Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.

programme.title: Death Trap
programme.desc: Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.

programme.title: The Queue
programme.desc: A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.

programme.title: The Vaqueros
programme.desc: While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.

programme.title: First Wages
programme.desc: Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.

programme.title: Sheer Terror
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.

programme.title: The Stand-In
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.

programme.title: The Journey Back
programme.desc: Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: Corey Hazlett insists he's innocent of murder, despite Lucas's eyewitness testimony.

programme.title: Knight Errant
programme.desc: Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.

programme.title: Honest Abe
programme.desc: Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.

programme.title: The Shattered Idol
programme.desc: Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.

programme.title: Long Gun From Tucson
programme.desc: Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.

programme.title: The High Country
programme.desc: Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.

programme.title: A Friend in Need
programme.desc: When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.

programme.title: Skull
programme.desc: Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.

programme.title: The Princess
programme.desc: The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.

programme.title: Gunfire
programme.desc: A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.

programme.title: The Quiet Fear
programme.desc: Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.

programme.title: Sporting Chance
programme.desc: An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: Mark falls head-over-heels in puppy love.

programme.title: The Man from Salinas
programme.desc: Banker Hamilton is closing up for the day when Rudy Gray persuades him to stay open for one more transaction.

programme.title: Two Ounces of Tin
programme.desc: Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.

programme.title: Deadly Image
programme.desc: Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.

programme.title: Tinhorn
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.

programme.title: None So Blind
programme.desc: Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.

programme.title: Jealous Man
programme.desc: A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.

programme.title: Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.

programme.title: The Day the Town Slept
programme.desc: The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.

programme.title: Milly's Brother
programme.desc: A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.

programme.title: Outlaw's Shoes
programme.desc: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

programme.title: Waste: Part 1
programme.desc: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

programme.title: Waste: Part 2
programme.desc: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

programme.title: Lou Mallory
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: Quiet Night, Deadly Night
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox hotel occupants are quarantined with an outlaw.

programme.title: Death Never Rides Alone
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: I Take This Woman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Assailants
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: Mark's Rifle
programme.desc: Sharpshooter Marty Blair tries to persuade Lucas to buy Mark a rifle. After Lucas shoots a man during a robbery at the hotel, Mark and Lucas disagree his character.

programme.title: The Most Amazing Man
programme.desc: Fast-draw artist Wade Randall is in town, bragging of his gun battles with notorious bad men, until one of them shows up to challenge his story.

programme.title: Squeeze Play
programme.desc: When Lucas refuses to sell his land, Mr. Prescott will stop at nothing to to change his mind. He hires men to try to persuade Lucas, but he refuses.

programme.title: Gun Shy
programme.desc: Mark's careless actions cause the death of a friend. Unable to accept the truth, he blames the rifle and runs away from home. Soon, he is faced with a tough decision.

programme.title: The Anvil Chorus
programme.desc: Nils Swenson takes the marshal's place for a few days while Micah is away. To maintain peace, Nils insists that anyone coming into town must turn in their weapons.

programme.title: Conflict
programme.desc: Lucas's self-confidence begins to slip away when he misses an easy shot that could have cost Mark his life.

programme.title: Incident at Line Shack Six
programme.desc: A murder occurs at a railroad camp and a young Indian friend of Lucas' is accused of the killing. When Lucas tries to help the boy, he finds himself on trial.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark come upon Winslow Quince, a peddler whose wagon has broken down. They help him bring his wagon to North Fork for repair.

programme.title: The Sidewinder
programme.desc: Gridley Mau, the son of a man Lucas killed during an attempted robbery, comes to North Fork looking for revenge.

programme.title: The Sixteenth Cousin
programme.desc: The first railroad train is coming to the North Fork station. On board is a Japanese nobleman visiting the US.

programme.title: Hostages to Fortune
programme.desc: At Halloween, rustlers take advantage of the seasonal disguises to raid a cattle ranch. Lucas' faith in his son's honesty is shaken when he hears rumors of Mark being mixed up with the thieves.

programme.title: And the Devil Makes Five
programme.desc: Mark and Lucas run into Micah on the trail and help when the prisoner he is transporting injures his arm.

programme.title: End of the Hunt
programme.desc: While Mark goes hunting for Old Spike, Lucas goes hunting for his mortal enemy. Lucas is thrown into jail to stop him from murdering his former friend.

programme.title: The Bullet
programme.desc: Lucas is baffled when the marshal of a neighboring town refuses to hold a gambler who just attempted murder.

programme.title: Requiem at Mission Springs
programme.desc: Mark is injured in an accident, leaving his legs paralyzed. At the doctor's suggestion, Lucas and Mark set out on a trek to Mission Springs.

programme.title: The Guest
programme.desc: Mario Arsatti claims to be an acquaintance of a friend from Lucas' past. But he has been hired to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Old Man, Running
programme.desc: Lucas, who blames his wife's death on his father-in-law, refuses to help the old man elude a gang of gunmen.

programme.title: Which Way'd They Go?
programme.desc: The lazy Jackman brothers mortgage has been foreclosed. Unfit for farming, they head to a nearby town.

programme.title: Old Tony
programme.desc: Mark and his girlfriend discover that an old hermit is very lonely. Old Tony invites them to lunch and lets them look for arrowheads on a remote part of his land.

programme.title: The Sharpshooter
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark decide to enter a local turkey shoot to raise money to buy a ranch.

programme.title: Home Ranch
programme.desc: Cattle baron Oat Jackford orders his two cowboys to run Lucas McCain and his son off their ranch.

programme.title: End of a Young Gun
programme.desc: When Mark gets caught on a mountain ledge, a young outlaw risks his life to rescue him and breaks his leg doing so.

programme.title: The Marshal
programme.desc: The notorious Shelton rides into the town of North Fork to take revenge on an elderly Marshal who is now crippled and working for Lucas McCain.

programme.title: The Brother-In-Law
programme.desc: Johnny Gibbs, Lucas McCain's brother-in-law, visits the McCain ranch. Gibbs, a rodeo rider wanted by the law, begins stirring up trouble.

programme.title: Eight Hours to Die
programme.desc: A vengeful judge who believes Lucas was responsible for his son's death, kidnaps Mark McCain to revenge himself on Lucas.

programme.title: Duel of Honor
programme.desc: A handsome Italian count arrives in North Fork. The town bully ridicules his manner of speech and dress and provokes the Count to challenge him to a duel.

programme.title: The Safe Guard
programme.desc: A new bank opens and Banker Hamilton hires a slow-witted gunman to guard the safe. When some of the gunman's old outlaw friends arrive in town they propose he join them in robbing the bank.

programme.title: The Sister
programme.desc: When Mark tries to play Cupid between Lucas and a stranger who arrives in North Fork, the girl's older brothers accuse him of trifling with her affections and challenge him to fight.

programme.title: New Orleans Menace
programme.desc: An arch-criminal has been run out of New Orleans and is passing through North Fork. Spotting the McCain ranch, he tells McCain he wants to buy it.

programme.title: The Apprentice Sheriff

programme.title: 99 Homes
programme.desc: A desperate construction worker (Andrew Garfield) reluctantly accepts a job with the ruthless real-estate broker (Michael Shannon) who evicted him and his family from their home.

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: In 1906 Hong Kong, a newspaper editor and a tycoon learn of an assassination plot against Sun Yat-sen, and recruit a small band of ordinary men and women to protect him.

programme.title: Before I Go to Sleep
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
programme.desc: Andy (Philip Seymour Hoffman), a debt-ridden broker, needs some quick cash. He ropes his younger brother, Hank (Ethan Hawke), into a scheme to commit the perfect crime: to rob their parents' (Albert Finney, Rosemary Harris) jewelry store. The scheme goes horribly awry, and the family patriarch takes justice into his own hands, unaware that the criminals he is hunting are his own sons.

programme.title: A Better Tomorrow
programme.desc: A Hong Kong policeman blames his reformed-gangster brother (Chow Yun-Fat) for the death of their father.

programme.title: Basquiat
programme.desc: Despite living a life of extreme poverty in Brooklyn, graffiti artist Jean-Michel Basquiat (Jeffrey Wright) strives to rise up through the heady New York art scene of the 1970s and 1980s. He becomes the brightest star of neo-Expressionist painting and one of the most successful painters of his time, and even develops a friendship with Andy Warhol (David Bowie). But Basquiat's tumultuous life, specifically his addiction to heroin, overshadows his rise to fame, threatening all.

programme.title: Black Christmas
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: Unmarried yuppies Patty (Melanie Griffith) and Drake (Matthew Modine) move into an expensive dream home in a high-end neighborhood in San Francisco. As they renovate the house, they look for a tenant for the first floor of their house. Carter Hayes (Michael Keaton) seems like a great fit at first, but it transpires that he is a con artist who plans to swindle them out of their real estate. As Hayes tries to drive them out of their own home, the couple must take drastic measures to fight back.

programme.title: Among Wolves
programme.desc: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

programme.title: If... Dog... Rabbit
programme.desc: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother.

programme.title: Eat My Dust!
programme.desc: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

programme.title: Eat My Dust!
programme.desc: A California sheriff's son and his girlfriend go for a joyride in a stolen stock car.

programme.title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
programme.desc: Julien Temple's film is a fitting tribute to one of Britain's most influential and best-loved musicians, best known as the frontman of The Clash, who mellowed in later life into fronting his new band, the Mescaleros. Temple's advantage is that as a chronicler of punk from its earliest days, he could call on his own archive footage as well as that shot by others over the years.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Luv
programme.desc: Accompanied by his young nephew (Michael Rainey Jr.), an ex-convict (Common) tries to raise money through a drug deal.

programme.title: Homegrown
programme.desc: Marijuana growers Jack (Billy Bob Thornton), Carter (Hank Azaria) and Harlan (Ryan Phillippe) are looking at a big payoff for their crop -- until head honcho Malcolm (John Lithgow) is murdered. Wanting a bigger piece of the proverbial pie, the three men decide to keep Malcolm's demise a secret, selling the stash themselves and pocketing all the profits. But, when they get involved with some very dangerous characters in the drug industry, the men start to question the wisdom of their scheme.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Dawg
programme.desc: After a lifetime of wooing, bedding and then leaving women without giving them a second thought, the self-centered Douglas Munford (Denis Leary) finds himself having to reflect on the hurt he has caused -- that is, if he wants a big inheritance from his late grandmother. According to Anna (Elizabeth Hurley), the estate's executor, Douglas must find 12 of the women he mistreated and get their forgiveness. Thus, the man who earned the nickname "Dawg" begins his journey of redemption.

programme.title: Crimson Rivers: Angels of the Apocalypse
programme.desc: Called to a French monastery following the appearance of a dead body, Detective Pierre Niemans (Jean Reno) finds himself investigating what appears to be a radical cult killing that's based on obscure passages from the Bible. When fellow detective Reda (Benoît Magimel) shows up, his own murder investigation intertwining with Niemans', it becomes clear that a grand conspiracy is underway, one that spans the globe and reaches all the way back to World War II.

programme.title: Down by Law

programme.title: Glengarry Glen Ross
programme.desc: When an office full of New York City real estate salesmen is given the news that all but the top two will be fired at the end of the week, the atmosphere begins to heat up. Shelley Levene (Jack Lemmon), who has a sick daughter, does everything in his power to get better leads from his boss, John Williamson (Kevin Spacey), but to no avail. When his coworker Dave Moss (Ed Harris) comes up with a plan to steal the leads, things get complicated for the tough-talking salesmen.

The girl is no ordinary child; she's a math prodigy who holds in her head a numerical code for which various factions are ready to kill.

programme.title: Trauma Center
programme.desc: Alone and trapped in a locked-down hospital isolation ward overnight, an injured young woman must escape a pair of vicious killers who are after the only piece of evidence that can implicate them in a grisly murder: the bullet in her leg.

programme.title: Akeelah and the Bee
programme.desc: Akeelah, an 11-year-old girl living in South Los Angeles, discovers she has a talent for spelling, which she hopes will take her to the National Spelling Bee.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: Voyagers
programme.desc: With the future of the human race at stake, a group of young men and women -- bred for intelligence and obedience -- embark on an expedition to colonize a distant planet. When they uncover disturbing secrets about the mission, they defy their training and begin to explore their most primitive natures. As life on the ship descends into chaos, they soon become consumed by fear, lust and an insatiable hunger for power.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Young entrepreneurs Sean (Emile Hirsch) and Ben (Max Minghella) meet stranded travelers Natalie (Olivia Thirlby) and Anne (Rachael Taylor) at a hot Moscow nightclub. Their whole world changes in an instant when an alien attack devastates the city and everything goes dark. Joined by a Swedish businessman (Joel Kinnaman), the youths emerge from hiding days later and must somehow fight back against a nearly invisible enemy that could find and disintegrate them at any moment.

programme.title: Ender's Game
programme.desc: When hostile aliens called the Formics attack Earth, only the legendary heroics of Mazer Rackham (Ben Kingsley) manage to attain a victory. To prepare for the next attack, Col. Hyrum Graff (Harrison Ford) and his cohorts initiate a military program to find the next Mazer. Recruit Ender Wiggin (Asa Butterfield) exhibits an unusual gift for the training, easily mastering all the challenges thrown at him. Mazer Rackham, himself, takes Ender as a protégé to prepare him for the oncoming war.

programme.title: The Giver
programme.desc: Jonas (Brenton Thwaites) lives in a seemingly idyllic world of conformity and contentment. When he begins to spend time with The Giver (Jeff Bridges), an old man who is the sole keeper of the community's memories, Jonas discovers the dangerous truths of his community's secret past. Armed with the power of knowledge, Jonas realizes that he must escape from their world to protect himself and those he loves -- a challenge no one has ever completed successfully.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: The world stands on the brink of annihilation when a mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling toward a collision course with Earth. With only weeks before impact, NASA executive Jacinda "Jo" Fowler teams up with a man from her past and a conspiracy theorist for an impossible mission into space to save humanity.

programme.title: Kin
programme.desc: While scavenging for copper wire, Detroit teenager Eli Solinski stumbles upon a high-tech gun that holds special powers. When his brother, Jimmy, lands in trouble with a local crime boss, the two siblings take the mysterious weapon and go on the run. Eli and Jimmy now find themselves in a life-and-death battle against an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their gun back.

programme.desc: A strange sea fortress that guards icy waters is home to a grim secret; experts investigate the mysteries at this eerie structure, which fought an invisible enemy far more deadly than ever imagined.

programme.title: Hidden Hell of Angel Island
programme.desc: A cluster of military defensive structures among a quaint holiday village lie deserted on a San Francisco Bay island; experts investigate and uncover a mysterious Civil War outpost that conceals a dark and hellish history.

programme.title: Fortress of Nuclear Secrets
programme.desc: Long, dome-like structures camouflaged by a rural landscape conceal the remains of concrete vaults with a hidden history; experts investigate and uncover state-of-the-art bunkers built to conceal and protect a deadly nuclear secret.

programme.title: Psychiatric Ruins of Scotland
programme.desc: The ruins of a mental health institution lie deserted in the Scottish woodlands; experts investigate and uncover the terrifying past of a notorious psychiatric asylum where many entered but few escaped.

programme.title: Historic Remains of USS Hornet

programme.title: Remnants of Rocket Complex

programme.title: Hollywood vs. Nazis

programme.title: Ruins of the Zoo Fortress

programme.title: The Beached Leviathan
programme.desc: Experts investigate the ruins an enormous war machine stranded in Russia.

programme.title: Derelict Housing of Protest

programme.title: Desolate Remnants of Agdam

programme.title: Chinese Nuclear Box
programme.desc: An enormous concrete box with bizarre circular openings looms on the coast of an island near mainland China; experts investigate and uncover tunnels leading to an enormous underground complex that nearly triggered a nuclear war.

programme.title: Secret Vaults of Scotland
programme.desc: A series of dark, subterranean vaults lie hidden beneath the bustling streets of Edinburgh, Scotland; experts investigate and uncover a vast network of tunnels and chambers that contain a history of opportunity, crime and destitution.

programme.title: Desolation of Ponte City

programme.title: Remnants of Traitor Chateau
programme.desc: An opulent château perched in the middle of a lake now stands dilapidated in the Loire Valley of France; experts investigate and uncover the remains of a festering palace whose owner was labeled a traitor by France's most notorious king.

programme.title: Shadowed

programme.title: Toxic Relations
programme.desc: A century-old house stricken by tragedy; a house's former occupants met a series of unfortunate deaths, and their spirits still linger in the home.

programme.title: Carriage House Creeper

programme.title: Tradition Dies Hard

programme.title: Disorderly Conduct
programme.desc: Amy, Adam and Chip investigate escalating paranormal problems at a home undergoing renovations; the entities within are fiercely protective of the property and lash out when the team attempts to communicate.

programme.title: Death Alley

programme.title: Death Interrupted

programme.title: Fenwick Plantation

programme.title: Pennhurst Asylum

programme.title: Hill View Manor

programme.title: Sibley Mill

programme.title: Fort Delaware

programme.title: The Bissman Building

programme.title: Peoria State Hospital

programme.title: Missouri State Penitentiary

programme.title: Castillo de San Marcos

programme.title: Coco Palms Resort

programme.title: Old Crow Distillery

programme.title: Brushy Mountain Penitentiary

programme.title: Anderson Hotel

programme.title: Hinsdale House

programme.desc: Nick and Katrina are in Staten Island, New York to seek answers on who is haunting the infamous Kreischer Mansion.

programme.title: Unlocked: The Black Monk House
programme.desc: Katrina Weidman and Nick Groff launch a special investigation of the Black Monk House in Yorkshire, England, feared for its violent poltergeist activity; Groff and Weidman plan to stay in the house for 100 hours.

programme.title: Monroe House
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina spend 72 hours untangling the mysteries of Monroe Demon House, dealing with wraiths that are at odds with each other.

programme.title: Shrewsbury Prison
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina unlock the foreboding secrets of HMS Shrewsbury Prison in England, facing down over 200 years of executions, anger and tragedy.

programme.title: Oliver House
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina visit a historic manor in Middleboro, Mass., to determine if it's unsafe for tourists; Katrina investigates hauntings beyond the house; the paranormal activity hits too close to home for Nick.

programme.title: St. Ignatius Hospital
programme.desc: St. Ignatius Hospital in Colfax, Wash. has been abandoned since 2003, but Nick and Katrina soon realize they are not alone in the hospital.

programme.title: Waverly Hills
programme.desc: Nick and Katrina set out to document the elusive shadow figures lurking within the expansive corridors of Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Ky.

programme.title: Bellaire and Hinsdale Unlocked
programme.desc: The team is called to Ohio to help a bereft mother identify the dark energy forcing her family to flee their home; Nick gets caught in a psychological battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Saddle Warmer
programme.desc: A former medical student (David Hartman) drifting west feels responsible for a broken leg suffered by Trampas and offers to take the ranch hand's place until he recovers; guests Ralph Bellamy, the Irish Rovers.

programme.title: Fox, Hound & the Widow McCloud
programme.desc: A convict (Victor Jory) on the run from a bounty hunter (Troy Donahue) seeks help from onetime cellmate Trampas; guest Jean Inness.

programme.title: Ride to Misadventure
programme.desc: The Virginian teams with a bounty hunter (Joseph Campanella) to find the gang responsible for robbing gold and cattle vaccine from the Medicine Bow stage; guest Katherine Justice.

programme.title: Price of Love
programme.desc: A young cowboy (Peter Duel) tries to repay past kindnesses by using a gun to settle a land dispute with a neighbor (James Gregory); guest Skip Homeier.

programme.title: Image of an Outlaw
programme.desc: An innocent ranch hand is mistaken for a wanted criminal (Don Stroud in a dual role), and later sees advantages in assuming the fugitive's identity; guest Sandy Kenyon.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Clay's old friend (Anne Baxter) and her Army-officer husband (Hugh Beaumont) cut a visit short after Indians kill a soldier; guest Tim McIntire.

programme.title: Vision of Blindness
programme.desc: An ex-convict (John Saxon) seeking to take revenge on Trampas for his brother's death finds Elizabeth, left blinded and helpless after a stagecoach accident; guests Ben Johnson, the Irish Rovers.

programme.title: The Mustangers
programme.desc: An aging bronco buster (James Edwards) who wants to send his son (Chuck Daniel) to school in Texas turns to a horse thief (Don Knight) to get the necessary money; guest Grace Lee Whitney.

programme.title: Death Wait
programme.desc: A vengeful father (Harold J. Stone) and his gunslinger son (Murray MacLeod) don't believe David killed another son in self-defense; guests Conlan Carter, Sheila Larkin.

programme.title: The Land Dreamer
programme.desc: A foreclosed farmer (James Olson) becomes the target of a lynch mob after killing an unscrupulous investor (Don Francks); guests Cloris Leachman, Ford Rainey, John Daniels.

programme.title: Big Tiny
programme.desc: David poses as the fiancé of a young woman with a persistent suitor, then discovers her admirer is a giant.

programme.title: Crime Wave in Buffalo Springs
programme.desc: Yvonne De Carlo and the Irish Rovers head the list of guest stars in the first comedy ever presented on the Virginian.

programme.title: Halfway Back From Hell
programme.desc: Trampas helps prison probationers succeed with an Arizona ranch despite local opposition.

programme.title: Long Ride Home
programme.desc: A roving cowboy attempts to recoup money from a con man, while his sidekick begins to prefer ranch life.

programme.title: The Power Seekers
programme.desc: Clay discovers politics' unsavory side when he runs against an ambitious opponent (Andrew Prine) for the territorial legislature; guests Barry Sullivan, Dana Elcar, John McLiam.

programme.title: No War for the Warrior
programme.desc: Jim's life is endangered after an Indian (Charles Robinson) running from authorities hides out with the Shiloh wranglers on a cattle drive; guests Henry Jones, Charles Aidman.

programme.title: A Love to Remember
programme.desc: A Boston journalist tracking her family's killer finds articles that belonged to her spouse.

programme.title: A Touch of Hands
programme.desc: Trampas agrees to marry a childhood friend, coming back from finishing school, despite her father's wishes.

programme.title: The Runaway
programme.desc: A boy (Johnnie Whitaker) fleeing a reform-school operator (Peter Whitney) shelters at Shiloh Ranch while the Virginian and Trampas try to find his father (Guy Stockwell).

programme.title: The Bugler
programme.desc: After being whipped, an Army private (Michael Burns) deserts the post commanded by his father (Morgan Woodward) and is found unconscious and injured on Shiloh property; guest Alan Hale.

programme.title: A Woman of Stone
programme.desc: A long-time captive (Bethel Leslie) of an Indian tribe returns to the husband (Charles Drake) who deserted her during a raid, only to find her desire for revenge could destroy her daughter's wedding.

programme.title: A King's Ransom
programme.desc: An Australian couple visits Medicine Bow with plans to kidnap and ransom Clay.

programme.title: A Flash of Darkness
programme.desc: Blinded after a fall, the Virginian strays to the home of a horse thief and his two sons, fired earlier from Shiloh.

programme.title: Journey to Scathelock
programme.desc: Jim heads to Canada on the trail of a saloon girl (Anne Helm) and her con-man boyfriend (Burr De Benning) who disappeared from Shiloh with $4,000; guests Frank Campanella, Lawrence Dane.

programme.title: The Family Man
programme.desc: Jim delivers the baby of a woman (Darleen Carr) whose fugitive husband has run out on her, then cares for her and her property in addition to his responsibilities at the ranch.

programme.title: A Time of Terror
programme.desc: A family (Shelly Novak, Phillip Alford, Pamela Murphy) takes over Shiloh at gunpoint, then lures the Graingers' friend (Joseph Cotten), a Congressional candidate, to the ranch for revenge.

programme.title: Black Jade
programme.desc: Trampas joins forces with his quarry when an outlaw captures them in a ghost town.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Gregg Palmer) waylays Trampas then takes him to a town where he is mistakenly identified as the killer of a beloved local doctor; guests Dennis Cooney, Beverlee McKinsey.

programme.title: You Can Lead a Horse to Water
programme.desc: A stagecoach robbery interferes with the plans of a Southern belle (Elizabeth Hubbard) who is traveling to Clearwater to marry her childhood sweetheart (Anthony Eisley); guest Strother Martin.

programme.title: Rich Man, Poor Man
programme.desc: A poor farmer (Jack Elam) goes on a spree, spending the $10,000 reward for helping capture a bank robber; guest Patricia Morrow.

programme.title: Holocaust
programme.desc: An agent for Eastern interests begins to split the Cattlemen's Association, to grab land.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A newly married woman (Joan Crawford) faces many problems, including a murder charge, after her husband's (Michael Conrad) injury sets off a bid for power in his company; guest Warren Kemmerling.

programme.title: Sins of the Fathers
programme.desc: Clay awaits a showdown with a young gunslinger (Robert Lipton), hired as a Shiloh ranch hand, who blames his father's death 20 years earlier on Grainger and refuses to listen to any explanation.

programme.title: Home to Methuselah
programme.desc: An aging sheriff (John Anderson) arrives to visit old friend the Virginian, then invites him on a hunting trip that is actually a cover for tracking the last of a desperate band of bank robbers.

programme.title: Train of Darkness
programme.desc: A clan avenging the death of kin targets a former gunslinger and his bride.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: A wounded bank robber hides his loot and dies in a saloon girl's room, making her the target of his partner.

programme.title: Throw a Long Rope
programme.desc: The Virginian defends a poor homesteader (Jack Warden) against attacks by Judge Garth and an ex-Army officer (John Anderson); guest Ted Knight.

programme.title: The Executioners
programme.desc: The Virginian hires an itinerant cowboy (Hugh O'Brian), despite the sheriff's (John Larch) suspicions he may be looking for revenge.

programme.title: Woman From White Wing
programme.desc: Carrying a secret that could destroy Garth's relationship with his daughter, a former friend (Barry Sullivan) of the judge's arrives at Shiloh Ranch; guests Tom Reese, Parley Baer.

programme.title: The Big Deal
programme.desc: A South American (Ricardo Montalban) uses armed men and barbed wire around his land, which is surrounded by Shiloh property.

programme.title: Riff-Raff
programme.desc: Trampas, Steve and the Virginian enlist in Theodore Roosevelt's Rough Riders, and join in the charge up San Juan Hill in Cuba; guest Ray Danton.

programme.title: Impasse
programme.desc: The head (Eddie Albert) of a family of horse thieves plots retaliation when Shiloh begins a wild-horse roundup, but doesn't expect his daughter's (Denice Alexander) reaction to Trampas.

programme.title: It Tolls for Thee
programme.desc: A vengeful ex-convict (Lee Marvin) kidnaps Garth, intending to use torture to reduce him to savagery; guests Albert Salmi, Ron Soble.

programme.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show
programme.desc: Sofía Vergara, Howie Mandel, Terry Crews and Mel B ("America's Got Talent"); Bre-Z (series "All American").

programme.title: Baker vs. Johnson
programme.desc: The court calls on a polygraph examiner to determine if a woman is sleeping with her boyfriend's 21-year-old son.

programme.title: Daskoski vs. Daskoski
programme.desc: A Florida man confesses to cheating 32 years ago, but his wife suspects he's still cheating and will end their 37-year marriage if the polygraph results prove he's guilty.

programme.title: Collins vs. Collins
programme.desc: After 13 years of marriage, an Oklahoma woman comes to court, and she is worried that her minister husband is preaching more than just the word.

programme.title: Pruitt vs. Catlin
programme.desc: A former college football player denies his wife's allegations that he cheats to punish her for ruining his chance at a football career.

programme.title: Cotton vs. Pendleton
programme.desc: A Philadelphia mother brings her ex-boyfriend to court to prove that he is the father of her 6-month-old baby girl.

programme.title: Robinson vs. Smith
programme.desc: A Michigan woman brings her boyfriend to court to prove he is the biological father of her 2-month-old fraternal twins.

programme.title: Davis vs. Simpson
programme.desc: After forgiving his ex-wife for cheating on him 11 times, a divorced man doubts the paternity of her 2-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Grimes vs. Davis
programme.desc: A woman from Missouri says her ex-boyfriend is the biological father of her 10-month-old son, but he claims that another man is.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Officer Corbin is forced to pursue her ex-con brother when he returns to Sparta and becomes a suspect in a robbery.

programme.title: A Frenzied Affair
programme.desc: A man is accused of killing his teen stepdaughter's married lover; Althea nears a nervous breakdown; guest Allan Arbus.

programme.title: Discovery
programme.desc: Althea goes into a deep depression sparked by the suicide of a troubled student while his former girlfriend falls for a biker.

programme.title: Our Family Wedding
programme.desc: Soon after returning from college, Lucia (America Ferrera) and Marcus (Lance Gross) announce their engagement to their parents. Marcus and Lucia realize too late that, although it's their marriage, the wedding belongs to their families. Insults fly and tensions run high when their highly competitive fathers (Forest Whitaker, Carlos Mencia) get involved, threatening to wreak havoc with the couple's special day.

programme.title: The Nutty Professor
programme.desc: Brilliant and obese scientist Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) invents a miraculous weight-loss solution. After a date with chemistry student Carla Purty (Jada Pinkett) goes badly, a depressed Klump tries the solution on himself. Though he instantly loses 250 pounds, the side effects include a second personality: an obnoxiously self-assertive braggart who calls himself Buddy Love. Buddy proves to be more popular than Sherman, but his arrogance and bad behavior quickly spiral out of control.

programme.title: Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Professor Sherman Klump (Eddie Murphy) is getting married. And the Klump family could not be more delighted. His fiancée Denise (Janet Jackson) is thrilled to become a Klump, and with her appetite she'll fit right in. But Buddy Love ... well, Buddy is another matter.

programme.title: Dead Mann Walking
programme.desc: The family plays into Daniel's health hysteria in order to get him to visit his doctor. Lieutenant Tate and Hobbs use a social media expert to help them solve a string of thefts.

programme.title: Dope Mann
programme.desc: When drugs are found at Toni's school, everyone sees DJ as a suspect. Hobbs and Mann go undercover at the school to catch the criminal.

programme.title: A Woman's Mann
programme.desc: Toni takes DJ and Terri to a robotics competition, but she accidentally ruins Terri's chances at victory; Daniel does a horrible job watching the kids and the house on his own.

programme.title: Mann, Shut Yo Mouth
programme.desc: Struggling to solve a tough case, an exhausted Daniel falls asleep and wakes up in a 70s blaxploitation cop show.

programme.title: Here Come the Manns
programme.desc: Daniel and Toni return home from their honeymoon to their new life, including their blended family and Daniel's mother, all under one roof.

programme.title: Life
programme.desc: During Prohibition, loudmouth Harlem grifter Ray (Eddie Murphy) and the no-nonsense Claude (Martin Lawrence) team up on a bootlegging mission to Mississippi that could bring them big bucks. But they run into trouble when a crooked lawman hits them with a phony murder charge. Ray and Claude are given life sentences and shipped off to jail, where they must think of a way to prove their innocence and avoid the brutal guards while battling their biggest enemies -- their opposing personalities.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Kevin Hart returns to his comedy roots in Philadelphia, visiting his first stand-up club; he introduces performances by Tu Rae Gordon, Anthony Moore, Lawrence Killebrew and Skeet Carter.

programme.title: Birmingham
programme.desc: When Kevin Hart and his crew check out the comedy scene in Birmingham, they introduce performances from Jermaine "FunnyMaine" Johnson, Rocky Dale Davis and Trey Mack.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Kevin Hart endures Phoenix's heat to host a comedy showcase featuring local stand-up comedians James 'JayMac' McCowan, Jill Kimmel, Bryan Ricci and Terrence DeLane.

programme.title: Seattle
programme.desc: Kevin Hart explores Seattle's comedy scene, meeting and showcasing local stand-up talents Kanisha Buss, Manny Martin, Bo Johnson and Ralph Porter.

programme.title: J-O-R-D-A-N Spells Funny
programme.desc: Jordan tries comedy as a way of overcoming stage fright; Vanessa makes a documentary about her home life.

programme.title: Make Room for Caddy
programme.desc: Despite Bernie's offer to buy him a car, Wanda's father cannot get along with him; showing when they all met.

programme.title: Saving Sergeant Tompkins
programme.desc: Bernie realizes he may have been too truthful when telling Jordan about his father; he amends the truth to make Jordan think well of his father.

programme.title: It's Mac-ademic
programme.desc: Bernie volunteers as a teacher's helper to assess the teaching methods used at Bryana's school; Wanda is at wits' end trying to reason with Vanessa and Jordan.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: The family goes to San Diego for a relaxing vacation; Bernie, unable to relax, goes to Las Vegas for some gambling and debauchery.

programme.title: Easy Rider

programme.title: Mac-Inations

programme.title: Who's That Lady?

programme.title: The Talk
programme.desc: Bernie stops by the Playboy Mansion to get advice from Hugh Hefner on how to talk to Jordan about sex.

programme.title: That Old Mac Magic
programme.desc: "American Idol" judges Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson critique Bernie's commercial.

programme.title: Five Stages of Bryana
programme.desc: Bernie and Wanda seek a child therapist's help in figuring out why Bryana has become a bully; Wanda winds up caring for a guinea pig Bernie bought for Bryana.

programme.title: Go Bernie, It's Your Birthday
programme.desc: On Bernie's 40th birthday, he is electrically shocked by an old lady and forced to be a clown at a children's party.

programme.title: Thanksgiving

programme.title: Big Brother

As the friends look forward to new horizons after high school, they face challenges on and off the rink that bring about turning points in their lives.

programme.title: Altar Call
programme.desc: Omar finally attends church and gives a powerful testimony that shocks everyone; Keith vulnerably professes his feelings for Jackee through poetry; Jarvis learns some truths that change everything he thought he knew about his family history.

programme.title: Warm Welcome
programme.desc: Omar learns some shocking information about Bianca; Greg gets out-hustled by an unwanted house guest; Keith notices his neighborhood is changing and blames his local councilman; Jarvis visits the man who claims to be his father.

programme.title: Who's Who
programme.desc: Omar, Greg, Keith and Jarvis attend the Annual Quintessential Gentleman's mixer; Keith ruins the vibe when he confronts his local councilman over his rising rent.

programme.title: First Impressions
programme.desc: Omar witnesses Naomi out with another man; Greg sets a bad first impression when he meets with Chef Williams; Keith meets Jackee's parents for the first time.

programme.title: Family Feud
programme.desc: Greg makes himself a little too comfortable during date night at Jarvis' house; Jarvis confronts his parents about his past; Omar's late-night meeting with Bianca comes to an unexpected end.

programme.title: Common Ground
programme.desc: Keith and Booker try to come to an understanding; Omar reconnects with Naomi; Greg enlists the fellas' help on a plan to get Reggie out of his house for good; musical artist Patrick Paige performs.

programme.title: Self Care
programme.desc: Omar's first attempt at yoga doesn't go so well; Keith shows Jackee the contents of her father's developed photos; Jarvis gets his petty revenge on Antoinette while Omar, Greg and Keith attend Caleb's football game.

programme.title: Middle Man
programme.desc: Jarvis surprises the fellas with a token of appreciation for their friendship; Love is in the air as Booker and Sherrie go on a date while Keith takes his disapproval of their relationship too far.

programme.title: Uncommon Ground
programme.desc: Jarvis hangs out with his new family and realizes how much they don't have in common; Keith challenges Alan Garrett at the city council meeting while Omar's relationship with Eugene is tested after an encounter with a patron turns violent.

programme.title: Spaghetti Junction
programme.desc: Greg impresses Chef Williams with his newfound passion for the culinary arts; Omar visits Naomi at her job unannounced; Keith receives an unexpected letter while Jarvis gets caught in the middle of a family confrontation.

programme.title: Social Distance
programme.desc: Greg mentors a teenager through Big Brothers Big Sisters of America while Jarvis and Freddie Sr. play a card game; the group organizes an intervention for Omar, and Samoht performs as the musical guest.

programme.title: Brotherly Love
programme.desc: Omar, Greg, Keith and Jarvis Johnson have a guys' night out that doesn't go exactly as planned; they run into popular radio host Eugene Johnson.

programme.title: Opposites Attract
programme.desc: Lisa forces Jarvis to have a dinner date with their friends, Kevin and Karen; Omar, Greg and Keith hang out at a lounge where musical artist Emi Seacrest performs.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Omar, Greg and Jarvis attend Eugene Johnson's annual poker tournament; Keith goes salsa dancing with Bianca as he tries to figure out if it's a real date or not.

programme.title: The Lady
programme.desc: Omar learns the importance of mental health; Keith begins his search for a rental space for his dream photo gallery.

programme.title: Shaft
programme.desc: Crooked cops on the take -- small-time drug lords -- sleazy informers and sadistic rich kids ready to kill --- for police detective John Shaft, its just another night in the underbelly of New York City, another shift facing down cops and criminals who want him dead and a legal system that thrives on money, not justice.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Lincoln Jefferson, an Iraqi War veteran, working as a school janitor tries to mend his relationship with his son after a divorce. When his son is killed by a police officer found innocent, he takes matters into his own hands to seek justice.

programme.title: Mann's New Baby
programme.desc: The family becomes ill which leaves Daniel to take care of DJ's class assignment to care for an automated doll; Lorraine substitutes for Toni's class and almost costs Toni her job.

programme.title: Mann-datory Counseling
programme.desc: Daniel and Michael are forced to attend communication therapy; the kids fight for equal rights of their household chores.

programme.title: The Ex-Mann
programme.desc: Daniel's ex-wife, Michelle, comes to visit, and the family anxiously awaits her arrival; Michael's girlfriend has Daniel worried.

programme.title: The Mann Brothers
programme.desc: Daniel's brother, Lionel, visits and sibling rivalry takes over; Toni tries to improve the school's dress code.

programme.title: A Woman Much Admired
programme.desc: While investigating the death of the woman he once loved, Gillespie meets his daughter for the first time.

programme.title: Baby for Sale
programme.desc: A friend of Bubba's, fearing the loss of his adopted son, is coerced by the boy's biological father into committing a fatal armed robbery.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Gillespie and Tibbs meet legal resistance trying to protect a high-school teacher from a disturbed admirer.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Gillespie attempts to prove the innocence of a prostitute charged with murdering one of Sparta's wealthiest citizens.

programme.title: Ruda's Awakening
programme.desc: Virgil's Aunt Ruda observes the shooting of a black man who was resisting arrest, but her rage clouds her recollection of the incident.

programme.title: Unfinished Business
programme.desc: While in Los Angeles to testify in an organized-crime case, Bubba tries to protect a boy who is the state's key witness.

programme.title: Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: Rex doubles down on his love for Ella as she scrambles to buy back Greater Hope.

programme.title: Into the Lion's Den
programme.desc: Ella must play nice with Jabari in order to win the long game.

programme.title: Dark Will Come to Light
programme.desc: Rex does Ella's bidding.

programme.title: The House Always Wins
programme.desc: After Ella's successful casino opening, Rex reveals long-held secrets that could reverse her good fortune.

programme.title: Sit Down, Be Humble
programme.desc: Ella and Rex make a deal.

programme.title: Antwone Fisher
programme.desc: The touching story of a sailor (Derek Luke) who, prone to violent outbursts, is sent to a naval psychiatrist (Denzel Washington) for help. Refusing at first to open up, the young man eventually breaks down and reveals a horrific childhood. Through the guidance of his new doctor, he confronts his painful past and begins a quest to find the family he never knew.

programme.title: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The outbreak of war in Europe forces the US to review its readiness for war. Whilst the American Air Force recruits and trains, adapting to Germany's new battle tactics, the Empire of Japan creates bring about a global conflict with its surprise attack. Now at war in the east and the west, America's air power must start to push back the forces of aggression.

programme.title: The Pacific in Erruption
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. involvement in the the Pacific theater starting in 1933. It looks at Pearl Harbor, the Burma theater, the Battle of the Coral Sea, the Battle of Midway, the invasion of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, the dropping of the atomic bomb and the surrender of Japan. It also looks at the start of the Korean War.

programme.title: A Day in Vietnam
programme.desc: Army and Naval Forces in Vietnam.

programme.title: Lull Before the Storm: Between the Wars
programme.desc: Here's a front row seat to Japanese attack on Manchuria and the rise of Hitler and the Nazi Party. As the world was undergoing significant changes so was the military air power.

programme.title: Victory
programme.desc: Monash takes up the challenge of vigorous pursuit of the Germans and in one day advance 10 kilometres and takes two and a half thousand prisoners - one week later the war is over.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Makeev's team rescues Smereko from the chemical test site; he survived with a stolen protective mask and reports mass poisonings, including women and children. Zvonareva urges aerial destruction, but Nenarokov demands firmer proof. Shevchenko proposes a risky low pass over the warm-spring lake to drop scouts into the water without parachutes.

programme.title: Bonhoeffer Agent of Grace
programme.desc: The story of Dietrich Bonhoeffer, a German clergyman of great distinction, who actively opposed Hitler and the Nazis. His convictions cost him his life.

programme.title: The Cold War
programme.desc: The Cold War sheds a new light on the clandestine wars fought between the US and the Soviet Union. This documentary takes us across the world in the turbulent 50s, 60s and 70s: an era of spies, secrets and lies. Thanks to recently disclosed images and files from the CIA and Russia's KGB, and with access to rare archive footage, we reveal a clearer picture of what was happening behind the scenes.

programme.title: Theater Commanders
programme.desc: Outstanding military Naval leaders, soldiers, sailors, and marines are discussed and the Theater commanders of General Dwight D. Eisenhower are also discussed.

programme.title: Beachhead and Breakthrough
programme.desc: Eisenhower inspects the landing beaches and we see the 'Mulberry' harbors put in place along the Normandy beaches. Airfields are built and supplies are offloaded. V-1 rockets attack London. We see the Germans build V-2 rockets. Storms wreck a Mulberry harbor and damage the other. Cherbourg is taken but is wrecked by the Germans. The British and Canadians work to take Caen.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: 1944 - Ardennes' Battle/Battle of the Bulge
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Ardennes massif that will take place one of the bloodiest battles of the Second World War. A few days before Christmas, 500,000 Germans are preparing to stampede on the allied forces stationed in the sector. In the early hours of the assault on December 16th, 1944, the American forces are taken by surprise. Discover what actually happened in Ardennes in the winter 1944.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group North
programme.desc: As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany. He abandoned cooperation from western pals. By agreeing to share polish territory between the 3rd Reich and the Soviet Union after invasion, Hitler kept the Russians at bay on his eastern borders to devote attention to war with the west.

programme.title: Third Reich - Collaboration in the Vineyards
programme.desc: Legend holds that Nazi Germany pillaged France's vineyards, but historians reveal a more complex truth. Through archives, expert voices, and winemakers, this film uncovers profiteering, collaboration, and even wine alcohol sold for V2 rockets, while also highlighting those who resisted in the name of solidarity.

programme.title: One Demerit to Go
programme.desc: On the brink of failure, many give up but some fight twice as hard. Establishing a military academy in Munich, the Seventh Army trained non-commissioned officers. One of these students, Sgt. Leon Carroll had, to this point, received twenty demerits. He mobilized all his intelligence and leadership to complete his course avoiding the final demerit which would result in discharge.

programme.title: Victory at Last
programme.desc: The victories at Manila and Okinawa are discussed.

programme.title: Resolve
programme.desc: It is 1917 and the ANZACS are involved in the seminal battles of Bullecourt, Ypres, Messines and Menin Road.

programme.title: Atomic Test at the Bikini
programme.desc: No event in the history of cinema had ever been so thoroughly covered. Why so many cameras and equipment to film two atomic explosions just after the end of the Second World War ? Moreover, what's the relationship between atomic testing and the famous bathing suit?

programme.title: Resistance is Never Futile: April-June 1943
programme.desc: The Polish Jews of the Warsaw Ghetto rose up against their oppressors and although facing the horrors of the Nazi Concentration Camps, German army units were needed to deal with the situation. The French Resistance was also formed.

programme.title: Tentative Steps: July-September 1943
programme.desc: After success in North Africa the Allies returned to occupied Europe, first landing on Sicily before moving north into Italy under command of Montgomery, known fondly by his men as Monty. But as the Italians surrendered, the Germans occupied Rome.

programme.title: Invasion of Southern France
programme.desc: Invasion of Southern France by the 7th army and subsequent junction with the American 3rd army in northwest part of France.

programme.title: Caen Falls to the British
programme.desc: British artillery pounds German positions in northern France and troops advance through villages and care for civilians. Tanks clear mine fields. Part 2, American troops enter Cherbourg. The 6th Airborne Div. receives supplies by parachute from British planes. Gen. J.L. Collins accepts the surrender of German officers.

programme.title: The Allies Forge On
programme.desc: 'Independence Day in Europe - In France, Eisenhower observes General Bradley fire a giant howitzer signaling our artillery into a massed crescendo of fire. Following the landing battles in Normandy, the Canadians return to the thick of the fighting at Cariquet. So severe that some Canadian camera crew were killed. In their sector, the Yanks are blazing through the hedge rows with grenade guns.

programme.title: Helena Bonham Carter
programme.desc: Helena Bonham Carter's grandparents were unconventional war heroes. They didn't fight in battle, but saved many lives. Helena's maternal grandfather Eduardo Propper de Callejón, a Spanish diplomat who defied his government's orders, helped Jewish people escape the Holocaust. Helena's paternal grandmother Lady Violet Bonham Carter volunteered as an air raid warden and campaigned for women's rights.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The ultimate test of tank technology is the battlefield. American tanks form the sharp end of the sword in Desert Storm. The U.S. marine corp was still using the older M-60 tank, although with some modifications.

programme.title: Part 1 - The Invasion
programme.desc: The series begins with the German invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, a surprise attack that ignited the Second World War. This episode explores the swift and brutal tactics of Blitzkrieg, the political miscalculations of European leaders, and the failure of appeasement. Through rare footage and expert analysis, we witness how the seeds of global conflict were sown.

programme.title: The Graves
programme.desc: The armies of the Third Reich invaded the USSR on June 22, 1941. Mobile commandos, the Einsatzgruppen, were following their advance to Stalingrad with the mission of eliminating all Jews on the conquered territories.

programme.title: THE NAZI CONCENTRATION CAMPS
programme.desc: This film was made by the U.S. Army and directed by George Stevens. As the Allies reached Germany, General Eisenhower ordered George Stevens to film the concentration camps. The camps are filmed and survivors interviewed. This film was evidence at the Nuremberg Trials.

programme.title: Part 1 - The Invasion
programme.desc: The series begins with the German invasion of Poland on September 1, 1939, a surprise attack that ignited the Second World War. This episode explores the swift and brutal tactics of Blitzkrieg, the political miscalculations of European leaders, and the failure of appeasement. Through rare footage and expert analysis, we witness how the seeds of global conflict were sown.

programme.title: Terror of the World
programme.desc: Germany's 'revenge weapons'-V1 and V2 missiles-heralded a new kind of war. Jet and rocket planes came too late to help. In Japan, kamikaze pilots struck fear, but a single weapon changed everything: the A-Bomb. As WWII ended, the bomber had reshaped warfare-and opened the door to the nuclear age.

programme.title: War of Korea: On to the Yalu
programme.desc: This episode dramatically details the outbreak of the world's first jet war. On June 24, 1950, Communist North Korea invaded her sister to the south, forcing a war. Within days, America had F-80s knocking out Communist supply lines.

programme.title: 1944 - Hitler Youth Strike Back
programme.desc: June 6, 1944, at dawn, 156,000 men are preparing to disembark with five objectives of the Normandy coast. This is Operation Overlord. Among them, combatants which we often forget about their active participation in the liberation of Europe... These are the 15,000 Canadians of the 3rd Infantry Division. They must arrive on a beach five miles wide, code name: Juno.

programme.title: Infantry Firepower
programme.desc: Documentary looking at the weapons used by infantry soldiers in the Second World War. Includes such weapons as the mortar, the landmine, the bazooka and the hand grenade. The programme features graphics, animation, archive footage and interviews with expert Robin Clifton.

programme.title: Meeting the Soviet Challenge
programme.desc: The post WWII years were a technological boom period. Watch the history of rockets and missiles as the world's first guided missile is created during WWI. Witness the first operational jet bomber, the B-47 as it takes over from its predecessors.

programme.title: Invasion and Breakout
programme.desc: This episode chronicles the US bombing invasion of Germany. We will see the great engineering of our aircraft, carrying out their bombing mission with precision.

programme.title: The Battle of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The struggle to control the Atlantic and maintain the Allies supply chain in WWII.

programme.title: Vietnam Peace Negotiations
programme.desc: 27 January 1973. After five years of negotiations in Paris, the Americans and the Vietnamese made peace, in what had been a difficult process.

programme.title: Daily Bread
programme.desc: The most fundamental need of any society is a reliable food supply. During WW2, every combatant nation introduced some form of rationing - but that was only the start of the business of keeping the population fed.

programme.title: The Graves
programme.desc: The armies of the Third Reich invaded the USSR on June 22, 1941. Mobile commandos, the Einsatzgruppen, were following their advance to Stalingrad with the mission of eliminating all Jews on the conquered territories.

programme.title: THE NAZI CONCENTRATION CAMPS
programme.desc: This film was made by the U.S. Army and directed by George Stevens. As the Allies reached Germany, General Eisenhower ordered George Stevens to film the concentration camps. The camps are filmed and survivors interviewed. This film was evidence at the Nuremberg Trials.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The U-Boat War
programme.desc: Twenty years after Kaiser Wilhem's exile in 1919, the German navy, Kriegsmarine, had once again grown into a powerful weapon, nurtured this time by Hitler's Third Reich. By 1939, Germany was eager and ready to wipe out the stain in her naval history. They possessed a terrifying weapon to make sure Hitler's victory and vision was realized, especially over Great Britain. The U-Boat.

programme.title: Big Picture: Ranger Ready 1953 US Army Elite Airborne Light Infantry
programme.desc: 'For this issue of The Big Picture our camera crews have journeyed into the mountains of North Georgia and the swamps of Florida in order to bring the story of the U.S. Army Rangers to the television screens of America. The Rangers are a proud corps of elite combat-ready troops who undergo the most rugged training in the Army.

programme.title: The Iraq War
programme.desc: Precision airstrikes have become the big stick of international relations. When diplomacy fails and military action is chosen, the missile armed strike aircraft is at the center of combat. Many nations deploy advanced jet aircrafts and high-tech missiles, but only one has the broad range of technologies and forces to deploy such weapons on a global scale, the United States.

programme.title: Modern Warfare: The Iran-Iraq War
programme.desc: Iraqi troops stormed Iran in 1980, expecting an easy victory. The Iranians rallied however, using, their much-larger population, and were able to push the invaders out.

programme.title: Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The ultimate test of tank technology is the battlefield. American tanks form the sharp end of the sword in Desert Storm. The U.S. marine corp was still using the older M-60 tank, although with some modifications.

programme.title: New Challenges: October-December 1943
programme.desc: While Hitler faced frustrations on all fronts, and the Japanese were kept at bay by the Americans, despite heavy US casualties, the Allied leaders faced a new challenge. Although Churchill and Roosevelt had always been comfortable working together, the Russian leader Joseph Stalin had in the past been regarded more as a foe than a friend.

programme.title: Blueprint for Victory: January-March 1944
programme.desc: As winter gave way to spring the world watched and waited as the Allied forces prepared for Operation Overlord. Brave and daring, risking all, US General Dwight D Eisenhower took charge of the campaign to deliver the fight directly to Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: The Invasion of France
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: Keeping the Railways Open
programme.desc: French civilians and U.S. Army engineers repair and salvage railroad yards, bridges, and trains.

programme.title: Battle of Moscow
programme.desc: October 1941, Germany's Army Group Center is only some 25 km west of Moscow. The Russian winter, however, is only a few weeks away. With not enough soldiers or military equipment, the Soviet high command's only hope left is that the weather will save the capital. The battle ends in a bloody failure for the German Army, and it is forced to retreat.

programme.title: War's End
programme.desc: The Korean War - Brigadier General S.L.A. Marshall assesses the war and the effect it has had on training in today's army.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Year - Part II: The Downfall
programme.desc: In January 1945, the Soviet army discovered the existence of Auschwitz and then of more than a hundred concentration camps. The Allies progressed through Europe, leaving many victims of rape and summary executions behind, and finally conquered Berlin. On April 30, Hitler committed suicide: The war was finally over. But who won it?

programme.title: Big Picture: United Nations Forces Push the Chinese Back
programme.desc: Recapture of Suwon... The 25th Infantry Division's advance of Seoul... Attack on Hill 584. Captain Zimmerman interviews Lieutenant William Travis from New Jersey. Lieutenant Travis was with the Army's 1st Cavalry Division and for a time served with the Air Force as a Liaison Officer, spotting targets for the Air Force.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: The squadron prepares for a mission, mourns a fallen comrade, and faces chaos in the air. Inexperienced pilots break ranks, causing casualties. Personal relationships and inner struggles unfold amidst reprimands. The episode ends with consequences and regret.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Sir David reveals the legendary characters, audacious missions and makeshift methods of spying's early days, and uncovers the real heroes and heroines who were pivotal to Allied victory in World War I.

programme.title: Episode 1: The 1950s
programme.desc: On February 14th, 1950, a Convair B-36B plane crashed in northern British Colombia after jettisoning a Mark 4 nuclear bomb. This was the first such nuclear weapon loss in history. The Goldsboro B-52 crash was similar. Information newly declassified in 2013 showed that one of the bombs came very close to detonating which would have irreparably changed the North Carolina coastline.

programme.title: Fall of Berlin
programme.desc: A Russian Captain and a German paratrooper recall the struggle to conquer Berlin in 1945.

programme.title: Big Picture: Chinese Reds Enter the Korean War
programme.desc: In this The Big Picture we see American soldiers battling winter cold, as well as the Communist Chinese, in Korea. The film shows how soldiers saved thousands of lives with quick evacuations of wounded U.S. fighters in helicopters. Also included is a display of the finest weapons in the world -- the U.S. Army's.

programme.title: Hell is on Us
programme.desc: After starting on the second front, the Allies broke out of Normandy and launch the Red Army. In the East, the invasion of the Philippines will bring the Allies one step closer to the home islands.

programme.title: Battle On Two Continents
programme.desc: We've seen the main action of the fighting in Belgium, Battle of the Bulge, and the decisive event of the winter campaign. We will sum up the entire battle ending in the allied victory and drive into German as Hitler underestimated America's leaders.

programme.title: Nuclear Weapons
programme.desc: Since the end of World War II, when the United States dropped the A-bomb on Japan, and the advent of the Cold War, the threat of nuclear destruction has never seemed far away. Although in recent times attempts have been made to slow or even stop nuclear proliferation, countries such as North Korea, China and Pakistan have continued to develop and test their own missiles.

programme.title: WWI The War To End All Wars - Part 2: War In The East
programme.desc: Austrian invasion of Serbia in July 1914. It would grow to encompass a vast geography from the Baltic to the Black Sea, and from the Carpathian Mountains to the Caucasus.

programme.title: Battle of Moscow
programme.desc: October 1941, Germany's Army Group Center is only some 25 km west of Moscow. The Russian winter, however, is only a few weeks away. With not enough soldiers or military equipment, the Soviet high command's only hope left is that the weather will save the capital. The battle ends in a bloody failure for the German Army, and it is forced to retreat.

programme.title: War in Korea
programme.desc: After World War II, Korea is divided along the 38th Parallel. In the North, the Soviet Union influences a Communist government under Kim Il-sung. In the South, the United States shepherds a young Republic. The Korean peninsula is plunged into war when North Korea invades the South.

programme.title: Private Hitler's War
programme.desc: Why, at the height of the battle for France in 1940, was Hitler driven to step aside from the battle to visit the graves of his fallen comrades and lead the General Staff on a tour of his old trenches from the Great War? This powerful film study proves comprehensively that, contrary to popular myth, Hitler was not a cowardly malingerer and oddball loner. He in fact served with distinction.

programme.title: Convoys to Hell
programme.desc: Allied convoys resupplying the Soviet Union had to navigate the Arctic, infested with U-boats and enemy aircraft. In summer, dense fog obscured ships despite 24-hour daylight, while in winter, freezing temperatures, ice-covered decks, and permanent darkness made the journey perilous. Veterans recall the constant threat of submarines or icebergs, knowing an attack almost guaranteed death.

programme.title: The War Against Japan
programme.desc: The war in Europe is over. However, in the Pacific East, the United States is still fighting the Japanese, who consider surrender the greatest humiliation for a soldier. Stalin promises to help Roosevelt, but the dropping of the Atomic bomb on Japan suddenly alters the calculus for the Allies. Despite the devastation, the Japanese military vows to fight on.

programme.title: Jungle & City fighting, Sea Battles, Invasions, Advances & Retreats
programme.desc: A war that reached every continent and touched every sort of terrain demanded a wide variety of strategies and tactics: Dunkirk, Malaya, The River Plate, Operation Market Garden, Syria and The Battle Of Berlin.

programme.desc: Teams answer questions to earn time and advantages over their competitors before going on a supermarket shopping spree; the team that adds the most valuable items to its cart wins.
