programme.title: Somewhere Over the Rainbow
programme.desc: Beryl and Harry face a race against time to get married before war breaks out.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Lucie Manette travels to pre-revolutionary France to find her father she assumed was dead.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Lucie appears to vouch for French emigre Charles Darnay, who is charged with high treason.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Darney is acquitted and Mr Stryver tells Carton of his intentions regarding Lucie Manette.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Carton reveals his true feelings to Lucie, and Barsad, makes an unwelcome reappearance.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: In London, Dr Manette suffers a relapse while, in Paris the Bastille is stormed.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: On receipt of Gabelle's letter Darnay returns to Paris during the Reign of Terror.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Darnay is released from prison thanks to Dr Manette's influence.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: The day of Darnay's execution arrives and with Barsard's assistance, Carton visits him.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Denise struggles with her new job at The Paradise and catches the eye of its suave owner.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Moray welcomes his dazzling Parisian friend to The Paradise, rousing jealousy from Denise.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Spirits are high at the Paradise in anticipation of the annual staff outing.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Miss Audrey develops a mysterious illness which starts a rivalry between Denise and Clara.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Moray's neighbor fulfills his ambition to work at The Paradise.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Denise cannot hold onto her secret any longer but will it spell the end of her career?

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: A renowned photographer visits The Paradise and his portraits reveal extraordinary things.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Moray has a big decision to make. Can he find the courage when he needs it most?

programme.desc: Elizabeth receives an astounding piece of news and Jane's sweet nature is put to the test.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Rejected by Elizabeth, Darcy returns to Rosings Park and writes to her.

programme.title: Sin dinero
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano se dan cuenta de que se han gastado todo su dinero. Ahora tienen que pedirle comida prestada a sus vecinos para poder sobrevivir.

programme.title: El papá de la nena
programme.desc: Los López preparan una fiesta sorpresa para La Nena. Carlos, el papá de La Nena reaparece inesperadamente y le cuenta cómo ha sido su vida.

programme.title: Martina y Ricky
programme.desc: Martina tiene su primer novio, pero las cosas se salen de control cuando se inventa una vida que no tiene y a su vez, él también tiene un secreto que no se imaginan.

programme.title: Cambio de cuerpos
programme.desc: Al tratar de arreglar la antena de la televisión, un rayo cae sobre los López, provocando que todos cambien de personalidad. Renata le pide ayuda a una curandera y Plácido descubre que todo era un sueño.

programme.title: Cambio de hábitos
programme.desc: A Renata se le ocurre desintoxicar a su familia, así que les informa que cambiarán sus hábitos alimenticios. Don Arnoldo escucha que La Nena ya tiene novio y aprovecha para chantajearla con comida.

programme.title: Los chiles de la discordia
programme.desc: Carmelo queda encerrado probando la alarma del negocio. María sueña que debe ganarse el corazón de Doña Lucha para conquistar a Albertano, y para eso prepara unos deliciosos chiles, aunque esto despierta un sentimiento de competencia.

programme.title: San Chambelán
programme.desc: María quiere celebrar su fiesta de quince años, pero para eso utiliza dinero que no es suyo. Doña Lucha entrena al Chino para ser chambelán. Albertano se ofrece a ser el chambelán de María.

programme.title: La Navidad perfecta
programme.desc: Ludovico sufre un infarto y muere. Santa Ninel le pide cambiar su forma de ser para antes de Navidad si no quiere morir. Ludovico hace todo por cambiar con su familia.

programme.title: Recuerdos
programme.desc: Ludovico habla de su familia: cuando conoció a Federica, cuando se enteró de que iba a ser padre y de otros graciosos momentos que han marcado su vida.

programme.title: Hijo de tigre pintito
programme.desc: Paco recibe la visita de una ex quien le deja una bendición del pasado: se trata de Lucas, un hijo que él no sabía que tenía y que se queda a vivir en su casa a pesar de las protestas de Rocío.

programme.title: El niño espurio
programme.desc: Después de que Toña hace cuentas, Rocío descubre que Lucas es producto de una infidelidad porque aún andaba con Paco, así que le pide una prueba de paternidad para verificar que son padre e hijo.

programme.title: Fantasmas del más acá
programme.desc: Los vecinos están molestos por escuchar ruidos en el edificio y creen que existe un fantasma. Silvia visita al Doctor Cupido y le dará opciones para que encuentre una pareja.

programme.title: Video descompuesta
programme.desc: Frankie le vende una videocasetera a Luis, pero Lorena le recuerda a Frankie que tiene atorado un vídeo muy vergonzoso de ellos; Germán intenta ayudar a Benito para que se le caiga un diente.

programme.title: Welcome to ELEI
programme.desc: Los héroes llegan a Los Ángeles y piensan que su presentación va a ser en el estadio de los Dodgers. En realidad, son los invitados especiales del aniversario del mercado de East LA.

programme.title: Sin dinero
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano se dan cuenta de que se han gastado todo su dinero. Ahora tienen que pedirle comida prestada a sus vecinos para poder sobrevivir.

programme.title: La boda de mi mejor amigo
programme.desc: Vítor ha encontrado a la mujer de su vida y decide casarse con ella, pero Albertano hace todo por impedir esa boda, tras descubrir que ella es una peligrosa criminal.

programme.title: Un mundo nos vigila
programme.desc: Los Héroes tienen que regresar por carretera a México. En el camino les roban la camioneta y los dejan tirados en el desierto donde son secuestrados por extraterrestres.

programme.title: La novia fea
programme.desc: Vítor y Albertano tienen que alquilar su departamento para obtener dinero, pero no es suficiente para continuar con su estilo de vida. Vítor trata de convencer a Albertano de que se haga novio de Bertha, una chica fea, pero multimillonaria.

programme.title: Buscando casa
programme.desc: El Vítor lleva a su mamá a la central camionera porque se va a regresar a su pueblo. Albertano y el Vítor se conocen cuando van a ver un cuarto en renta y se pelean por él, pero Rosita, una de las inquilinas, les aconseja compartir la habitación.

programme.title: Los cinco puntos
programme.desc: Plácido sigue las recomendaciones de las cinco cosas que un padre debe enseñarle a su vástago para que llegue hacer un gran hijo.

programme.title: El secreto
programme.desc: Martina escucha que La Nena tiene novio y la chantajea con decirle a la familia si no obedece sus órdenes. Cansada de los abusos decide hablar con la familia.

programme.title: El novio
programme.desc: Lichita lleva semanas sin hablarle a la Nena porque tiene novio y le exige que termine su relación. Renata propone que hagan una comida para que puedan conocer al novio de la Nena.

programme.title: Prueba de embarazo
programme.desc: Nena averigua que ella está embarazada.

programme.title: Sostengo el pi
programme.desc: La euforia por el feng shui y por limpiar desata un conflicto entre familias. Doña Lucha y María intentan controlar a todos con el feng shui, y organizan un concurso.

programme.title: Ofertín y los vinagres balsámicos
programme.desc: En su búsqueda por trabajo, Albertano es contratado por María de todos los Ángeles, pero sucede una tragedia que Rosa Aurora tendrá que arreglar.

programme.title: La sirvienta
programme.desc: Federica convence a Ludovico de que le contrate una sirvienta. Federica se quiere contratar a una mujer conservadora y gruñona, mientras que Ludovico pretende quedarse con una mujer de buen cuerpo aunque algo torpe.

programme.title: El cumpleaños de Ludoviquito
programme.desc: Ludovico y Federica descubren que Martina y Fabio tienen una fiesta y se ofenden por no haberlos invitado. Federica y Ludovico interrumpen la cena de Martina y Fabio con sus nuevos amigos.

programme.title: Amor de secundaria
programme.desc: Paco consigue a un mudancero para llevarse las cosas de Rocío y casualmente se trata de Ismael, un exnovio de la Toña que, al reencontrarse con ella, reaviva la llama de la pasión y pone en riesgo su matrimonio.

programme.title: La deportada
programme.desc: Una amiga extranjera de Fran llega a pasar unos días al departamento, pero descubren que fue deportada de Estados Unidos. Sin embargo, crea una relación muy estrecha con Lucas.

programme.title: Un nuevo casting
programme.desc: Germán le pide a los vecinos que le den un aumento de sueldo, pero se lo niegan y decide renunciar. Lorena y Frankie están decididos a hacer todo lo posible para que Benito consiga actuar en un comercial.

programme.title: Sesiones espiritistas

programme.desc: Dolida porque don Nacho olvidó su aniversario, doña Cuca inicia un romance con su exnovio el carnicero. Vítor y Albertano ayudan a don Nacho a recuperar el amor de doña Cuca.

programme.desc: Cuando su contrato con doña Olegaria está a punto de terminar, aparece Roger de los Santos, empresario que les propone manejarlos. A los héroes les encanta la idea, pero no quieren traicionar a doña Olegaria.

programme.title: Presuntos culpables
programme.desc: Doña Olegaria no puede competir contra Roger, así que se dividen la representación. La banda tiene una fecha en LA, pero ninguno de ellos puede entrar a EE.UU.

programme.title: Un héroe chapín
programme.desc: Los héroes no puedan entrar a los Estados Unidos para su presentación en Los Ángeles. Así que tratan de arreglar su situación y, al hacerlo, se descubren detalles del pasado de los héroes que nadie se esperaba.

programme.title: Las travesuras del Chavo
programme.desc: Quico juega con sus amigos y hace que estos se sientan celosos cuando no les presta su globo. El Chavo se enfada porque no puede comprar un globo y termina pinchando el de sus amigos.

programme.title: El mozo revoltoso
programme.desc: El Mil Caras se fuga de la cárcel. Don Ramón se ofrece a pintar la vecindad a cambio de las rentas que debe, pero los niños provocarán un desastre jugando a los pintores.

programme.title: La enfermedad de la Chilindrina
programme.desc: La Chilindrina le hará una broma al Chavo. Los Caquitos son acusados de robar un bebé. Los niños le juegan una broma a Clotilde. Don Ramón tendrá que aguantar los berrinches de La Chilindrina, al no querer tomar su medicina.

programme.title: El sarampión
programme.desc: Chespirito, el Metichito, desenmascara sin querer a Shory frente a sus dos novias. Para evitar pagar el alquiler, don Ramón inventa que la Chilindrina tiene sarampión, pero por mentiroso, todos los inquilinos pagarán las consecuencias.

programme.desc: El más extraño de los fanáticos del balompié, se ve envuelto en muchos enredos a causa de su honestidad.

programme.title: Louisville: Bourbon and Burgoo

programme.title: St. Croix
programme.desc: Andrew visits St. Croix in the U.S. Virgin Islands, where he discovers a diverse cultural melting pot of food. Goat water soup; conch roti; breadfruit tostones.

programme.title: St. Louis
programme.desc: Brain sandwiches and crispy pig snouts; pig heart pastrami; dessert made with organ meats and caramel sauce.

programme.title: Houston
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern gets a taste of the vibrant city of Houston. From a tailgating feast featuring buffalo to a blast and cast that nets fresh duck organs and grilled redfish.

programme.title: New Jersey
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern finds out that some amazing things are growing in America's Garden State; dinuguan; Taylor pork roll.

programme.title: Pittsburgh
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern discovers that America's Steel City has a knack for blending old and new food traditions.

programme.title: Virginia
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern finds out that in Virginia, people aren't afraid to shake up tradition when it comes to food.

programme.title: Toronto
programme.desc: Andrew finds that Toronto is a melting pot of edgy eats; Horse heart salami; seal flipper pie; pig's ear.

programme.title: Cleveland: Beef Souse & Perch
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern makes some tasty new discoveries in Cleveland; pig head; kidney ramen; popcorn shoots.

programme.title: NYC Bizarre at All Hours
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern stays up all night in the city that never sleeps to uncover the secrets of feeding hungry New Yorkers.

programme.title: Minnesota State Fair
programme.desc: Andrew visits the Minnesota State Fair where bizarre food is the main attraction; Scandinavian delicacy lutefisk; deep-fried candy bars.

programme.title: San Francisco Bay
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern visits San Francisco's Bay Area; Cookies made with crickets; eggs made out of plants; lamb's head soup.

programme.title: Moose Fat & Muskrat
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern heads into the remote area of Chistochina in Alaska's Copper River Valley; Moose Head Soup.

programme.title: Box Crab and Bull Kelp
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern visits Vancouver; Box crab and bull kelp; blood sausage made with pig heads; a tuna cannery.

programme.title: Crane Meat and Pigeon Feet
programme.desc: Andrew visits the home of country, Nashville, Tennessee; Hot chicken, dry ribs and grilled Sandhill crane.

programme.title: Dallas: Red Meat/Rattlesnakes
programme.desc: Andrew visits Dallas, Texas; Cow head roasted underground; chicken feet and water bugs; goat meat stew.

programme.title: Jungle Rats and Reptiles
programme.desc: Andrew savors caiman and giant jungle rodents in exotic Columbia.

programme.title: Lima Peru: Frog Shakes
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern downs frog shakes, snails, and fried guinea pig in Lima.

programme.title: Monkfish Liver and Goat Heart
programme.desc: In Atlanta, Andrew feasts on calf brains, goat heart, and monkfish liver.

programme.title: Horse Conch and Hogfish
programme.desc: Hunting and cooking iguanas with a family; a fishing derby competition; Cuban cooking and cigar making.

programme.title: Belize
programme.desc: Andrew dives into blue waters to encounter sharks and stingrays, and explores a cave filled with skeletons during a trip to Belize.

programme.title: Kalahari
programme.desc: Andrew travels to Botswana, where a hunter-gatherer tribe teaches him how to live off the land and become one with their tightknit community.

programme.title: South Africa
programme.desc: Andrew finds old traditions in unexpected places while exploring urban South Africa, including Johannesburg and Cape Town.

programme.title: Germany

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Tony Curtis (6/21/78)
programme.desc: Movie star Tony Curtis discusses his steamy new novel about Hollywood and the mob. Also shows a clip from his first movie, at age 23, in which he played a rumba dancer.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jack Palance (5/10/91)
programme.desc: The ultimate Hollywood bad guy, Jack Palance chats with Johnny about his break-out role in Shane (1949). Palance also describes his current line of work -- running a cattle ranch.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Gregory Peck (8/3/77)
programme.desc: Hollywood leading man Gregory Peck dishes on WW2 hero General Douglas MacArthur, whom he played in the biopic, and the General's overlooked sense of humor.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Eli Wallach (9/1/77)
programme.desc: Remember The Thorn Birds? Meet Colleen McCullough, who wrote the blockbuster novel-turned-mini series. Lou Brock discusses his base-stealing record and acting legend Eli Wallach chats about his craft. Don Rickles plugs his show C.P.O. Sharkey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Peter O'Toole (1/13/78)
programme.desc: Screen star Peter O'Toole was Oscar nom'd 8 times! Never won. Finally bagged the golden statue for lifetime achievement. O'Toole discusses The Stunt Man. Comic Buddy Hackett brings some laughs.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Robert Mitchum (6/16/78)
programme.desc: The gorgeous and talented Ann-Margret says she disguises herself in a black wig when out in public. Screen legend Robert Mitchem reveals he did time on a chain gang, at age 15.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (12/10/81)
programme.desc: Hollywood heavyweights Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau regale Johnny with tales of making 5 movies together and one near-death stunt gone very wrong.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (3/23/82)
programme.desc: Stardom is bad for your health. Walter Matthau dons dark glasses to disguise an eye problem, jokes about his roommate in the hospital and the awful food.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Sean Connery (10/5/83)
programme.desc: Sean Connery gives a Bond trivia quiz, and recalls his scariest stunts. Comic Keenan Ivory Wayans says dating white girls is like being on Mutual of Omaha's Wild Kingdom; people can't stop staring.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Mickey Rooney (3/13/84)
programme.desc: Mickey Rooney compares notes with Johnny on their many marriages. Comic Paul Rodriguez riffs on Mexicans picking fruit and the fun of annoying white drivers on LA freeways.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Walter Matthau (7/22/86)
programme.desc: We're spelling tonight! Walter Matthau and Johnny quiz one another on difficult words. Matthau recalls filming Tunisia and shows a clip from his movie, Pirates.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (6/22/88)
programme.desc: Hog wild: That's Jay Leno who owns 17 motorcycles. Leno describes a chopper breakdown in LA with a busload of tourists cheering him on. Raquel Welch discusses her children and getting older.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dennis Hopper (8/15/91)
programme.desc: Not your typical leading man, Dennis Hopper talks about his unusual roles in Blue Velvet and Easy Rider, and his up and down career which began in his Kansas hometown.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Clint Eastwood (5/15/92)
programme.desc: Mr. "make-my-day" Clint Eastwood reminisces about Gunsmoke, Outlaw Josey Wales and Dirty Harry, while Bob Hope and David Letterman also appear.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Jane Fonda (10/6/77)
programme.desc: Activist and two-time Oscar winner Jane Fonda details her suit against the US government for invading her privacy. Also plugs her move, "Julia."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Dean Martin (12/12/75)
programme.desc: Star party guy, Dean Martin recounts the wild fun celebrating Frank Sinatra's big 6-0. Also fills in Johnny on playing Las Vegas and his frequent forays into the casinos.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Joey Bishop (2/24/76)
programme.desc: Brat packer & longtime TV personality Joey Bishop talks about his career, politics, how he gave up smoking and lost weight.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Raquel Welch (11/21/80)
programme.desc: The great actress and great beauty Raquel Welch chats about Presidents Reagan and Carter, her 2nd marriage, getting negative press and how she imagines her life in the year 2000.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (11/4/88)
programme.desc: James Garner shares the gruesome details of his recent bypass surgery and thanks well-wishers for the 9,000 get well cards he received. The operation has not, thankfully, hurt his golf game.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - Victor Buono (8/16/73)
programme.desc: The very funny Victor Buono drops in to talk about his recently released book of poetry, and to cut up with Johnny and Ed.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '60s - James Garner (9/13/91)
programme.desc: Actor James Garner stops by to talk about his latest television series, "Man Of The People," and discusses some one of the biggest clinkers of his career, his induction into the Television Hall Of Fame, and his fear of public speaking.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/14/72)
programme.desc: Watch a Tea Time movie with Carol Wayne. Plus Doris Day has a bad neck, Rodney Dangerfield performs and Burt Mustin discusses his first visit to Hollywood in 1925.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Diane Keaton (12/28/72)
programme.desc: Diane Keaton talks about Christmas in her childhood. Gene Hackman also appears.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Ricardo Montalban (8/1/73)
programme.desc: Remember Ricardo Montalban's "rich Corinthian leather?" The king of kitsch (Fantasy Island, 3 Planet of the Apes movies and Star Trek tv series and movie) reveals his obsession with bullfighting!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (10/2/73)
programme.desc: No one rocks a polyester leisure suit like sex god Burt Reynolds. Comic Buddy Hackett's orgasm-sneeze makes for really compelling TV. Master complainer Don Rickles rounds out the show.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (10/5/73)
programme.desc: Catch a rack of iconic rumpled raincoats worn by 4-time Emmy winner Peter Falk in his detective show Columbo. Dallas star Victoria Principal chats about quitting booze and cigarettes.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gene Hackman (3/21/74)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Gene Hackman shows a watery clip from ocean liner disaster flick Poseidon Adventure. Also on this episode is Diane Keaton

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Jim Henson (5/24/74)
programme.desc: Even celebs like Suzanne Pleshette go to the dentist and suffer with ordinary phobias. Of course, Jim Henson's Muppets are the exception; they have perfect teeth!

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (9/26/74)
programme.desc: Decked out in head-to-toe leather, Burt Reynolds shares a clip from The Longest Yard. Comic genius Dom DeLuise discusses his dog's issues and Honeymooners star Art Carney plays "September Song."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lilly Tomlin (2/20/75)
programme.desc: Lily Tomlin describes her Detroit childhood, creating a character by working a check-out counter and her career as a shoplifter.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Michael Caine (12/5/75)
programme.desc: Oscar clubbers Michael Caine and Sean Connery share a clip from their movie The Man who would be King. Connery announces he's retiring from James Bond movies and Caine says he's now a wine merchant.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (3/2/77)
programme.desc: Burt Reynolds shows his vacation videos and talks about moving in next door to Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/30/77)
programme.desc: Oscar winner Bruce Dern talks about getting his big break and his neighbor Robert Redford. Psychiatrist Sam Dunkell analyzes dreams and sleep positions. `

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Falk (5/20/77)
programme.desc: Columbo Star Peter Falk discusses the series' ties to the Mensa Society. Heavyweight champion and civil rights activist Muhammad Ali shows a clip from The Greatest.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Mark Hamill (11/29/77)
programme.desc: Luke Skywalker, a.k.a. Mark Hamill, chats about the making of the iconic movie Star Wars and working with the legendary Alec Guiness.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Cloris Leachman (2/1/78)
programme.desc: Who's racked up more Emmys than anyone except Julia Louis Dreyfuss and Carl Reiner? Cloris Leachman. She talks to Johnny about growing up in Des Moines and doing live TV.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Goldie Hawn (2/22/78)
programme.desc: The bikini'd star of Laugh-in and Oscar winner Goldie Hawn talks about giving birth. And what's the big deal with King Tut? Buck Henry, who created Get Smart and wrote The Graduate has some thoughts.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (3/2/78)
programme.desc: Even stars get stiffed. Ask Bruce Dern. Comedian Robert Klein reports on making a movie with Burt Reynolds, and Dr. Carl Sagan bashes Star Wars for strangling science.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (8/2/78)
programme.desc: Pin up guy Burt Reynolds grouses about look-a-likes who impersonate him at public functions. Susan Sarandon demos relaxation techniques and reads Johnny's palm.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (4/4/79)
programme.desc: Rat pack darling Angie Dickinson chats about self defense training. Johnny practices the Heimlich maneuver on her with coaching from its developer, Dr. Henry Heimlich.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (6/21/79)
programme.desc: Celebrities at the pump; Burt Reynolds talks about waiting his turn. He also fesses up to coveting an Oscar. Jimmy Carter's mom, Miss Lillian, admits she doesn't like sleeping at the White House.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bruce Dern (12/20/79)
programme.desc: Acting icon Bruce Dern talks about working with Ann-Margret on Middle Age Crazy, and David Letterman scores laughs describing his visit to a nude beach and his dog's love life.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (12/30/80)
programme.desc: Actress Angie Dickinson, who's made over 50 films, chats about New Year's Eve parties, New Year's resolutions, her first date and coping with depression.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Alan Alda (5/19/81)
programme.desc: M*A*S*H* star Alan Alda discusses his career and the impact of celebrity on his life. Comedian David Brenner riffs on health food, controlling his weight and eating in New York.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Bo Derek (7/24/81)
programme.desc: TV star Michael Landon gets sentimental over Bonanza; watching episodes dubbed in Japanese and promoting the show at county fairs. Actress Bo Derek talks about vine-swinging for Tarzan, the Ape Man.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (7/31/81)
programme.desc: Show biz veteran Angie Dickinson talks about men who whistle at women, Tommy Lasorda chats about losing weight, and Dom DeLuise dishes on doing an off-Broadway play with Barbra Streisand.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - John Travolta (8/6/81)
programme.desc: Actor/pilot John Travolta on flying lessons, dropping out of high school and getting his first part. Humorist Erma Bombeck complains that "housewives" on commercials don't look like housewives.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Burt Reynolds (2/11/82)
programme.desc: Heartthrob Burt Reynolds chats about his Cosmo centerfold and comedian Richard Lewis jokes about his dandruff, driving in LA and growing up in New Jersey.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Roger Moore (3/30/82)
programme.desc: With five Bond movies under his belt, Sir Roger Moore says he'll keep going. Having just won the Oscar for Reds, Maureen Stapleton wonders aloud how it will impact her career.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Jodie Foster (3/4/83)
programme.desc: Yale student and movie star Jodie Foster chats about college life, John Hinckley and working with Peter O'Toole. Tim Conway describes the brochure he asks his prospective dates to read.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Donald Sutherland (5/13/83)
programme.desc: Autograph hounds watch out: Donald Sutherland has a policy on handling signature seekers. Comic actor Martin Mull answers his fan mail and shows off his artwork.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Cloris Leachman (5/9/84)
programme.desc: Eight-time Emmy winner Cloris Leachman reveals her favorite prize --mother of the year -- awarded by a club in New York. 91year old Olympic athlete Abel Kivat discusses how he keeps in shape.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Miss Piggy (7/12/84)
programme.desc: The epitome of beauty and elegance, Miss Piggy extols the joys of learning French. Comedian Howie Mandel covers his seat with plastic because he says he wants to feel like he's at his mom's.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Fonda (1/4/85)
programme.desc: Actor/screenwriter Peter Fonda opens up about being compared to his father and sister. Charles Nelson Reilly recalls his dad pouring cheap bourbon into fancy bottles to hide their poverty.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Candice Bergen (3/21/85)
programme.desc: Soon-to-be star of Murphy Brown, Candice Bergen chats about her marriage and how rude the French are. Comic actor Tim Reid says he was fired from show for not being "black enough."

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Gary Busey (8/23/85)
programme.desc: Oscar nom'd for playing the title role in The Buddy Holly Story, Gary Busey has acted in over 150 movies. He talks about his early rocker days playing in a band at Disneyland and Knott's Berry Farm.

programme.title: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Angie Dickinson (1/2/86)

programme.title: Prince Avalanche
programme.desc: Two road-crew workers (Paul Rudd, Emile Hirsch) spend the summer of 1988 isolated and away from their city lives, eventually finding themselves at odds with each other and their women back home.

programme.title: Nobody Walks
programme.desc: A young woman's (Olivia Thirlby) arrival sparks a surge of energy into a laid-back, artistic Los Angeles household, forcing the residents to confront their own fears and desires in an intricate dance of lust, denial and deception.

programme.title: Main Street
programme.desc: A stranger (Colin Firth) becomes involved with the close-knit residents of a North Carolina town after he arrives with a controversial plan to save their crumbling community.

programme.title: Compliance
programme.desc: A fast-food worker (Dreama Walker) who's accused of theft is put through the wringer as her boss (Ann Dowd), at the direction of a phone caller who says he's a cop, subjects her to increasingly harsh forms of interrogation.
A man (Anthony Hopkins) searches for his missing daughter in one of several vignettes dealing with issues of love, loss and betrayal.

programme.title: Lucky
programme.desc: A 90-year-old atheist has outlived and out-smoked his contemporaries, and as he comes to terms with his own mortality, he searches for ever-elusive enlightenment.

programme.title: Then She Found Me
programme.desc: Life deals a few heavy blows to April (Helen Hunt), a 39-year-old schoolteacher. Though she is desperate for a baby, her husband (Matthew Broderick) has decided to end their brief marriage. April barely has a chance to recover from the shock, when Bernice (Bette Midler), a brassy and selfish TV personality, barges into her life, claiming to be her mother.

programme.title: Touchy Feely
programme.desc: A dentist (Josh Pais) gains the ability to heal his patients' physical pain while his sister (Rosemarie DeWitt), a massage therapist, develops an aversion to touching and being touched.

programme.title: Melancholia
programme.desc: As a planet hurtles toward a collision course with Earth, two sisters (Kirsten Dunst, Charlotte Gainsbourg) cope with the approaching doomsday in different ways.

programme.title: Goon
programme.desc: Though a misfit among his brainy family members, Massachusetts bouncer Doug Glatt has a knockout punch that lands him a spot on a minor-league Canadian hockey team.

programme.title: Tucker & Dale vs Evil
programme.desc: Two scruffy pals' (Tyler Labine, Alan Tudyk) backwoods vacation takes a bloody turn when ignorant college students mistake them for a pair of murderous hillbillies.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies
programme.desc: Although they're both dating other people, two co-workers (Olivia Wilde, Jake Johnson) hang out together in bars and try to ignore their mutual attraction.

programme.title: Life Partners
programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless
programme.desc: A janitor (Michael Caine) convinces a frustrated executive (Demi Moore) to help him steal gems from their employer, the London Diamond Corp.

programme.title: Detour
programme.desc: Harper (Tye Sheridan), a seemingly naive law student, obsesses over the idea that his shifty stepfather (Stephen Moyer) was involved in the devastating car crash that left his mother hospitalized and comatose. While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County
programme.desc: Aspiring doctor Peter Hadley (Jeremy Strong) gets the shock of his life when his hard-nosed father (Peter Bogdanovich) -- and medical-school professor -- fails him, invalidating his acceptance to an elite residency program. His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

programme.title: The Napa Boys
programme.desc: A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.

programme.title: Tapawingo
programme.desc: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

programme.title: Support the Girls
programme.desc: Lisa is the general manager of Double Whammies, a sports bar that features skimpily dressed waitresses. Always nurturing and protective of her staff, she soon faces one trying day that tests her optimism at every turn.

programme.title: The Great Buck Howard
programme.desc: Defying his father and dropping out of law school, aspiring writer Troy Gable looks for a way to gain some meaningful life experience. Troy gets that and more when he takes a job with Buck Howard, a vainglorious mentalist who hopes to reinvigorate his fading career by staging a big comeback.

programme.title: Permanent
programme.desc: Aurelie, 13, dreams about getting a perm so that she can finally fit in at her small-town Virginia school. Things soon go incredibly wrong when her clueless parents bring her to a beauty school to save a few bucks.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: En route to Canada with stolen casino loot, a thief (Olivia Wilde) separates from her brother (Eric Bana) and falls in with a boxer (Charlie Hunnam) who's on his way home for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: First Date
programme.desc: Conned into buying a shady '65 Chrysler, shy teen Mike's eagerly anticipated first date with the girl next door, Kelsey, implodes as he finds himself targeted by criminals, cops and a crazy cat lady. A night fueled by desire, bullets and burning rubber makes any other first date seem like a walk in the park.

programme.title: Tyrel
programme.desc: Tyler spirals out of control when he realizes he's the only black person attending a weekend birthday party in a secluded cabin.

programme.title: Frances Ferguson
programme.desc: A substitute teacher's crushing discontent drives her to an ill-advised transgression.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: During the course of an ordinary week in Hollywood, movie producer Ben must navigate his way through shark-infested waters as he struggles to complete his latest projects. A demanding studio boss demands extensive changes to a movie starring Sean Penn, while another chief won't greenlight a project unless star Bruce Willis shaves his beard. Meanwhile, Ben tries to reconcile with his wife and maintain a relationship with his young daughter.

programme.title: Take This Waltz
programme.desc: A young woman (Michelle Williams) is torn between the husband (Seth Rogen) that she loves and a new man (Luke Kirby) in her life, whom she's unable to ignore.

programme.title: Infinity Baby
programme.desc: A man works for a company called Infinity Baby, which is tasked with farming out 3-month-old babies who don't age.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: An alcoholic, disabled novelist finds his muse again after he moves into a lakeside cabin and meets a single mother and her daughters.
