programme.title: Smooth Operators
programme.desc: Jessica poses as a wealthy patient to probe the murder of a vagabond identified as the hospital's accountant.

programme.title: Fire Burn, Cauldron Bubble
programme.desc: Jessica investigates a murder which coincides with Doc Hazlitt's sighting of a 17th-century witch.

programme.title: From Russia, with Blood
programme.desc: Jessica is detained and accused of espionage while attending an international writers conference in Moscow.

programme.title: Alma Murder
programme.desc: A former sorority sister asks Jessica's help in clearing the name of a respected college professor who has confessed to murder.

programme.title: Truck Stop
programme.desc: Jessica encounters murder when car trouble strands her and a fellow writer at a run-down truck stop owned by a disillusioned woman.

programme.title: The Sins of Castle Cove
programme.desc: Jessica's former student publishes a tell-all novel with characters resembling Cabot Cove residents, but when a murder occurs that follows the book's plot, Jessica gets involved.

programme.title: Trevor Hudson's Legacy
programme.desc: Jessica must find the truth when murder befalls a young writer she had recommended editing a dead author's last novel.

programme.title: Double Exposure
programme.desc: In Boston Jessica calls on private detective Harry McGraw after running into an old friend who denies knowing her.

programme.title: Three Strikes, You're Out
programme.desc: Jessica investigates when her the friend (Tim Dunigan) of her nephew (Todd Bryant) is accused of murdering a female sportscaster.

programme.title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall
programme.desc: A jealous mystery-writer (Jean Simmons) creates havoc for Jessica when her own publisher tells her that her work is slipping.

programme.title: Mirror, Mirror, on the Wall, Part 2 of 2
programme.desc: Eudora admits she stole Jessica's notes, but denies poisoning the apples she brought or murdering the detective who was following her.

programme.title: Appointment in Athens
programme.desc: Jessica becomes involved in a dangerous espionage case in Athens, Greece, after a chance encounter in Paris with British agent Michael Hagarty.

programme.title: Seal of the Confessional
programme.desc: A parishioner confesses murder to a pastor, who cannot divulge the truth when an innocent man is accused.

programme.title: The Grand Old Lady
programme.desc: The death of a venerable female mystery writer takes Jessica back to a 1947 murder aboard the Queen Mary.

programme.title: The Error of Her Ways
programme.desc: Jessica can't make sense of clues surrounding a real-estate developer's murder and his wife's suicide.

programme.title: Jack and Bill
programme.desc: Jessica's friend's (Ken Howard) dog-sitting assignment turns to mystery when the canine's owner doesn't return.

programme.title: Dead Letter
programme.desc: An unsent letter turns up in an old bureau bought at a rummage sale the same day arson occurs in a furniture store; are these events connected?

programme.title: Night of the Tarantula
programme.desc: While visiting a friend in Jamaica, Jessica encounters voodoo and black magic when a family celebration is marred by murder.

programme.title: When the Fat Lady Sings
programme.desc: Jessica becomes involved in a double-murder investigation when she attends an opera opening with old friend Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) in San Francisco.

programme.title: Test of Wills
programme.desc: Jessica spends the weekend on a remote island with a tycoon (Gene Barry) who thinks his life is in danger.

programme.title: Class Act
programme.desc: Jessica's friend, a top-flight homicide detective (Barry Newman), investigates the cover-up of a young woman's murder.

programme.title: Town Father
programme.desc: Jessica may be forced into public office when a woman arrives in town claiming Cabot Cove's bachelor mayor is the father of her five children.

programme.title: Good-bye Charlie
programme.desc: The questionable identity of a body found by a railroad track leads to murder and becomes the inspiration for Jessica's latest novel.

programme.title: If the Shoe Fits
programme.desc: Jessica befriends a Cabot Cove newcomer who is a murder suspect.

programme.title: How to Make a Killing Without Really Trying
programme.desc: Jessica enters the world of high finance when she attempts to solve the murder of her stockbroker, a partner in a prestigious Wall Street firm.

programme.title: Fixer Upper
programme.desc: Jessica's niece (Genie Francis) is a suspect in the murder of a real-estate client, a rich movie heiress in Beverly Hills.

programme.title: The Big Show of 1965
programme.desc: Jessica attends a variety-show reunion to research the 25-year-old unsolved murder of TV host Richie King (Kim Strauss), and while she's investigating, a show writer (Gavin MacLeod) is shot backstage.

programme.title: Murder -- According to Maggie
programme.desc: One of Jessica's former students, a scriptwriter for a TV show, must find the killer of a network executive or look for another job.

programme.title: O'Malley's Luck
programme.desc: Jessica's old friend, NYPD Detective Lt. O'Malley (Pat Hingle), investigates the suspicious suicide of a wealthy New York developer's wife.

programme.title: Always a Thief
programme.desc: Jessica's old friend, former jewel thief turned insurance agent Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell), becomes involved in a high-society murder.

programme.title: Shear Madness
programme.desc: While Jessica is in Texas to attend her cousin Ann's wedding, the bridegroom is murdered, as was Ann's first fiancé 15 years earlier.

programme.title: The Szechuan Dragon
programme.desc: Jessica's nephew and his wife enjoy house sitting in Cabot Cove until they discover the body of a peg-legged murder victim on the living room floor.

programme.title: The Sicilian Encounter
programme.desc: Michael Hagarty (Len Cariou) falls for a widow (Deidre Hall) whose volatile brothers-in-law pose a threat.

programme.title: Trials & Tribulations
programme.desc: Jessica is accused of false testimony and bribery in the death of an escaping murderer, and the man's daughter (Carrie Hamilton) takes Jessica to court.

programme.title: Deadly Misunderstanding
programme.desc: When Jessica suffers a broken arm, she hires a typist to meet her deadline, but she must clear the woman of a murder charge.

programme.title: See You in Court, Baby
programme.desc: Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) tries to clear a man of charges he murdered an unscrupulous divorce attorney.

programme.title: Hannigan's Wake
programme.desc: Jessica reopens a 16-year-old murder case at the urging of a dying author (Van Johnson) who felt injustice was done.

programme.title: Family Jewels
programme.desc: Jessica attends a political fundraiser with her friend Drew (Mike Farrell), but the focus turns to murder when another guest's chauffeur is murdered.

programme.title: A Body to Die For
programme.desc: A physical-fitness instructor (Jason Beghe) who has captivated Cabot Cove's female population is linked to the murder of a con artist.

programme.title: The Return of Preston Giles
programme.desc: Jessica's first publisher (Arthur Hill), imprisoned for murder, is paroled and requires her help when he is suspected of a similar crime.

programme.title: The Great Twain Robbery
programme.desc: Jessica's friend Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) is called to investigate when a purported Mark Twain manuscript leads to murder.

programme.title: Ballad for a Blue Lady
programme.desc: Jessica becomes enmeshed in feuds, infidelity and murder in Nashville when visiting her friend, blues singer Patti Sue Diamond (Florence Henderson), whose country-singer husband, Bobby (Jimmy Dean) is having trouble with his manager.

programme.title: Murder in F Sharp
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton confronts murder and arson while on a case involving a famous pianist (Ricardo Montalban).

programme.title: Family Doctor
programme.desc: Jessica and Seth inadvertently get entangled in a crime family's power struggle after a sniper attack in Boston wounds a mob boss.

programme.title: Suspicion of Murder
programme.desc: Dennis Stanton (Keith Michell) investigates when he is accused of murdering his girlfriend's estranged husband.

programme.title: Moving Violation
programme.desc: Sheriff Metzger (Ron Masak) defies political pressure and arrests an ambassador's son for murder, then is accused of the crime.

programme.title: Who Killed J.B. Fletcher?
programme.desc: A member of Jessica's fan club mysteriously dies while impersonating her to investigate cheating at a dog show.

programme.title: The Taxman Cometh
programme.desc: Jessica's old friend (Phyllis Newman) is accused of murder when $2 million in tax payments disappears and her ex-husband is found dead.

programme.title: From the Horse's Mouth
programme.desc: Jessica and detective Harry McGraw (Jerry Orbach) investigate the murder of a Thoroughbred owner whose prize horse has sired two unplanned foals.

programme.title: The Prodigal Father
programme.desc: The presumed-dead perpetrator (Donnelly Rhodes) of a 20-year-old bank robbery resurfaces, then is murdered.

programme.title: Where Have You Gone, Billy Boy?
programme.desc: Insurance investigator Dennis Stanton becomes involved in a murder case while delving into the disappearance of a shy ventriloquist's (Grant Shaud) dummy.

programme.title: Thursday's Child
programme.desc: Jessica is pulled into a murder investigation by a woman (Vera Miles) who claims Jessica's husband fathered her son.

programme.title: Murder, Plain and Simple
programme.desc: While traveling with her publisher's assistant in Amish country, Jessica's involvement in a traffic mishap leads her to a murder.

programme.title: Tainted Lady
programme.desc: Jessica comes to the aid of a small-town diner's owner (Dee Wallace Stone), who becomes an outcast when she is blamed for three arsenic poisoning deaths.

programme.title: The Skinny According to Nick Cullhane
programme.desc: A writer is murdered after sending Jessica a manuscript exposing a kidnapping scam, and Jessica's friend, private investigator Harry McGraw (Jerry Orbach) is caught near the body.

programme.title: Bite the Big Apple
programme.desc: Jessica takes a teaching position in New York, gets an apartment and finds its previous tenant murdered.

programme.title: Night Fears
programme.desc: A policeman-turned-professor challenges Jessica to solve a series of campus muggings that soon escalates to murder.

programme.title: Unauthorized Obituary
programme.desc: A friend (Bradford Dillman) is suspected of killing the author (Jessica Walter) who was writing an unauthorized biography of his wife.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Sheriff Metzger assumes his younger brother, the black sheep of the family, is guilty of murder, as charged.

programme.title: Lines of Excellence
programme.desc: New computer owner Jessica discovers hackers gathering information for blackmail, a crime that leads to murder.

programme.title: Judge Not
programme.desc: Jessica probes a 20-year-old unsolved murder after attending the funeral of a New Orleans jazz great.

programme.title: Terminal Connection
programme.desc: Jessica attempts to prove a battered wife innocent of killing her husband after failing to convince the woman to defend herself.

programme.title: A Killing in Vegas
programme.desc: Jessica tries to disprove charges against her friend's boyfriend, suspected of murdering a Las Vegas casino manager.

programme.title: The Committee
programme.desc: After Jessica speaks at an exclusive men's club, they ask her to investigate when one of their members is murdered, and they are all suspects.

programme.title: The List of Uri Lermentov
programme.desc: Jessica finds herself amid international espionage while attending a trade reception in Washington, D.C.

programme.title: Danse Diabolique
programme.desc: Jessica is convinced that a ballerina who died during her premiere performance in a new ballet was actually murdered.

programme.title: Second Chance
programme.desc: Meg's glamorous sister, Celia Rivers, arrives at Drovers Run. They have a falling out over their disparate lives and Celia heads into the bush in a huff and gets lost. The Drovers women, with Nick and Alex, set out in search of her.

programme.title: Call Me Kate
programme.desc: Jodi battles with what seems like the biggest decision of her life after her old friend Kate Manfredi arrives at the ranch. Tess hires Kate on a three-month probation period because they need all the help they can get at Drovers Run.

programme.title: Desperate and Dateless
programme.desc: Heading to the Bachelor and Spinsters' Ball, the girls from Drovers Run are ready for a big night out. On the way, they pass Dave at a roadside field and newcomer Kate is immediately smitten.

programme.title: Magnetic Attraction
programme.desc: When Stevie's 13-year-old daughter Rose arrives unannounced, life at Drovers Run is thrown into turmoil for everyone, and Stevie is faced with revealing the biggest secret of her life.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take
programme.desc: The weekend of Stevie and Alex's rodeo school has finally arrived and they are excited with the prospect of turning their fresh-faced students into rodeo stars.

programme.title: My Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Stevie and Kane meet under less-than-perfect circumstances when they are brought together by a minor car accident at the truck stop. Despite the awkwardness of their introduction, the charismatic Kane makes a huge impression on Stevie.

programme.title: Saturn Returns
programme.desc: Tess's birthday forces her to take a long, hard look at herself, but she "sees" more than she bargained for and unwittingly creates some midsummer night's madness. Sandra and Harry ask Nick to father a child for them.

programme.title: Friendly Fire
programme.desc: Kane's relationships with Stevie and Alex strains their friendship. They are each aiming for Kane's attention: Alex as a mate, Stevie as a lover; but they have no idea that Kane is using them both for his own advantage.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: Tess decides to turn traditional courtship on its head and ask Nick to marry her, but it doesn't take long for the rest of the household to find out what she has in mind. Then, Dave makes a discovery that threatens to derail the proposal permanently.

programme.title: For Love or Money
programme.desc: Vin Riley has come looking for Stevie and, more specifically, for the opals he believes are rightfully his. She decides to leave with Kane and the other women are stunned at her sudden decision. Stevie hasn't told them about Vin, so they can't help feeling hurt as she has chosen a life with Kane so quickly.

programme.title: Dangerous Waters
programme.desc: Feeling that she's been given an omen, Tess becomes increasingly afraid, for Nick, for Charlotte, even for the safety of the pregnant ewes, which she insists be brought in to the house paddock for lambing.

programme.title: Where There's Fire
programme.desc: Just as romance starts blossoming between Jodi and Luke, her position in the Country Fire Service is compromised when suspicion falls on Luke over a series of arson attacks.

programme.title: Trembling on the Brink
programme.desc: After an earth tremor, the cattle are skittish and the bore has dried up on Drovers Run. Tess worries that it is a sign before her wedding to Nick. In the interests of harmony and good omens, Tess decides to invite Sandra to her hens night, something that makes Sandra suspicious.

programme.title: This Moment Forward
programme.desc: Nick and Tess are due to approaching the altar at last, but the imminent arrival of Nick's mother, Liz, strikes a discordant note. Nick is happy to see his mother and Tess is happy to play along, but Liz still has a few bombshells to deliver along with the gift-wrapped knives.

programme.title: Something to Prove
programme.desc: Change is in the air on the outback cattle property of Drovers Run. While Tess and Nick enjoy their honeymoon in Fiji, Stevie becomes intent on proving that she can run the property on her own.

programme.title: My House is Your House
programme.desc: The Drovers girls have a tough time adjusting to Nick as the new "Man of the House," forcing Tess to set out some boundaries in an attempt to keep things running in an orderly manner.

programme.title: A McLeod Daughter
programme.desc: Ghosts of the past are awakened when Jasmine McLeod arrives in the district with the intention of scattering her father's ashes on Drovers Run. Tess is thrown when Nick asks her to update her will.

programme.title: The Things We Do For Love
programme.desc: Tess is thrilled to have her cousin to stay but soon discovers that Jaz is haunted by the death of her fiancé Mark. Mark was killed in a riding accident at an equestrian event where Jaz was a star on the rise.

programme.title: Love Interrupted
programme.desc: Sally Clements, Nick's ex-girlfriend, arrives at Drovers Run with news that is hard to conceal. She is heavily pregnant with Nick's child, conceived during the brief time when Nick was estranged from Tess.

programme.title: Twice Bitten
programme.desc: Tensions are rife with Kane now living in the cottage with Stevie, and Sally staying in the big house with Nick and Tess. Despite Kane's attempts to get 'straight' work, Stevie's suspicions are aroused when she witnesses him talking to Ray, his old car contact.

programme.title: No Man's Land
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison.

programme.title: Little White Lies
programme.desc: All the women of Drovers Run plan take on the big boys of the sheep industry at the annual Wool Board Expo, and Tess especially has thrown herself into various preparations to keep her mind off Sally and baby Harrison

programme.title: Rules of Disengagement
programme.desc: Meg heads home early from the city in hopes she can be of some comfort to Tess during her time out with Nick. But Meg has little success getting Tess to open up.

programme.title: Once Were Heroes
programme.desc: The stubborn side of Dave is exposed when he finds an injured horse and believes he has found a descendent, a Waler, of the first settlement horses. Meanwhile, Jodi's life is in a downward spiral as her continued absences from work force Stevie to fire her, and her personal life takes a hit too.

programme.title: Return of the Black Queen
programme.desc: Harry is secretly thrilled when he hears Sandra is back in town, however, their initial meeting doesn't go well when they aren't capable of confessing their love.

programme.title: Do You Read Me...?
programme.desc: Incapacitated by an injured foot, a bored Stevie has become addicted to the two-way radio, which causes her to get involved in with a mystery man. Meanwhile, Sandra offers Kate a farm manager's job.

programme.title: Taking Care of Business
programme.desc: The women of Drovers Run are no longer a team of four. Kate is now working with Sandra as an overseer at Kinsella's. Jodi has gone into business for herself, selling cosmetics, and the work is tough.

programme.title: Old Flames
programme.desc: When Kate organises a reunion of the high school hiking club, she isn't prepared for the old feelings it's about to stir up. For Jodi, the reunion is fraught with tension as she faces her old rival, Natalie, and she ends up introducing Luke as the local mechanic, rather than as her boyfriend.

programme.title: Body Blows
programme.desc: When Harry suffers a stroke, he reconsiders his plans for Killarney and he makes it clear that he favours Nick over Alex.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: Nick discovers that Harry's heart condition could be quite serious and he goes into denial. Helping Tess with the hay, he works recklessly and has a frightful accident with the hay bales.

programme.title: Boy Made Good
programme.desc: Will Hamilton, an old boyfriend from Stevie's school days in Broken Hill shows up at Drovers Run. He is also the father of Rose, a daughter he has no idea exists. Will is at first shocked to learn he is a father but delights Stevie by wanting to know all about their daughter.

programme.title: The Pearl
programme.desc: In trouble again, Luke promises a concerned Jodi that he will extricate himself from the criminal's grasp, but his problems only escalate. Stevie urges Jodi to distance herself from Luke, but Jodi needs to give him one final chance. She rushes to the truck stop and is shattered to discover drugs hidden in Luke's wardrobe.

programme.title: The Prodigal Daughter
programme.desc: Tess's other cousin, Regan, visits Drovers Run and causes a few problems. Ultimately, Stevie must rely on Regan's help to escape a life-threatening farm accident and Regan must face her fears to save Stevie.

programme.title: Love and Obsession
programme.desc: Dave and Regan's flirtation steps up a level when Dave offers to help cure her of her animal phobia. As they fall for each other, Kate realises Regan has a secret she'll do anything to protect.

programme.title: One Long, Long Day
programme.desc: Tess learns Nick has been offered a job in Argentina and she makes the difficult decision that they will go overseas for six months. Meanwhile, Stevie takes care of Charlotte for the afternoon, but when the child goes missing, she turns Drovers Run upside down to find her. As Dave and Regan's romance blossoms, Kate is devastated.

programme.title: Down to Earth
programme.desc: Things are in a state of flux, if not panic, with the imminent departure of Tess and Nick. Stevie is now in charge, and she decides Kate and Jodi need to sort out who's going to take on her old overseer's job.

programme.title: Heart of Gold
programme.desc: When Regan starts the process to mine Drovers Run, the other women put up a fight and vow to stop her.

programme.title: Taking Flight
programme.desc: Today is Harry's birthday and he's in a foul mood. Alex is stuck giving Sandra a lift to Gungellan so that she can get to an appointment. Kate tries to avoid Dave during a birdcall competition, but he makes it difficult.

programme.title: Make Believe
programme.desc: Kate's grandmother comes for a visit and Kate is in hot water because her grandmother believes that she's engaged to Dave and she runs Drovers Run.

programme.title: Heaven and Earth
programme.desc: Harry buys the truck stop and appoints Moira as manager, leaving Terry as a lowly mechanic. The approach of a raging dust storm adds to the troubles at Drovers Run and Stevie struggles to save the life of Tess's horse Oscar.

programme.title: Moonstruck
programme.desc: Stevie borrows a water pump but leaves without the right hose when she learns that Alex won't be taking her to the ball. The wrong hose causes a tank to fill with toxic gas, and Alex shows up to help, but he is overcome by the fumes.

programme.title: If You Build It...
programme.desc: Stevie locks horns with Sandra during a drought but later helps her through a personal crisis, which temporarily eases tensions between them.

programme.title: Out of Time
programme.desc: Stevie thrilled at the prospect of a visit from Rose but things sour when Stevie's sister Michelle arrives with her. Protective of her adopted daughter, Michelle doesn't want the usually rash Stevie to take matters into her own hands and tell Rose the truth about who her real mother is.

programme.title: Betwixt and Between
programme.desc: Caught off guard when Rose discovers a baby's hospital bracelet, Stevie tells a half-truth: she did have a baby, but she put it up for adoption. Rose finds out the whole truth and takes off in the ute, accidentally reversing into the cattle yard gates.

programme.title: Truth or Dare
programme.desc: Patrick, Dave's adventurer brother literally parachutes onto Drovers Run and ensnares Kate's heart. In the wake of Patrick's appearance, Dave must deal with painful memories and a shocking family secret that's been hidden for years.

programme.title: The King and I
programme.desc: Jodi is on top of the world when she receives a birthday gift from the deceased Jack McLeod. Meanwhile, Dave begins training a new veterinary student. Alex wants to get out of doing an interview for local radio, which Harry has delegated to him.

programme.title: Intentions
programme.desc: Dave is forced to question his behaviour when his former student, Catriona, threatens him with a sexual harassment suit. Meanwhile, after confronting Meg about Jack's gift to her, Jodi feels that her whole life has been a lie.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Meg agonises over Jodi's rejection of her, following the revelation that Jack McLeod is possibly her real father. Jodi reads her mother's novel, which is based on real life and details the mystery surrounding her birth.

programme.title: Twelve and A Half Hours Behind
programme.desc: When Tess returns home to Drovers Run, she discovers the exciting news that she's pregnant. Her joy is soon turned to grief, though, when a call comes from Argentina saying that the plane Nick was traveling on has been reported missing.

programme.title: Anniversary
programme.desc: Tess has been holed up in her room since the news of Nick's death, but she suddenly reappears, strong and composed. She throws herself back into work and declares she wants to hold a party to celebrate Nick's life.

programme.title: Body & Soul
programme.desc: Determined that the Ryan empire continues despite Nick's death, Harry quickly sets about organising his grandson's future, while Alex goes a.w.o.l after Nick's life celebration.

programme.title: New Beginnings
programme.desc: After a vivid dream, Stevie can no longer deny the love she has developed for Alex, but she struggles to tell him. Meanwhile, Harry pushes for his grandson to live near him, despite objections from Sandra, and Jodi gets the results of her DNA test

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: A week has passed since the fire and Alex's mysterious disappearance, but then he returns with his new fiancée and he unknowingly breaks Stevie's heart. Just when Tess is starting to get on top of things, she gets a call that sets her back: Nick's remains have been found.

programme.title: Truth Hurts
programme.desc: Alex and Fiona's engagement is publicly announced thanks to a meddling Harry. Meanwhile, a jealous Stevie, prompted by Dave, looks into Fiona's past and discovers something shocking. Meanwhile, Tess asks Jodi to move into the main house.

programme.title: Kiss of Death
programme.desc: Stevie is trying to deal with the fact that Alex may never be hers. She brings home a very young guy for the night, a move which ultimately endangers the land of Drovers Run. Meanwhile, Jodi comforts Rob and they are brought closer together when he reveals a secret.

programme.title: Luck Be A Lady
programme.desc: After the crop-dusting incident, Drovers has lost its contracts for organic produce and the women struggle to keep the bank from taking over. Trying to help, Stevie ends up gambling away Drover money.

programme.title: The Real McLeod
programme.desc: Jodi is stunned when Tess offers her half her share of Drovers Run. Tess feels that Jodi should have equity in the family heritage, as well as sharing their current debt. Leo, the pilot who dumped pesticide on Drovers Run, returns and tries to make Harry lift the black ban placed on him.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Kate falls and when Dave gives her a cursory examination, he notices a small sunspot on her back. After numerous attempts to convince her to see a doctor, Dave abducts Kate and drives her to the Gungellan GP.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: Nick returns home to Drovers Run but is troubled by shadowy flashbacks of Argentina and his mugging. Meanwhile, Kate secretly goes to see a cancer specialist in the city, but Jodi figures out that something is going on and follows her.

programme.title: Where The Heart Is
programme.desc: Nick is anxious to start up the cattle breeding program he never had the chance to realise in Argentina. Tess and Stevie move Phoenix to a safer paddock, but another visit from the Brumbies leads to the discovery that she is already pregnant, no doubt to the brumby stallion.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: Jodi risks her own life in an attempt to save Rob from the hitman that is hunting him, and with her courage, common sense and bushcraft, they survive the daylight risk. Meanwhile, Dave's brother Patrick returns with a truckload of "liberated" goats.

programme.title: The Big Commitment
programme.desc: When Patrick is blinded in a farming accident, he must rely on Kate for help. Stevie and Fiona take on a dodgy horse dealer, gaining a new-found respect for each other. Meanwhile, Meg and Terry adopt a new dream together.

programme.title: Biting the Bullet
programme.desc: When Regan returns to Drovers Run, she reveals a tragic secret. Though Tess has left, Jodi, Kate, and Stevie allow her to stay. Meanwhile, Fiona learns she is infertile but hides this information from Alex.

programme.title: Second Best
programme.desc: When Harry's stud ram is stolen, the Drovers Run women unmask an unlikely sheep rustler. Stevie ends up as Alex's backup best man in case Nick is not back from Argentina in time for the wedding.

programme.title: The Trouble With Harry
programme.desc: Jodi is driving back to Drovers Run when her phone rings. For a split second, she takes her eyes off the road and collides with a ute that Harry was driving. Meanwhile, the Japanese trade delegation visits to make an export deal with 'Gungellan Fresh'.

programme.title: The Legend of Harry Ryan
programme.desc: As he prepares for his father's funeral, Alex becomes obsessed with finding out why Harry had secreted away so many things. Stevie struggles to tell Alex that she argued with Harry on the day he died, and fears that it might have prompted the heart attack that killed him.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Kevin returns unexpectedly and Jodi tells him the news about her real father. He isn't too surprised, though, and Jodi is later devastated to find he was just trying to access her inheritance money.

programme.title: Secrets and Lies
programme.desc: The day before the big wedding has arrived and Stevie makes a shocking discovery that Fiona has been lying to Alex about being pregnant. Meanwhile, Kate decides to try on Fiona's dress and manages to stain it.

programme.title: Drama volume 1
programme.desc: A creator contemplates how he fits into the future. An astronaut faces infinite solitude. A boy finds peace in difference. A bear reveals hidden love. A girl transforms grief into wonder. Six films about what it means to be human.

programme.title: Sci-Fi volume 2
programme.desc: From plots to destroy earth to ominous conspiracies - four sci-fi films spanning Earth, Mars, and the cosmos, where every universe hides a secret.

programme.title: Sam Wasserman
programme.desc: BLVCKL!GHT AI sits down with filmmaker Sam Wasserman on Artist to Artist to dive into the future of cinema! Discover how Wasserman uses cutting-edge AI tools and agentic workflows to push creative boundaries and revolutionize storytelling.

programme.title: Episode One
programme.desc: Made On Fairground kicks off with a countdown of the ten top-performing titles on Fairground AI TV, then sits down for an exclusive interview with the filmmaker behind the film that claimed the No. 1 spot.

programme.title: Kelly Boesch Playlist Volume 1
programme.desc: A curated playlist of AI-created music videos by Kelly Boesch.

programme.title: Mike Mitch
programme.desc: BLVCKL!GHT AI welcomes Mike Mitch of Phantom X for a candid conversation about his latest work, the creative process behind it and where he sees AI filmmaking heading next.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Mary, a caretaker at The Drakewood Shelter, attempts to rescue a bat-like creature from an angry mob, a girl comes to Monster Town with a dangerous secret, and a man must venture into the sewers of Monster Town to save his sick daughter.

programme.title: Sci-Fi volume 3
programme.desc: Four stories that explore surreal landscapes where love rebuilds through broken geometries and impossible mathematics in a world of infinite truths.

programme.title: Mob Bosses
programme.desc: True Crime Stories: Mob Bosses chronicles history's ruthless kingpins from Prohibition to post-war America. These real figures built empires from blood and loyalty, shaping cities through power, silence, and brutal ambition. Every empire eventually falls.

programme.title: Volume 1
programme.desc: Explore a "Mysterious Planet" with Barnabas Deepcraft. From oceanic "financial advice" barnacles to 6,000,000-count stones and colonial superorganisms, discover surreal creatures thriving in bogs, clifftops, and thermal shelves.

programme.title: The Christmas Haunting
programme.desc: It may be Christmas, but Charlie is given no time to familiarise himself with his new surroundings. He finds himself thrown straight into an intriguing mystery in the village of Morton Shallows, as furniture maker and serial philanderer Conor Bridgeman is stabbed to death with an antique sword during a ghost-hunting party at the manor house.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: Barnaby and Nelson investigate a series of murders in Midsomer St Claire. The crimes appear to be inspired by the macabre images on a medieval fresco recently discovered in the church crypt.

programme.title: Wild Harvest
programme.desc: When wealthy farmer Martin Strickland is covered in truffle oil and mauled to death by a wild boar, the investigation leads to restaurant Wyvern House and its tyrannical celebrity chef Ruth Cameron.

programme.title: The Flying Club
programme.desc: The owner of Finchmere Airfield drops dead from a plane. Astonished, Barnaby and Nelson enter the world of stunt pilots and aviation heroes, and discover a web of lies and intrigue.

programme.title: The Killings of Copenhagen
programme.desc: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

programme.title: The Village That Rose from the Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer in the ghost village of Little Auburn.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

programme.title: Last Man Out
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

programme.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
programme.desc: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

programme.title: Death by Persuasion
programme.desc: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: The Curse of the Ninth
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter uncover multiple motives when the winner of a fought-after music award is found strangled with a violin string moments before a performance, including a rivalry over the prize and a missing Stradivarius.

programme.title: The Dark Rider
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones investigate when the appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths among an aristocratic family called the DeQuettevilles. Meanwhile, the family stage a Civil War re-enactment with their hostile neighbours and relive historic battles. Can the detectives uncover the truth about the DeQuettevilles and the ghostly rider in order to prevent more murders?

programme.title: Murder of Innocence
programme.desc: When convicted murderer Grady Felton returns to the village where he killed a boy years earlier, his arrival is met with anger from the locals. Soon afterwards, a barrister is killed in Midsomer and suspicion falls on Grady. Grady has a solid alibi, but Barnaby suspects that he is working with an accomplice - until Grady himself is targeted in an arson attack.

programme.title: Death and the Divas
programme.desc: The murder of a journalist has chilling echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomer's own Stella Harris. When Stella's more famous sister returns after a 40-year family rift, the killings escalate, each of them reminiscent of a movie plot - is life - and death - imitating art?

programme.title: Written in the Stars
programme.desc: As darkness covers Midsomer Stanton during a total eclipse of the sun, amateur astronomer Jeremy Harper is killed by a blow to the head with a meteorite. Barnaby and Jones soon discover intrigue, sexual tension and academic rivalry are rife among the star-seeking community.

programme.title: The Sicilian Defence
programme.desc: Harriet Farmer wakes up after being in a coma since the night she tried to elope. Harriet's boyfriend Finn Robson has been missing since the couple tried to run away together a year before. Then the president of the local chess society, Edward Stannington, is found dead in a lake with an ice pick in his back. His damaged car is nearby and Kate finds a clue in his mouth.

programme.title: Schooled in Murder
programme.desc: When a woman is crushed to death by a giant round of cheese at the home of the world-famous "Midsomer Blue", Barnaby and Jones are soon on the case. Debbie Moffett worked at the dairy, founded by her colleague Jim Caxton, who seems more anxious about his precious cheese than Debbie's death. And later, Debbie's lover Oliver Ordish is garrotted with cheese wire and covered with cheese fly larvae.

programme.title: The Point of Balance
programme.desc: Midsomer is buzzing with excitement at the arrival of the annual Paramount Dance Extravaganza. Behind the sequins and smiles are deep running feuds and passions, and when the stakes are high, the desire to win has outweighed everything.

programme.title: The Miniature Murders
programme.desc: The worlds of miniature doll's houses and real houses collide when prolific real estate agent Alexander Beauvoisin is murdered in front of a crowd at the unveiling of a new doll's house collection at Midsomer Museum of the family.

programme.title: The Sting of Death
programme.desc: The Deddington's thriving bee empire has put Granville Norton on the map, but the lengths they will go to ensure they're never dethroned are extreme.

programme.title: With Baited Breath
programme.desc: Fishermen and women flock to the village of Solomon Gorge, desperate to catch a giant fish that is said to be in the lake. Their plans are threatened however when hundreds of Lycra-clad sporting enthusiasts descend on the area for the Psycho Mud Run.

programme.title: Blood Wedding
programme.desc: There are two contrasting weddings taking place in Midsomer - Cully's to Simon, and local baronet Ned Fitzroy's to Beth Porteous. As Cully suffers from last minute doubts, Barnaby becomes an unwelcome guest at Ned's marriage when the maid of honour is stabbed to death. What are the secrets in Midsomer high society, and will Barnaby get to his daughter's ceremony on time?

programme.title: Shot at Dawn
programme.desc: A family feud dating back to WWI comes to a head after the unveiling of a war memorial in Midsomer Parva, when a retired colonel is found dead. During their investigation, Barnaby and Jones discover that the town's mayor blamed the deceased man for his grandfather's shooting for cowardice at the Somme, and that the dysfunctional families are connected by dangerous secrets.

programme.title: Left for Dead
programme.desc: A reclusive couple are found dead, victims of a supposedly botched burglary which shocks the occupants of the village of Dunstan. Then, a guest is murdered at the wedding at one of Jones' oldest friends. Could this spate of killings be connected to a mystery of a fatal road accident, and the disappearance of a teenager 20 years ago?

programme.title: Midsomer Life
programme.desc: When a body is discovered in woodland near Midsomer Sonning, country magazine Midsomer Life and its outspoken owner Guy Sandys come under scrutiny from Barnaby and Jones. Former city fund manager Guy is disliked in the neighbourhood for his negative reviews of local businesses. The body proves to be that of a man with whom Guy's wife was having an affair. Then Guy himself is found stabbed through the heart.

programme.title: Murder by Magic
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: Days of Misrule
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are called away from a hated team-building exercise to investigate an explosion at a haulage yard run by Territorial Army officer Matt Parkes and his ruthless son James. James is involved in some shady activities, but is he capable of arson or murder? When a body turns up, there are plenty of other suspects on the scene, including a peace protestor and a host of trained killers at the TA.

programme.title: Talking to the Dead
programme.desc: Two couples vanish without trace from the village of Monks Barton amid rumours of witchcraft and haunted woods. Flamboyant psychic Cyrus LeVanu clashes with pompous cleric Wallace Stone as a body is found, while other villagers seem to be caught up in a stolen antiques racket.

programme.title: The Made to Measure Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Milton Cross, a feudal estate with a church, farms, houses and acres of land, depend on lord of the manor Edward Milton for their livelihoods. When Sonia Woodley is stabbed in the churchyard two years after the death of her abusive husband Gerald, Barnaby and Jones investigate - and the village starts to reveal its secrets.

programme.title: The Sword of Guillaume
programme.desc: Barnaby joins a trip from Midsomer Parva to Brighton because he's suspicious about a deal to buy coastal land for holiday chalets by Causton's mayor. Also against the proposal is Lady Matilda William, a descendant of a French knight Sir Richard Guillaume, whose son Richard will be the last of the line because of brain damage sustained in an attack 20 years ago.

programme.title: Blood on the Saddle
programme.desc: Trouble seems to be brewing in the pretty village of Ford Florey when a tract of waste ground dubbed 'the Swamp' becomes the focus of a land dispute between two old agricultural families and a band of travellers. Things get nasty at the town's annual fair when a woman is shot for real during a shoot-out reconstruction at the Wild West show. Barnaby and Jones uncover a series of seething grudges within the village.

programme.title: The Silent Land
programme.desc: After Joyce Barnaby swerves off the road into a ditch, believing she has hit someone, the body of a librarian is found in a nearby cemetery. Amid stories of ghosts and haunted buildings, can DCI Tom Barnaby convince his wife that she is not to blame - and at the same time identify the real killer on the loose in March Magna?

programme.title: Master Class
programme.desc: During a masterclass for talented young musicians held by famous pianist Sir Michael Fielding, prodigy Zoe Stock is shocked to witness a woman drowning in the river, leaving a baby on the bank. When police arrive, however, there is no sign of the woman or her child. DCI Tom Barnaby is struck by the similarity of the reported drowning to a mysterious case from 20 years ago.

programme.title: Pilot - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan helps the residents of Havencrest, when they learn that the retirement home is going to be sold.

programme.title: To Touch The Moon
programme.desc: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.

programme.title: Return of the Masked Rider
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers. They persuade a young boxer not to throw a big fight when the gang tries to bully him.

programme.title: Song of the Wild West
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps. Next, they help a widow mourning her late husband.

programme.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan must find a way to help Deke, a college football star whose dreams of reaching the pros are shattered by a tragic motorcycle accident.

programme.title: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan enlists the aid of a gymnast to rehabilitate Deke. Meanwhile, Deke's parents have been deeply affected by the accident.

programme.title: A Divine Madness
programme.desc: A construction tycoon believes he's King Arthur and his estranged son wants him declared incompetent.

programme.title: Catch A Falling Star
programme.desc: Jonathan has been hired to look after the kids of a movie star who never has time to spend with his family.

programme.title: Help Wanted: Angel
programme.desc: Mark has fallen in love with an attractive woman, but Jonathan receives news about her from higher up.

programme.title: Dust Child
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark must help an Amerasian girl facing racial prejudice when she goes to live with her father's family in the United States.

programme.title: Hotel Of Dreams
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father. They must deal with an unkind boss, an obnoxious kid and a difficult guest.

programme.title: Another Song For Christmas
programme.desc: Car salesman Honest Eddy (Geoffrey Lewis) plans an expansion, which threatens a local orphanage at Christmas.

programme.title: Plane Death
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark investigate a gang of drug smugglers after an old friend of Mark's has disappeared.

programme.title: One Winged Angel
programme.desc: Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend. But his efforts backfire when he falls for the woman himself.

programme.title: Going Home, Going Home
programme.desc: Mark is in a state between life and death when he's critically injured in a car accident. Jonathan takes Mark back to childhood to give him a second chance to tell his grandfather how much he loves him.

programme.title: As Difficult as ABC
programme.desc: Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.

programme.title: A Child of God
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are on hand when a dying woman attempts a reconciliation with her estranged father.

programme.title: A Match Made in Heaven
programme.desc: Scotty is a lovelorn quadriplegic with a successful law practice. And Jonathan is happy to play cupid.

programme.title: The Banker and The Bum
programme.desc: A greedy banker and a good-hearted bum switch places. The bum dies, but the banker is now infused with love and generosity.

programme.title: The Brightest Star
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programme.title: Investment In Caring
programme.desc: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programme.title: The Right Thing
programme.desc: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.

programme.title: Thoroughbreds - Part 1
programme.desc: Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programme.title: Thoroughbreds - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.

programme.title: A Song for Jason - Part 1
programme.desc: Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.

programme.title: A Song for Jason - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.

programme.title: Bless the Boys in Blue
programme.desc: Jonathan relinquishes his angelic powers for awhile and realizes the dangers that Mark has faced being a police officer.

programme.title: Cindy
programme.desc: An aspiring actress wants to be accepted for who she really is, not in the image her well-meaning dad tries to transform her into.

programme.title: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
programme.desc: Mark has been tricked into selling his soul in order to save a little girl's life. But the Devil has another agenda: acquiring Jonathan's soul.

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Factory workers ignore ground-water contamination, even though it is making their children sick. As a result, Jonathan takes drastic measures to force them to face the facts.

programme.title: Popcorn, Peanuts and Crackerjacks
programme.desc: A minor-league baseball team never wins, so Jonathan and Mark set out to help them. They also come to the aid of an elderly vendor who has been kicked out of the stadium.

programme.title: The Smile in the Third Row
programme.desc: The lead actor in a Broadway play claims that God is attending the show's performances.

programme.title: The Secret
programme.desc: The teenage daughter of Mark's friend tries to find her biological mother. It may tear the family apart.

programme.title: The Monster - Part 1

programme.title: Pittsburgh

programme.title: Clean

programme.title: Deal

programme.title: Godfathering

programme.title: Nice Ladies

programme.title: Nice Ladies

programme.title: Coop Out
programme.desc: Jackie rallies her co-workers against the developers, but an attractive offer challenges her allegiance.

programme.title: High Noon

programme.title: Are You with Me, Doctor Wu?

programme.title: Managed Care

programme.title: Serviam in Caritate

programme.title: Jackie and the Wolf

programme.title: Vigilante Jones

programme.title: I Say a Little Prayer

programme.title: Doing the Backstroke
programme.desc: Nancy goes in search of both of her sons while trying not to get shot by either U-Turn or the Armenians.

programme.title: A Pool and His Money

programme.title: The Brick Dance
programme.desc: Celia attempts to bond with Isabel, while U-Turn forces Nancy to run a dangerous errand.

programme.title: Sh*t Highway

programme.title: Bill Sussman

programme.title: Grasshopper

programme.title: He Taught Me How to Drive By

programme.title: The Two Mrs. Scottsons

programme.title: Release the Hounds
programme.desc: Doug and Sullivan fight over a golf membership and Doug gets revenge. Nancy spends time with Valerie.

programme.title: Roy Till Called
programme.desc: Nancy's up and running again until someone betrays her and sends in the DEA. Celia spends more time with Dean.

programme.title: Cankles
programme.desc: Silas discovers something about Tara. The Majestic and Agrestic merger leaves some people without jobs.

programme.title: The Dark Time
programme.desc: Andy and Dean play murderball. Nancy ponders a new venture while Heylia and Conrad must abandon theirs.

programme.title: Risk
programme.desc: Nancy tries out a new source but it doesn't go so well. Conrad and Nancy are having some good interplay.

programme.title: Protection
programme.desc: Nancy has another full week of trouble to deal with and Doug isn't helping.

programme.title: Go
programme.desc: As the fire approaches, Nancy has her family pack up, while Conrad and Heylia say goodbye to the growhouse.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: A longtime ER nurse tries to conceal her addiction to painkillers she gets from her boyfriend, the pharmacist.

programme.title: Sweet 'n All

programme.title: Chicken Soup
programme.desc: Jackie meets a patient who uses his wife's chicken soup to treat his heart disease.

programme.title: Remember Me
programme.desc: When it appears the widow's children must be separated, Mr. Edwards makes an announcement.

programme.title: The Camp-Out
programme.desc: Mrs. Oleson complicates the Ingallses' long-awaited camping vacation by deciding that she and her family should go along.

programme.title: At the End of the Rainbow
programme.desc: Laura thinks she has found gold and imagines the glamorous life it can buy.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Laura and Mary's plans to raise money for the pastor's birthday by investing the Sunday-school funds backfire.

programme.title: His Father's Son
programme.desc: Isaiah Edwards attempts to bond with his newly adopted son and buys him a rifle so that the pair can go hunting together; his son, an avid reader, has no interest in hunting.

programme.title: The Talking Machine
programme.desc: A voice-recording device broadcasts Laura's love for a new boy (Eric Shea) all over town.

programme.title: The Pride of Walnut Grove
programme.desc: When Caroline is away with Mary at an arithmetic championship, Laura has a hard time filling her mother's shoes at home.

programme.title: A Matter of Faith
programme.desc: A deadly infection fells Caroline before she can join her family on a camping trip.

programme.title: The Runaway Caboose
programme.desc: Charles and Mr. Edwards end up racing against time to rescue Mary, Laura and a friend from a runaway caboose.

programme.title: Troublemaker
programme.desc: A strict teacher (Richard Basehart) develops an instant dislike for Laura.

programme.title: The Long Road Home
programme.desc: During a recession, Charles and Mr. Edwards join two others in order to transport the highly explosive liquid dynamite.

programme.title: For My Lady
programme.desc: Rumors fly when Charles performs odd jobs for a widow to get a china set for Caroline.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: A Russian emigrant (Theodore Bikel) objects to cancellation of the centennial party.

programme.title: Soldier's Return
programme.desc: A gentle and sensitive musician returns to Walnut Grove to resume his career as a teacher.

programme.title: Going Home
programme.desc: A tornado that destroys crops convinces a desolate Charles to sell the farm and go back to his old home.

programme.title: The Collection
programme.desc: A man (Johnny Cash) dressed as a cleric and his wife (June Carter Cash) claim to be on a mission of mercy.

programme.title: Bunny
programme.desc: Nellie feigns injury after an argument with Laura, then tries to manipulate others.

programme.title: The Race
programme.desc: After having her horse shod for the annual race, Laura learns that the Olesons have purchased an expensive racehorse for Nellie.

programme.title: Little Girl Lost
programme.desc: Carrie falls into a deep mine while chasing a butterfly; a drunken former miner must get his act together to rescue her.

programme.title: The Monster of Walnut Grove
programme.desc: After witnessing a loud argument, Laura is under the impression that Mr. Oleson kills his wife, but no one believes her.

programme.title: Journey in the Spring
programme.desc: Charles rushes back to Wisconsin after he learns his mother has died, and his father is suicidal with grief.

programme.title: Journey in the Spring
programme.desc: Charles' father stays with the Ingalls, but an incident with Laura deepens his depression.

programme.title: Fred
programme.desc: Laura struggles to understand why the rest of her family does not like her goat, which she saves from farmer Parson's shotgun.

programme.title: Bully Boys
programme.desc: Charles tries to tolerate three bullies, until they assault his family.

programme.title: The Hunters
programme.desc: Laura asks help from a blind recluse (Burl Ives) and his trapper son (Johnny Crawford) when Charles has a hunting accident.

programme.title: Blizzard
programme.desc: The community's children are trapped by a sudden snowstorm while on their way home from school. With Michael Landon and Karen Grassle.

programme.title: I'll Ride the Wind
programme.desc: Mr. Edwards' adopted son John decides to refuse a college scholarship when Mary agrees to get married to him.

programme.title: Quarantine
programme.desc: When Mr. Edwards takes his deathly ill daughter to a mountain cabin to nurse her, Laura tries to help.

programme.title: Little Women
programme.desc: Mrs. Oleson casts Nellie as the lead in the children's play; a girl plots marriage for her widowed mother.

programme.title: Injun Kid
programme.desc: The Ingalls try to help a boy who is rejected by the townsfolk because his father is an Indian warrior.

programme.title: To Live With Fear
programme.desc: Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) needs an immediate operation, so Charles (Michael Landon) leaves the farm for a dangerous high-paying job.

programme.title: To Live With Fear
programme.desc: Charles (Michael Landon) risks his life and the lives of his crew by rushing a tunnel-dynamiting job. With Karen Grassle.

programme.title: The Wisdom of Solomon
programme.desc: A black boy (guest star Todd Bridges) enslaves himself to the Ingallses in exchange for an education. With Michael Landon and Karen Grassle.

programme.title: The Music Box
programme.desc: Nightmares plague Laura (Melissa Gilbert) after she steals a small toy. With Michael Landon, Karen Grassle and Melissa Sue Anderson.

programme.title: The Election
programme.desc: The boys want to prove that a slow-witted classmate can beat Mary and Nellie for class president.

programme.title: Gold Country
programme.desc: When heavy rains make it impossible to plant their crops, the Ingalls and Edwards families head west to search for gold.

programme.title: Gold Country
programme.desc: Charles (Michael Landon) regrets uprooting his family to the camps until he gets gold fever. With Karen Grassle, Melissa Sue Anderson and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: Castoffs
programme.desc: A lonely elderly woman tries to settle in Walnut Grove. With Michael Landon, Karen Grassle, Melissa Sue Anderson and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: Times of Change
programme.desc: Charles and Mary (Michael Landon, Melissa Sue Anderson) take their first trip to Chicago. With Karen Grassle and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: My Ellen
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes after Laura (Melissa Gilbert) convinces a mother to let her daughter go swimming in the creek. With Michael Landon and Karen Grassle.

programme.title: The Handyman
programme.desc: Gossip flies about Caroline and a man (Gil Gerard) building her kitchen in exchange for room and board.

programme.title: The Wolves
programme.desc: A pack of wild dogs, crazed with hunger, kills the livestock of Walnut Grove farmers. With Michael Landon, Karen Grassle, Melissa Sue Anderson and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: The Creeper of Walnut Grove
programme.desc: After an unknown thief plagues Walnut Grove, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and her friend investigate. With Michael Landon and Karen Grassle.

programme.title: To Run and Hide
programme.desc: Doc Baker (Kevin Hagen) decides to retire after a patient dies. With Michael Landon, Karen Grassle, Melissa Sue Anderson and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: The Aftermath
programme.desc: Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) is held hostage by the outlaw Jesse James (guest star Dennis Rucker). With Michael Landon, Karen Grassle and Melissa Gilbert.

programme.title: The High Cost of Being Right
programme.desc: Jonathan Garvey's barn burns down leaving the family with no means of support, but Jonathan is angry when his wife takes a job at the post office.

programme.title: The Fighter
programme.desc: Charles take Jonathan's place in a bout with an aging fighter (Moses Gunn), but victory dims when Charles realizes the boxer is badly injured.

programme.title: Meet Me at the Fair
programme.desc: Mary plans to meet a shy suitor at the Mankato Fair, until she encounters his charming balloonist boss.

programme.title: Here Come the Bride
programme.desc: Adam and Luke Simms move to Walnut Grove; Luke falls in love with Nellie, but she has reservations about him.

programme.title: Freedom Flight
programme.desc: An American Indian boy arrives in town seeking medical help for his ailing father. With Michael Landon and Karen Grassle.

programme.title: The Rivals
programme.desc: Laura wants to impress a newly discovered old buddy; Charles and Jonathan try to start a freight line, which leads them further away from home.

programme.title: Whisper Country
programme.desc: Mary takes a teaching job in a backwoods community only to clash with a hostile woman bent on driving her away.

programme.title: I Remember, I Remember
programme.desc: Caroline recalls her first meeting with Charles when he is late for their wedding anniversary celebration.

programme.title: Be My Friend
programme.desc: Laura finds a bottle bearing a message floating downstream, then another containing an infant's picture.

programme.title: The Stranger
programme.desc: Charles helps Mr. Oleson's unloved nephew learn values by hiring him for odd jobs.

programme.title: The Inheritance
programme.desc: News of Charles' inheritance from a wealthy relative prompts townspeople to suggest uses for the money.

programme.title: A Most Precious Gift
programme.desc: Pregnant Caroline worries Charles will be disappointed if her baby is a girl.

programme.title: I'll Be Waving as You Drive Away
programme.desc: Caroline and Charles are devastated when they find out that Mary's sight is deteriorating and cannot bear to tell her the truth.

programme.title: I'll Be Waving as You Drive Away
programme.desc: An instructor manages to help Mary come to terms with her blindness; Walnut Grove deals with financial ruin.

programme.title: As Long as We're Together
programme.desc: The Ingalls move from financially troubled Walnut Grove to the busy town of Winoka.

programme.title: As Long as We're Together
programme.desc: The Ingalls, Garveys and Olesons have trouble with city life; Charles tries to reform Albert.

programme.title: The Winoka Warriors
programme.desc: A strange and unusual football game makes an ignorant father realise that his visually-challenged son needs education.

programme.title: The Man Inside
programme.desc: Laura's innocent joke about a fat man has near-tragic results when he turns out to be her best friend's father.

programme.title: There's No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Charles and Jonathan become increasingly unhappy with Winoka; guest Ray Bolger.

programme.title: Constitutional Revolts in Persia and Turkey
programme.desc: How protests in Persia led to a new government; then why the Young Turks wanted a united Turkey to supersede the Ottoman Empire.

programme.title: World War I and the Ottoman Empire's Fall
programme.desc: The promises of Arab and Turkish nationalism and the construction of a Jewish state collide after the war.

programme.title: Egyptian Revolution and Turkish Independence

With an hour of light left, they ditch their packs, sprint to the next ridge and use the terrain to stalk into bow range. Then comes the hard part: breaking down the bull and getting the meat off the mountain on no sleep.

programme.desc: Alex witnesses an accident involving a John Doe.

programme.title: Hitler's Fatal Mistake: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: With the declaration of war, Hitler's break with Stalin was a fatal mistake, leading to the Third Reich's fall.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam III
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly conflict between North Vietnam and South Vietnam, allied with the U.S. The Vietcong used jungle cover for guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers. It was a 360-degree war with attacks from all angles, where territory changed hands regularly and political loyalties were often unclear.

programme.title: The Battle Above: True Stories from WWII Pilots
programme.desc: Experience real accounts from WWII pilots as they share harrowing stories from aerial combat, revealing truths more powerful than fiction.

programme.title: Strike Missions: Balkans
programme.desc: An exhilarating breakdown of some of history's most decisive battles, featuring expert analysis and eyewitness accounts. The Balkan Campaign was the invasion of Greece and the Balkan states by the Axis powers during World War II. By June 1st, 1941, all of Albania, Yugoslavia, and Greece were under Axis control. Greece was placed under triple occupation, and Yugoslavia was dissolved and occupied. Germany gained a significant strategic advantage with direct access to the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Vietnam War: Tales from Nam
programme.desc: This documentary offers an intimate look at the Vietnam War, a relentless conflict from 1955 to 1975.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: Operation Watchtower marked the first major Allied land offensive against Japan on Guadalcanal from August 1942 to February 1943.

programme.title: The Fall of the Third Reich
programme.desc: Arguably the most pivotal event in modern history, World War II saw mankind forced to evolve and accelerate for the sake of their own survival. The dramatic battle between Hitler and the Allies played out across every continent. This exciting series looks back across some of the most defining moments of WWII brought to a whole new life now in colour. The Battle of Britain was won, but not by Hitler. Hitler had lost the battle. He had lost 2,375 German planes and their crews.

programme.title: Nazis on Trial: Nuremberg in Colour
programme.desc: In 1945, Nuremberg becomes the site of justice as the Allies establish a tribunal to prosecute Nazi war crimes and dictatorship atrocities.

programme.title: Vietnam: Ho Chi Minh's Revolution
programme.desc: Uncovering the secrets behind Ho Chi Minh's control of Vietnam and his success in expelling Japanese, French and U.S. forces during his lengthy rule.

programme.title: The Battle of the Atlantic
programme.desc: The struggle for the Atlantic pitted Germany's lethal U-boat fleet against every weapon the Allies could muster.

programme.title: The Hunt for Atomic Secrets
programme.desc: The all-important race to develop an atomic bomb led to some of the most daring Russian spy operations in the United States.

programme.title: Rommel's Enigma
programme.desc: In the critical battle for North Africa, German General Irwin Rommel, the Desert Fox, seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: British Secret Intelligence in WWII
programme.desc: Insight into the British Secret Intelligence Service that demonstrates that facts can indeed be stranger than fiction.

programme.title: Shadows of the Six Day War
programme.desc: Israeli forces, surrounded and outnumbered by the enemy, use covert means to rewrite the map of the Middle East.

programme.title: The O.S.S.
programme.desc: The story of the formation of the Office of Strategic Services, the predecessor to the CIA.

programme.title: Cold War: Khrushchev's Regime
programme.desc: Although he tried to distance himself from Stalin's ruthless regime, Khrushchev brought the world to the brink of nuclear war.

programme.title: Prisoners of War, Part Three - Code of Conduct
programme.desc: From brainwashing in Korea to courageous acts of heroism in Vietnam and the Gulf War, a unique examination of POWs, their families, and their secrets.

programme.title: Gulf War: Iraq's Secrets
programme.desc: A look at Saddam Hussein's deception to make friendships with the West, but by invading Kuwait, he turned his back on those alliances forever.

programme.title: Battlefield Deceptions
programme.desc: From rubber tanks and camouflage to booby traps and tactical manoeuvers of deception, the role "trickery" plays on the modern battlefield.

programme.title: Tools of Deception
programme.desc: The use of camouflage and instruments of propaganda helped confuse the enemy both on and off the battlefield.

programme.title: Roosevelt's Spymasters
programme.desc: Details the American President's behind the scenes use of political and military intelligence operatives.

programme.title: Secret Weapons of the Third Reich
programme.desc: They were weapons systems that were far beyond anything the Allies had or could have imagined in World War II.

programme.title: Korea: Behind the Bamboo Curtain
programme.desc: The secrets of the Korean ground war leading up to Gen. MacArthur's surprise landing behind enemy lines.

programme.title: Secret Submarines in WWII
programme.desc: From silent one-man midget subs to U-boats on secret missions, both sides used secret submersibles of all shapes and sizes to conduct clandestine warfare in the war.

programme.title: Psychological Warfare
programme.desc: The soldiers who employ "Psy Ops" use every means available to destroy the will of the enemy to resist.

programme.title: Cold War: The Kennedy Years
programme.desc: This youngest of American presidents took over in the most tense period of the Cold War.

programme.title: Spy Planes
programme.desc: Examining the secret deployment of aircraft designed to spy from the sky, including the U-2 and the SR-71.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Secret Nazi attempts to turn the tide of war as Berlin crumbled.

programme.title: Sitzkrieg: The Phony War
programme.desc: Hitler's lightning strike in Poland soon gave way to a strange eight month waiting game.

programme.title: Cold War: The Kennedy Years

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: La venta del edificio
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Ahí va el agua
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Tome su turno
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: El embarazo no deseado
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: La casa del millón
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: El regreso
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Los muebles
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: El socio
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: ¿Quién se comió los tamales?
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Las vacaciones
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: El abuelo pierde la memoria
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Cartas a la bruja
programme.desc: Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.

programme.title: Esperando a Justo
programme.desc: Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.

programme.title: Cenizas
programme.desc: Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

programme.title: El ultimátum
programme.desc: Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

programme.title: El huequito
programme.desc: Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.

programme.title: La llegada
programme.desc: Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.

programme.title: Un fantasma de diez
programme.desc: Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.

programme.title: Ácido fólico
programme.desc: Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

programme.title: Plácido inactivo
programme.desc: Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.

programme.title: Justo para todos
programme.desc: Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.

programme.title: Una noche de estreno
programme.desc: Plácido acaba de recordar que es su aniversario de bodas con Renata, por lo que le organizará una cena romántica. Martina invita al cine a la familia a ver el estreno de una película.

programme.title: El yerberito llegó
programme.desc: Adolfo pierde el bono huachicolero por bañarse, y con la ayuda de Jacinta se convierte en hierbero. Carlos recibe regalos de un admirador secreto.

programme.title: El huequito
programme.desc: Plácido se lastima el pie y debe guardar reposo de un mes, por eso enviará a Adolfo a que recupere su trabajo. Martina hace un hoyo en la pared y la Nena descubre, a través de este, un departamento abandonado.

programme.title: La llegada
programme.desc: Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.

programme.title: Un fantasma de diez
programme.desc: Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.

programme.title: Ácido fólico
programme.desc: Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

programme.title: Plácido inactivo
programme.desc: Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.

programme.desc: Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.
