programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: A Gift From Bob
programme.desc: A friendship between a struggling street musician and a stray cat sparks a Christmas miracle.

programme.title: Christmas All Over Again
programme.desc: A mischievous boy must overcome his inner Scrooge or remain caught in a cycle where every day is a Christmas without presents.

programme.title: What's Cooking?
programme.desc: You are invited to a tasty Thanksgiving dinner that will all at once transport you to four different worlds and take you home again. On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: Babes in Toyland
programme.desc: With just days to go before presents are scheduled for Christmas delivery, Toyland is buzzing with activity. But curmudgeon Barnaby Crookedman (Christopher Plummer) is hatching a devious scheme to destroy Toyland -- meaning no presents for the world's children! Luckily, Jack (Joseph Ashton) and Jill (Lacey Chabert) rush into action to stop the villain, receiving some assistance from the likes of Humpty Dumpty (Charles Nelson Reilly) and even Santa Claus himself.

programme.title: Family Camp
programme.desc: Two polar-opposite families find themselves sharing a cabin for a week away at camp. With the highly coveted camp trophy at stake, dads Tommy and Eddie end up lost in the woods.

programme.title: Christmas All Over Again
programme.desc: A mischievous boy must overcome his inner Scrooge or remain caught in a cycle where every day is a Christmas without presents.

programme.title: D.L. Hughley: Clear
programme.desc: The comic performs in San Francisco, discussing current affairs and nosy neighbors at the Regency Theater.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings (Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian) must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters. Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety.

programme.title: How the Gringo Stole Christmas
programme.desc: A Mexican father's Christmas celebration goes from merry to messy when his daughter shows up with her new boyfriend.

programme.title: The Spy Next Door
programme.desc: Bob Ho (Jackie Chan), an undercover operative for the CIA, decides to give up his career and marry his girlfriend, Gillian (Amber Valletta). First however, he has one more mission to complete: Gain the approval of Gillian's children. Bob volunteers to baby-sit when Gillian is called away, but the operation hits a snag when one of the kids mistakenly downloads a top-secret formula, and a Russian terrorist takes aim at Bob's prospective family.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings (Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian) must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters. Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety.

programme.title: Christmas on the Farm
programme.desc: A New York socialite who fakes her identity to get her book published has to rush back to her deceased mother's farm when the publisher and her son come to visit their Australian author.

programme.title: Christmas Princess
programme.desc: A high school girl overcomes her traumatic past to become a pageant princess.

programme.title: The Loaded Goat
programme.desc: Andy and Barney must figure out a way to prevent a farmer's goat who has eaten a load of dynamite from blowing up Mayberry.

programme.title: Class Reunion
programme.desc: Andy and Barney look forward to seeing their high-school sweethearts at the Mayberry Class of '45 reunion.

programme.title: The Clampetts in Court
programme.desc: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

programme.title: The Clampetts Get Psychoanalyzed
programme.desc: The Clampetts take Jethro to Mrs. Drysdale's psychiatrist for an assessment so that he can pass the fifth grade; when Pearl accompanies him, she is worried about being asked to lie on the couch.

programme.title: The Psychiatrist Gets Clampetted
programme.desc: Jethro is finally told that he can finish the fifth grade by Doctor Twombly, but the doctor still wants to see Grannie; her love potion for Pearl misfires, leaving Twombly confused.

programme.title: Good Boy!
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, dogs arrived on planet Earth from a faraway star with plans to take over the world. Now, the Greater Dane (Vanessa Redgrave) wants a report on the takeover, so she sends Hubble (Matthew Broderick) to investigate. When he's adopted by the lonely Owen (Liam Aiken), Hubble slowly realizes that dogs have forgotten their mission. They're not man's worst enemy -- they're his best friend. And, to make matters worse, the Greater Dane is headed to Earth for an inspection.

programme.title: Rescue From Gilligan's Island
programme.desc: A massive tidal wave hits the island, bringing stranded Gilligan, Skipper and the rest of the gang back to civilization.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: Mark (John Larroquette) and Jessie (Kirstie Alley) get blindsided by an unexpected visit from Mark's cousin, Fred (John Diehl), and his pregnant wife, Bernice (Jessica Lundy). The family reunion is suddenly extended from five days to six months after an accident renders Bernice bedridden, and Mark and Jessie's life is slowly turned upside down by a seemingly never-ending stream of house guests, including Jessie's neurotic sister (Alison La Placa) and her obnoxious son (Bradley Gregg).

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack (Jackie Chan), a world-renowned archaeology professor, and his team are on a grand quest to locate a lost ancient Indian treasure when they are ambushed by a team of mercenaries and left for dead. Using his vast knowledge of history and kung fu, Jack leads his team on a race around the world to beat the mercenaries to the treasure and save an ancient culture.

programme.title: Hit Me With Your Best Shot
programme.desc: George kicks Alma out of his house and discovers he misses fighting with her.

programme.title: Hot Blooded
programme.desc: Alma sets George up on a date.

programme.title: School's Out
programme.desc: George and Mackenzie are reminded why they got a divorce after bickering over Harper.

programme.title: Rich Girl
programme.desc: George is thrilled to be dating a wealthy woman, but realizes he doesn't enjoy being her boy-toy.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Revenge of the Pink Panther
programme.desc: When French drug kingpin Philippe Douvier (Robert Webber) learns that he's losing the respect of New York mob bosses, he decides to murder Chief Inspector Jacques Clouseau (Peter Sellers) to regain his reputation. After a case of mistaken identity, Clouseau is declared dead, much to the delight of his former boss, Charles Dreyfus (Herbert Lom). When Clouseau reemerges, he teams up with Douvier's ex-lover, Simone LeGree (Dyan Cannon), to break up the drug trafficking operation.

programme.title: Wagons East!
programme.desc: When a group of dissatisfied settlers decides they've had enough of the Wild West, they hire James Harlow, an alcoholic wagon master, to take them back East. The eclectic but happy bunch includes Dr. Phil, prostitute Belle and openly gay man Julian. But the railroad investors don't want it getting out that the West isn't a nice place, so they do everything they can to make sure the group never makes it to their destination.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven
programme.desc: In this animated feature, canine casino owner Charlie (Burt Reynolds) is killed by gambler Carface (Vic Tayback), but returns to Earth from heaven thanks to the powers of a magical, rewindable watch. Charlie sets out to take his revenge on Carface by means of an elaborate plan that involves an orphan girl, Anne-Marie. But as the plan progresses, Charlie discovers that Anne-Marie is being exploited by Carface. Charlie must decide whether to change his mission from one of revenge to one of rescue.

programme.title: All Dogs Go to Heaven 2
programme.desc: In this animated film, Charlie Barkin (Charlie Sheen) is finding life in dog heaven a little dull. Even after his best pal, Itchy (Dom DeLuise), arrives in town, Charlie still longs to go back to Earth. When Charlie's old nemesis, Carface (Ernest Borgnine), steals the horn used by the archangel Gabriel, Charlie and Itchy quickly volunteer to retrieve it. Back on the planet, while scrambling to outwit Carface and get the horn, Charlie meets an alluring pooch named Anabelle (Bebe Neuwirth).

programme.title: Long Beach
programme.desc: Fluffy and the crew go out of character by attempting to eat light before the Magic Mike XXL premiere.

programme.title: Laffapalooza Volume 5
programme.desc: Jamie Foxx hosts this hilarious collection of comedy. With Sherman Golden, T.K. Kirkland, and more.

programme.title: How the Gringo Stole Christmas
programme.desc: A Mexican father's Christmas celebration goes from merry to messy when his daughter shows up with her new boyfriend.

programme.title: Boris and Natasha
programme.desc: The silly spies from The Bullwinkle Show foil a mad scientist whose lab is in a Mount Rushmore nose.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH
programme.desc: Mrs. Brisby (Elizabeth Hartman), a widowed mouse, must move her children out of their home in a field before the local farmer starts plowing. Unable to leave because her son is ill, Mrs. Brisby seeks the help of nearby rats, who have heightened intelligence after being the subjects of scientific experiments. She receives an unexpected gift from the elder rat, Nicodemus (Derek Jacobi). Soon Mrs. Brisby is caught in a conflict among the rats, jeopardizing her mission to save her family.

programme.title: Getting Even With Dad
programme.desc: Con man Ray Gleason (Ted Danson) is going after one last heist -- a stash of rare coins -- when his estranged son, Timmy (Macaulay Culkin), unexpectedly shows up. Ray is too busy with his robbery to spend much time with his son, so Timmy decides to blackmail Ray into acting like a father. He hides the coins and promises to give them back only after Ray takes him to amusement parks and baseball games. All the while, Detective Theresa Walsh (Glenne Headly) is closing in on Ray.

programme.title: Rafe Hollister Sings
programme.desc: Rafe Hollister, a farmer with a golden voice, is chosen to represent Mayberry at a musical, but Mayor Stoner believes he looks too seedy. It is then up to Andy to make Rafe presentable enough.

programme.title: Opie and the Spoiled Kid
programme.desc: Opie meets Arnold Winkler, a spoiled kid who teaches him how to manipulate Andy into increasing his allowance by throwing tantrums.

programme.title: The Great Filling Station Robbery
programme.desc: Andy uses common sense and Barney uses modern technology to solve several burglaries at a filling station.

programme.title: The Longshots
programme.desc: Curtis Plummer (Ice Cube), a down-on-his-luck former football player, becomes the new coach of the Minden, Illinois, Pop Warner football team. With his niece Jasmine (Keke Palmer) installed as the team's quarterback and secret weapon, Curtis has a chance to turn his life around, while the residents of Minden have a chance to recapture their team spirit and civic pride.

programme.title: An All Dogs Christmas Carol
programme.desc: In this animated adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic book, Christmas is coming, and pooch pals Itchy (Dom DeLuise), Charlie Barkin (Steve Weber) and Sasha (Sheena Easton) decide to raise enough cash for injured pup Timmy to get a much-needed operation. Unfortunately, mean-spirited canines Carface (Ernest Borgnine) and Killer (Charles Nelson Reilly) rob the kindhearted dogs before they can give Timmy his present, prompting Charlie and the gang to concoct a ghostly plan to retrieve their money.

programme.title: What's Cooking?
programme.desc: You are invited to a tasty Thanksgiving dinner that will all at once transport you to four different worlds and take you home again. On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal.

programme.title: Graffiti Bridge
programme.desc: The Kid (Prince) and his rock-club rival (Morris Day) disagree about music in a sequel to the 1984 film "Purple Rain."

programme.title: Surf Ninjas
programme.desc: Brothers Johnny (Ernie Reyes Jr.) and Adam (Nicolas Cowan) are coasting through a fun surfer existence in Los Angeles when they are suddenly accosted by a band of ninjas. A mysterious warrior comes to their aid, later telling the brothers that they are the royal heirs to the throne of Patusan, an embattled island under the rule of a tyrannical leader (Leslie Nielsen). After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

programme.title: Fathers' Day
programme.desc: Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.

programme.title: I Am Sam
programme.desc: A man with an intellectual disability fights for custody of his daughter.

programme.title: Cannonball Run II
programme.desc: The usual suspects return for a new breakneck, ocean-to-ocean free for all!

programme.title: Arthur (1981)
programme.desc: A drunken playboy decides to give up his inheritance for true love.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: Love threatens to come between a drunken playboy and his inheritance.

programme.title: Osmosis Jones
programme.desc: A cutting-edge, live action/animated action adventure comedy about one white blood cell's (Chris Rock) race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus (Laurence Fishburne). Bill Murray stars as Frank, in whose body the action unfolds.

programme.title: Deep Cover
programme.desc: David Jason (Jeff Goldblum) is the biggest drug dealer in Los Angeles, and Russell Stevens (Larry Fishburne) is an undercover cop who wants to bring him down. Posing as a dealer, Stevens begins to earn the trust of the L.A. drug underworld, eventually making his way to Jason himself. But along the way he has to take his cover to depths he never thought he would have to see, including selling drugs and going to great lengths to eliminate potential competitors for Jason's drug cartel.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Senior Trip
programme.desc: High schoolers head to D.C. after the President responds to their letter.

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons
programme.desc: In the Kingdom of Izmer, wizards use their magic to rule the land. The young Empress Savina desires to use magic for good, but the evil Profion plans to utilize his powers to usurp the throne from Savina and subject the kingdom to totalitarian rule. Profion gains control of the kingdom's golden dragons, while Savina sets out to win control of the even more powerful red dragons, gaining the alliance of a motley group of individuals along the way.

programme.title: Protocol
programme.desc: A waitress bumbles into a job with the diplomatic corps in the Middle East.

programme.title: Pleasantville
programme.desc: Impressed by high school student David's (Tobey Maguire) devotion to a 1950s family TV show, a mysterious television repairman (Don Knotts) provides him with a means to escape into the black-and-white program with his sister, Jennifer (Reese Witherspoon). While David initially takes to the simplistic, corny world of the show, Jennifer sets about jolting the characters with doses of reality that unexpectedly bring a little color into their drab existence.

programme.title: Preacher's Kid
programme.desc: After joining a traveling show, Angie discovers life on the road is tough.

programme.title: The Year of Living Dangerously
programme.desc: An Australian reporter and photographer get more than they'd bargained for.

programme.title: Funny Farm
programme.desc: A city slicker moves his family to the country with disastrous results.

programme.title: Victor/Victoria
programme.desc: A cabaret singer finds fame when she goes on stage as female impersonator.

programme.title: Matchstick Men
programme.desc: Roy (Nicolas Cage), a depressed con artist with obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Frank (Sam Rockwell), his partner, find their line of work complicated by the arrival of Roy's teenage daughter, Angela (Alison Lohman). Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. But when Angela wants to learn the family business, and Roy allows her to assist on a big scam concerning a businessmen (Bruce McGill), he reconsiders his parenting techniques.

programme.title: Sphere
programme.desc: Researchers unearth the mystery of a 300-year-old spaceship.

programme.title: Overnight Delivery
programme.desc: Friends have 24 hours to stop a package, prevent disaster and fall in love.

programme.title: The Killing Fields
programme.desc: An American journalist is engulfed in the horror of Cambodia.

programme.title: Red Sonja
programme.desc: Power-hungry Queen Gedren (Sandahl Bergman) captures the priestesses guarding the Talisman, a mystical orb that created and can destroy the world. But one of the priestesses escapes and seeks out her warrior sister, Red Sonja (Brigitte Nielsen), to warn her about Gedren's plan for world domination. Lord Kalidor (Arnold Schwarzenegger), the Talisman's keeper, insists on helping Sonja, and though she scorns the assistance of any man, she soon gains respect for Kalidor's fighting prowess.

programme.title: Fandango
programme.desc: Gardner Barnes is a young Texan who has just graduated from college and is unsure of what to do next. Along with his friends, collectively known as the Groovers, Gardner embarks on a road trip to the Rio Grande as a last hurrah for the group. As the trip progresses, Gardner and his buddies, including Kenneth Waggener and Phil Hicks, struggle with their impending adulthood and the looming issue of the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Her Alibi
programme.desc: Mystery novelist Phil Blackwood has written countless bestsellers, but he's having trouble finding inspiration for his latest book, so he goes to the courthouse to observe real criminals in action. There he encounters Nina, a gorgeous immigrant charged with a gruesome murder. Convinced she's not guilty, Phil furnishes Nina with an alibi and a place to stay. But, as the two begin to fall in love, Phil finds he has grave doubts about her innocence.

programme.title: Arthur 2: On the Rocks
programme.desc: The world's richest and most tipsy wit, is alive, well and living in style!

programme.title: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: NASA recruits seven test pilots for the Mercury Space Program.

programme.title: Best Friends
programme.desc: A couple learns the differences between being married rather than friends.

programme.title: Love Affair
programme.desc: Two star-crossed lovers vow to meet again if they still love each other.
A girl dreaming of a civil servant to support her mother gets into an accident and is framed as a murderer.

programme.title: Like a French Film
programme.desc: One movie four different stories: a time to leave a lady at the bar a remaining time like a French film. A mother who will take her own life two men fighting over a woman a couple with an uncertain future and a man who is deeply in love tell their own stories in this movie.
A girl dreaming of a civil servant to support her mother gets into an accident and is framed as a murderer.

programme.title: Idol
programme.desc: A car accident triggered everything. The secret is bound to connect two men's lives in a harrowing way.

programme.title: Episode 15
programme.desc: While Han Se Gye lays low, Seo Do Jae takes a big step to remove the insurmountable barrier between them despite the great personal risk.

programme.title: Episode 16
programme.desc: Seo Do Jae navigates the complexities of dating a celebrity. Jung Joo Hwan meets with Yoo Woo Mi to discuss a new scandal. Kang Sa Ra makes a proposal to Eun Ho's parents.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Han Se Gye senses something while at an awards ceremony and runs away, sending chaebol executive Seo Do Jae on a search for his missing spokesmodel.

programme.title: The Recon
programme.desc: One day at early dawn a search unit near the DMZ the front line is on alert. It was because a soldier from another unit's GP ran away to DMZ with a gun. Under Commander Baek the 3rd platoon members led by First Lieutenant Cho are put into the operation to arrest the deserter. The search begins and at the same time First Lieutenant Lim's dead body is found at the unit's official residence.

programme.title: The Artist: Reborn
programme.desc: A no-name artist suddenly has a heart attack. After she wakes up from a coma her paintings have become the most coveted art pieces in the world. However she soon senses that something is not right.

programme.title: The Sheriff In Town
programme.desc: A disgraced ex-cop serving as an unofficial sheriff in Busan suspects a popular new businessman is linked to his past failed drug sting-and a recent case-leading him to investigate.

programme.title: Possessed
programme.desc: Hee-jin's sister vanishes leading to a string of mysterious deaths in their neighborhood related to her.

programme.title: The Culprit
programme.desc: The victim's husband and suspected murderer's wife come together to track a real killer and solve the case but both of them are hiding secrets from one another.

programme.title: The Queen of Crime
programme.desc: As a meddling mom begins investigating her son's $1000 water bill she instinctively detects a crime behind it.

programme.title: Hometown
programme.desc: A failed comedian returns home after his father's death-only to inherit his role as a local crime boss.

programme.title: Man in Love
programme.desc: A street thug finds himself wanting to change for the better when he sees a woman whom he starts to fall in love with.

programme.title: A Melody to Remember
programme.desc: During the Korean War Second Lieutenant Sang-Yeol encounters a group of orphans while leading his platoon. Empathizing with their pain he makes a choir with the children to protect them.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Mi Rae realizes she can't escape others' taunts even with a pretty face. Chan Woo especially refuses to leave her alone.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Kyeong-seok feels conflicted about the CEO of a perfume company who becomes a new role model for Mi-rae.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mi Rae resolves an old misunderstanding with Kyung Seok. TA Yeon moves into the same neighborhood as Mi Rae and Hyun Jung.

programme.title: The Phone
programme.desc: Due to magnetic anomaly, a lawyer receives a call from his dead wife on the anniversary of her murder. He tries to prevent the tragedy by warning her about the murderer.

programme.title: Queen of Walking
programme.desc: High school student Man-bok walks 2 hours every day from home to school due to extreme motion sickness disorder. After the teacher's advice Man-bok decides to try out the sports of Race Walking.

programme.title: Come Rain, Come Shine
programme.desc: On the day of parting a couple still play hide and seek with their feelings. Will this being them back together?
A girl dreaming of a civil servant to support her mother gets into an accident and is framed as a murderer.

programme.title: Best Friend
programme.desc: Dae-kwon is a NIS agent specializing in wiretapping. On the verge of demotion he receives an order from Mr. Kim his senior: surveilling a well-known politician and his family in house arrest. That politician Lee Eui-min is the opposition party's frontrunner for the next presidency. Disguising as next-door neighbors Dae-kwon and his team must find evidence to stop him from running.

programme.title: Fortune Salon
programme.desc: Tae-rang is a successful upscale clairvoyant with not only gifted shamanistic talent but also good looks. Yet fate has it that she is destined to marry Seung-won the most unattractive and lazy man she has ever met.

programme.title: The Limit
programme.desc: A police officer joins a secret investigation and negotiates with a cunning kidnapper-until her own child is taken. Pushed to the edge, she risks everything in a desperate final act.

programme.title: Recalled
programme.desc: Soo-jin a woman suffering from post-traumatic memory loss returns to her daily life with her husband after an accident. But her recovery takes an unexpected turn when she starts experiencing eerie visions: One day she sees a vision of a child living in the same building being hit by a car. Shortly after almost risking her life to save the child she has yet another chilling vision about a girl living on the 7th floor being harassed by a man and does what she can to help the girl.

programme.title: Episode 2

programme.title: Episode 3

programme.desc: Ashie wants a bedroom her daughters will never forget, and Kylie brings the magic to life; with patterned wallpaper, dreamy canopies and a custom closet makeover, the room transforms into a warm, playful space full of fairytale vibes.

programme.title: Building Through Heartbreak and Healing
programme.desc: Rachel installs a glass door that connects the guest suite to the ranch's vast views; when tragedy strikes with the loss of her beloved bulldog, Rachel creates a special outdoor tribute and pushes on to finish the guest bedroom.

programme.title: Living With Leo
programme.desc: Rachel welcomes Leo the pig to the ranch, complete with a custom-built outdoor habitat; she is joined by her partner, Aaron, a fellow builder who helps her start to blend their lives and styles together with collaborative mini makeovers.

programme.title: A Ton of Potential
programme.desc: Rachel and Aaron find their rhythm with a DIY custom hay feeder for their horse Mouse; they dive into a massive living room overhaul-tackling popcorn ceilings, painting, and creating a stunning, hand-laid fireplace.

programme.title: Anchored in Stone
programme.desc: Rachel and Aaron face a design dilemma when their fireplace grout doesn't go as planned; after a celebratory sunset hike, they dive into personalizing the living room by building custom floating shelves and a record credenza.

programme.title: Collected Chic: Genevieve Gorder's NYC Apartment
programme.desc: Step into Manhattan's Chelsea neighborhood for a look inside designer Genevieve Gorder's home; in her most ambitious project yet, Genevieve combined two neighboring apartments into a singular, soul-filled home for herself and her daughter.

programme.title: Caroline Winkler's Cozy Space in DC
programme.desc: Step inside the charming 600-square-foot Washington, D.C., apartment of interior design YouTuber Caroline Winkler; bathed in natural light, every corner reflects a keen eye for detail and a passion for making a house entirely one's own.

programme.title: Luxurious Parisian Apartment
programme.desc: Welcome to Château Garrow, the fabulous Parisian pied-à-terre of New York-based interior designer Garrow Kedigian; Garrow has masterfully played into the apartment's grand architectural bones—from towering ceilings to original chevron floors.

programme.title: Norman Fenton: The Art of Latin Flavors
programme.desc: Matthew travels to Chicago to meet Michelin-starred Chef Norman Fenton at Cariño; Chef Norman makes fresh dough for his signature Huitlacoche Ravioli; at the bar, Raymond crafts a custom Tejuino cocktail featuring Reserva De La Familia Tequila.

programme.title: Marcela Valladolid: A Chef's Kitchen on the Coast
programme.desc: The one and only Chef Marcela Valladolid invites Matthew for a tour of her stunning historic San Diego home and lush edible garden plus a hands-on lesson in crafting the perfect taco and a signature salsa.

programme.title: Mystery Unlocked
programme.desc: Woodward Throwbacks owners Bo and Kyle acquire Mystery on Mack, a 4,000-square-foot Detroit warehouse that they intend to make their personal home; following intense months of demo, they reveal their first space: a minimal, character-rich bathroom.

programme.title: Raising the Bar
programme.desc: On the first floor, Bo and Kyle create a spectacular custom freestanding bar with a dramatic feature wall; combining Japanese craftsmanship with Detroit history, this one-of-a-kind bar transforms the past into a modern entertainment space.

programme.title: Rust, Relics and Relaxation
programme.desc: Bo reveals the transformation of the Mystery on Mack's living room, where industrial history meets modern design; the team turns salvaged metal panels into a stunning feature wall framed by an elevator door from a historic Detroit building.

programme.title: The Reclaimed Kitchen
programme.desc: Bo and Kyle transform their kitchen into an entertainment hub; centered around a custom 12-foot prep island built from salvaged Lincoln factory timbers and topped with soapstone, the room balances rich textures with local history.

programme.title: Off-Grid Living: The Creative Space
programme.desc: Jillian dives headfirst into an off-grid dream when she meets Chris at his one-of-a-kind Quonset hut in Joshua Tree and gets a crash course in living off the beaten path-without sacrificing style.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time: Fairy Tale Homes
programme.desc: Jillian explores some of the most whimsical homes in Southern California: the famed Hobbit Apartments in Culver City, a home built into a bridge, and a historic Storybook home filled with charm and a storied past.

programme.title: From Cats to Co-Living: A Place for Everyone
programme.desc: Jillian dives into the heart of community living, exploring how we create spaces that bring us-and even our pets-closer together; first, Jillian meets Alan, famously known as "The Catio Guy" and then heads to Cohaus, a vibrant co-living community.

programme.title: Innovation, Design and Style: Modern Marvels
programme.desc: Jillian tours three boundary-pushing homes with a modern twist: the iconic Garduno Heiser treehouse, Los Angeles' first 3D-printed, low-carbon micro-living home and a vibrant modern masterpiece that redefines what it means to live artfully.

programme.title: Living in Art: Kaleidoscopic Homes
programme.desc: Imagine stepping into a kaleidoscope, where colors, shapes, and textures collide; that's exactly what Jillian experiences as she explores the iconic Mosaic Tile House in beachy, boho Venice and the Rainbow House in the desert oasis of Palm Springs.

programme.title: The Science Behind Kitchens & Bedrooms
programme.desc: Designer Julie Couch takes on the science of transforming spaces.

programme.title: The Formula for Small Spaces & Outdoor Living
programme.desc: Designer Julie Couch transforms everything from small rooms to outdoor spaces.

programme.title: The Principles of Space Planning
programme.desc: Designer Julie Couch breaks down the basic formulas for successful design.

programme.title: Festive Thresholds & Holiday Styling Secrets
programme.desc: Designer Ashley Childers kicks off the festive season by transforming her front porch into a classic Christmas showpiece; step-by-step, Ashley reveals how to hang and layer lush garlands; she unpacks her top eight holiday styling secrets.

programme.title: Holiday Hosting Made Simple: Christmas Brunch & DIY Decor
programme.desc: Designer Ashley Childers shares holiday entertaining ideas and DIYs; watch as she builds a snack bar and sets a cozy Christmas brunch table; learn how to prepare her signature mulled wine alongside budget-friendly holiday DIY projects.

programme.title: Rustic Meets Refined
programme.desc: Courtney Cahoon calls Kylie for a DIY House Call to help transform her blank dining room into a warm Mediterranean-inspired gathering space; with lime-washed columns and timeless furniture, Kylie creates a homey, elevated room designed for hosting.

programme.title: Velvet, Vintage & Very Extra
programme.desc: Kylie helps her friend Lucy transform her bedroom into a warm retreat filled with velvet textures and bold personality; from a custom DIY headboard to a dream closet makeover, the space becomes a stylish reflection of Lucy's creative life.

programme.title: This Girls' Room Feels Like a Fairytale

programme.title: Contemporary Containers; Montana's Mountainous Mini Stays

programme.title: Sleek & Scandinavian Cozy Cabins; Tiny Treehouse Overlooks
programme.desc: Levi ventures to Nowhere, an upscale nature retreat outside of Austin, Texas and Tall Stuga, a modern, Scandinavian-themed cabin in eastern Kentucky; he also visits the Georgia mountains where he visits two treehouses perched atop hillsides.

programme.title: Heights of the Evergreen State

programme.title: Lucy Shimmers' Christmas Miracle
programme.desc: Second chances start when a hardened criminal crosses paths with a precocious little girl who is helped by an angel to change hearts during the holiday season.

programme.title: Our Father's Keeper
programme.desc: A successful family man suffering from early onset Alzheimer's wonders away from home and gets lost into the world the day before Thanksgiving, causing widespread panic within his family. He is eventually "rescued" by a fatherless, thirteen-year-old homeless girl. Together, they forge a unique friendship that ultimately heals broken hearts and redefines the meaning of "family".

programme.title: Miracle on Christmas
programme.desc: During the Christmas holiday, Mary (Erin Bethea) experiences emotional trials that cause her to question her faith until a visitor (Brett Varvel) arrives and her husband (Jason Burkey) receives an unexpected miracle.

programme.title: Finding Christmas
programme.desc: Mikey Finnegan, a 17-year-old from Philly, dreams of becoming a pro gamer. After a Christmas Eve attack leaves him in a coma, he travels back to Bethlehem. Guided by a Guardian Angel, he must find baby Jesus to return home.

programme.title: My Son, My Savior
programme.desc: A powerful portrayal of the life of Jesus as seen through the eyes of his mother, Mary. The film imagines Mary's childhood, growing up, celebrating the annual feasts and hearing the prophecies about a coming Messiah who would redeem Israel.

programme.title: The Perfect Gift
programme.desc: A spoiled schoolgirl, her overworked executive mother, and a disillusioned young minister each learns a valuable lesson about community, tradition, and the truest meaning of Christmas from a friendly, but mysterious, drifter named Jess.

programme.title: Shoelaces for Christmas
programme.desc: When Jennifer's father forces her to volunteer at the shelter to teach her compassion and responsibility, she creates an unlikely bond with the staff and a special young guest which makes her realize the true meaning of Christmas.

programme.title: Paper Angels
programme.desc: Abused wife Lynn leaves her alcoholic husband and moves with her children to another town, where their lives become entwined with that of another family in trouble. This film is inspired by the hit country Christmas song, Paper Angels, by Jimmy Wayne.

programme.title: By God's Grace
programme.desc: In the tradition of a classic "A Christmas Carol", this film offers many lessons on the importance of giving and the cause and effect our choices have on others.

programme.title: Hank's Christmas Wish
programme.desc: "Hank's Christmas Wish" tells the heartwarming tale of a retired elf seeking a life of seclusion. However, his plans are interrupted when a group of unrelentingly cheerful townsfolk, brimming with the holiday spirit, come into his life. Through their unwavering kindness and infectious joy, they help him rediscover the true meaning of Christmas. Packed with yuletide laughter, chestnut-roasting moments, and Jack Frost-nipping faith, this cutesy film captures the essence of the holiday season.

programme.title: The Messenger's Box
programme.desc: When high school student Jake Casper finds a small wooden box in the attic of his grandpa's antique store, his life is forever changed, especially when he discovers a secret compartment that appears to contain a nail used during Christ's crucifixion. Now, the more Jake learns of the power within the box and its purpose, the more obstacles he must overcome to get the box to a stranger before it's too late.

programme.title: We Three Kings
programme.desc: Amy, Catherine, and Charles Fay can't wait for their Uncle Henry to arrive for Christmas. This is the first year since Mama passed away and the children are working together to fill the void and put together a Christmas play at their church. With the help of Uncle Henry's new song, "We Three Kings", not only is the Christmas pageant a success, but the children learn truths about Jesus and the gifts that were given to Him by the Magi.

programme.title: The Miracle Of The Cards
programme.desc: There's no such thing as miracles. That's what a skeptical reporter (Kirk Cameron) thought until he met Craig Shergold (Thomas Sangster). Craig is an eight-year-old boy with a brain tumor and less than a year to live. Looking for hope, his mother (Catherine Oxenberg) pushes to break the Guinness World Record for receiving the most get-well cards. They receive an incredible 1.3 million cards and shatter the old record. However Craig continues to get worse.

programme.title: Christmas on Salvation Street
programme.desc: Noah Davis is a Pastor in an affluent community. Depressed after losing his wife to illness, he is contacted by an old friend who has opened a mission in a rough inner city neighborhood. With Christmas approaching, he packs up and together with his two daughters, moves into Salvation Street Mission. Now the family must struggle with the challenges they face in the crime ridden community.

programme.title: Christmas Grace
programme.desc: The story of two rival toy store owners during Christmas time. Gary, who runs an honest business and has a good relationship with his customers and has everything is running smoothly until he hears of a new bigger store.

programme.title: Romance interrumpido
programme.desc: Julieta le aclara a Matilde que es la esposa de don Erasmo, ella se disculpa y sale en busca de Tomás; Fernando le dice a Lety que se siente muy bien con ella y después atiende una llamada de Marcia.

programme.title: Fuera de la oficina
programme.desc: Fernando le cuenta a Omar cómo le fue con Lety; Alicia se queja con Marcia porque Fernando no la deja filmar el comercial y conseguir el dinero que necesita para pagar su deuda.

programme.title: Filmación caótica
programme.desc: Pilar se niega a filmar una subida en un caballo, un guardia impide que Alicia entre al club; don Riquelme y su acompañante le enseñan a don Erasmo a jugar golf.

programme.title: Cambios de último minuto
programme.desc: Gerardo le dice a Fernando que habrá problemas con el color del vestuario de las modelos. Ricardo llega a la locación y presenta a Francisco Riquelme como el cliente del comercial.

programme.title: Plan de diva
programme.desc: Fernando, Ricardo y Gerardo siguen el plan dictado por Luigi; el señor Riquelme y su acompañante llegan al bar con don Erasmo; Alicia espía el cámper de Pilar y Tomás la espía a ella.

programme.title: Sabotaje exitoso
programme.desc: Don Erasmo regaña a Lety por dejar que la abracen y le pide a Fernando que le ayude a cuidarla, pues al parecer anda en malos pasos y Tomás está en el club.

programme.title: Confesiones
programme.desc: Pilar le cuenta a su amiga que Fernando aceptó ser Pavel, pero que se dio cuenta de que ya no lo quiere; Lety cuestiona a Fernando y Pilar le dice lo que le confesó.

programme.title: No más mentiras
programme.desc: Lety intenta que su padre entienda la farsa entre Sara y Fernando, por lo que debe decirle la verdad que le ocultó cuando entró a Conceptos; Fernando le cuenta a Julieta cómo se unió el cuartel para que saliera el comercial.

programme.title: Miedo a volar
programme.desc: Alicia entra a la oficina de Fernando, pero él la corre porque sabe que solo quiere obtener información; Ricardo le da instrucciones a Fernando para cuando estén en Alemania.

programme.title: Afición futbolera
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se hospedan en un hotel en Alemania; en la agencia de publicidad, Fernando y Lety se enteran de que ya se firmó el contrato con otra empresa.

programme.title: El mundial
programme.desc: Marcia escucha las voces de Toño de Valdés y Omar Chaparro y empieza a dudar de Fernando; Lety y Fernando reciben un boleto para el partido de fútbol.

programme.title: Viaje de ensueño
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se la han pasado de maravilla. Sin embargo, don Humberto le reclama a Lety que no se comunicara con ellos y que no le haya enviado el video que le encargó.

programme.title: El sobre misterioso
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar lo nerviosa que se puso Lety cuando la encontró en postproducción y él le sugiere ver el DVD de Lety, quien le encarga a Simón mandar un sobre a Londres.

programme.title: Sólo para mujeres
programme.desc: Marcia se enoja con Fernando porque siente que la está engañando. Alicia se queja con Rubén porque las del cuartel se van a un show solo para mujeres y él le recomienda que las acompañe.

programme.title: La madrastra
programme.desc: Efrén presenta a Jazmín con Cuco y Adrianita, quienes la recuerdan como La Demostradora. A pesar de los problemas con Lola, Efrén le pide que intente mantener una buena relación con los niños.

programme.title: Amor eterno
programme.desc: Alicia logra entrar al show solo para mujeres; Simón, vestido de mujer, es obligado a subir al escenario; los niños destrozan la casa de Efrén y Jazmín lucha con todas sus fuerzas para no enojarse.

programme.title: Desconcierto
programme.desc: Don Erasmo invita a Sánchez y Rosales a tomarse un trago; Lety se desconcierta cuando Fernando no le contesta el teléfono a Marcia; Efrén lleva a los niños a casa de Lola.

programme.title: Inseguridades
programme.desc: Fernando sale a un restaurante con Lety y ella piensa que le da pena que lo vean con ella porque pide una mesa en el lugar más íntimo. Por otro lado, Julieta le pide a la Virgen que proteja a Lety.

programme.title: Obligaciones que cumplir
programme.desc: Lety se niega a hacer el amor con Fernando y le propone que hasta que los dos sean libres para amarse lo hagan. Fernando decide no terminar con Marcia.

programme.title: Enojo y decepción
programme.desc: Marcia recibe un anillo de compromiso por parte de Fernando. Lety descubre la carta que le dejó Omar a Fernando con instrucciones para conquistarla.

programme.title: Por los rincones
programme.desc: Lety descubre que Fernando y Omar prepararon todo para engañarla. Carolina se da cuenta de que Lety está devastada.

programme.title: Historia repetida
programme.desc: Leti le cuenta a Tomás todas las promesas que le hizo Fernando y lo mucho que le duele saber que solo la utilizó.

programme.title: Perro que ladra
programme.desc: Lety le cuenta a Tomás lo que planeó Fernando para enamorarla. Lety recuerda su época en la escuela y su fiesta de quince años.

programme.title: Recuerdos
programme.desc: Lety patea la foto de Fernando en la oficina; Carolina intenta ayudar a Lety a lidiar con sus sentimientos hacia Fernando.

programme.title: Venganza en mente
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Rocío Orozco que Alicia debe mucho dinero y no paga sus deudas; Lety lee en la carta de Omar las indicaciones para Fernando respecto a ella.

programme.title: El show de Yuri
programme.desc: Fernando intenta besar a Lety, pero ella lo esquiva poniendo de pretexto que Celso anda por ahí. En el show de Yuri, Fernando presenta a Lety como su asistente y Alicia logra entrar, fingiendo que conoce a un invitado.

programme.title: Celos
programme.desc: Lola llora al ver a su exesposo con Jazmín. Simón le lleva serenata a Paula María, pero ella no está en su casa.

programme.title: Venganza en acción
programme.desc: Lety escucha los planes de Fernando y Omar para conquistarla. Marcia regresa de Alemania. Tomás Mora y Fernando se conocen.

programme.title: Pagaré
programme.desc: Lety comienza su venganza contra Don Fernando. Con el dinero de Filmo Imagen, Tomás y Lety compran un automóvil último modelo. Fernando está celoso.

programme.title: Por un chocolate
programme.desc: Lety le da celos a Fernando con Tomás. Fernando descubre que Lety utilizó dinero de Filmo Imagen para comprar el auto último modelo.

programme.title: Fiel como un novio
programme.desc: Lety le reclama a Tomás ser tan coqueto con Jazmín y le pide ser fiel con ella ante las del cuartel; Fernando ve a Lety y a Tomás entrando a casa de Lety, pero Julieta le niega todo por orden de Lety.

programme.title: El coche de la discordia
programme.desc: Lety llega a Conceptos en su auto último modelo y causa muchas sospechas. Omar le echa la culpa a Fernando de que Lety ya no esté enamorada.

programme.title: Él paga la cuenta
programme.desc: Lety invita a las del cuartel a comer a un restaurante fino. Omar cuestiona a Lola sobre la bolsa roja que estaba en su escritorio.

programme.title: Fidelidad
programme.desc: Luigi se asombra cuando Celso le dice que el novio de Lety le prestó ese automóvil; Fernando le dice a Omar que no ha tenido relaciones con Marcia desde que estuvo con Lety.

programme.title: La cita
programme.desc: Lety escucha a Omar darle ideas a Fernando para seguir conquistándola y decide que es el momento para vengarse de él.

programme.title: Más premoniciones
programme.desc: Jorge Flores le dice a Fernando que Lety va a perjudicarlo más que ayudarlo, y que mientras siga pensando que la empresa es lo más importante, estará perdido; Tomás convence a Lety de quedarse en el restaurante con Fernando.

programme.title: Morir de deseo
programme.desc: Lety le dice a Fernando que no quiere pasar la noche con él y huye en un taxi. Tomás se lleva el dinero de la caja chica para su cita con Alicia.

programme.title: Tan cerca y tan lejos
programme.desc: Fernando le escribe una carta a Lety y le pregunta si van a seguir juntos. Todos están esperanzados por la nominación de Conceptos en Cannes.

programme.title: Tomás y Alicia
programme.desc: Marcia le enseña las invitaciones de boda a Fernando y le pide a Lety que se haga cargo de repartirlas.

programme.title: De remate
programme.desc: Fernando y Omar escuchan a Lety reclamándole a Tomás por haber tenido una cita con Alicia, quien recibe la noticia de que van a rematar su automóvil y no puede hacer nada para recuperarlo.

programme.title: Mucho trabajo que hacer
programme.desc: Alicia escucha que Tomás está enamorado de Lety y le preocupa que la deje plantada. Luigi amenaza a Jazmín con despedirla si no sigue ensayando, y no deja salir a Irmita porque tienen mucho trabajo.

programme.title: El celoso
programme.desc: Fernando está muerto de celos, sigue a Lety y Tomás en su cita. Por otra parte, Alicia intenta seducir al novio de su peor enemiga.

programme.title: No los conoces
programme.desc: Alicia le cuenta a Tomás sobre sus problemas económicos y él promete ayudarla; Ariel comienza a investigar todo lo relacionado con la empresa fantasma de Lety.

programme.title: ¿Cancelada?
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Lety que cancelará su boda con Marcia, pero la novia todavía no se entera. Por otra parte, Fernando escucha a Alicia quejándose de la apariencia de Tomás. Teresita llega a Conceptos. Lety ve a Marcia con su vestido de novia.

programme.title: Preocupaciones
programme.desc: Irma se siente mal en una prueba de vestuario de Luigi y el diseñador le pide disculpas. Fernando y Omar empiezan a preocuparse por el balance que tiene que hacer Lety. Carolina se da cuenta de que entre Lety y Fernando hay algo más que amistad.

programme.title: Sufre por ella
programme.desc: Irma se recupera rápido gracias a sus amigas del cuartel y a Luigi. Por otro lado, Tomás sufre por estar lejos de Alicia y ella sigue lidiando con sus problemas económicos.

programme.title: Vida solitaria
programme.desc: Irma conmueve a las mujeres del cuartel y a Luigi cuando les cuenta sobre su vida solitaria. Después de su pleito con Fernando, Tomás sale con Alicia, quien lo hace olvidar el dolor.

programme.title: Rafael
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety, pero ella sigue dudando de él; Irma recibe la visita de Rafael, el hombre que la abandonó años atrás, y ella le cuenta todo lo que se perdió.

programme.title: Caminos separados
programme.desc: Lety decide aceptar la oferta de trabajo de Carolina. Don Humberto y Teresita le dicen a Marcia y Fernando que les darán una casa de regalo de bodas.

programme.title: La última
programme.desc: Lety no sabe si hacer o no el balance para la junta del consejo; Luigi termina de preparar la última presentación para Conceptos mientras cuida que Irma no se canse mucho.

programme.title: Celebración
programme.desc: Marcia hace todo lo posible para averiguar la identidad de la amante de Fernando; el equipo celebra el premio obtenido en Cannes; Ana Leticia intenta enamorar al Borrego Nava.

programme.title: Reencuentro
programme.desc: Ariel se entera de todos los problemas financieros de Conceptos; Fernando y Lety celebran el premio de Cannes; Alicia le prepara una cena romántica a Tomás.

programme.title: Primera noche
programme.desc: Alicia hace todo lo posible para que Tomás le dé el dinero que necesita; Lety y Fernando están muy nerviosos por la próxima junta de consejo.

programme.title: Se acabó el cheque en blanco
programme.desc: Cuando Lety se entera de los gastos de Tomás, decide quitarle la chequera de la empresa; Ariel hace todo lo posible para comprobar el verdadero estado financiero de Conceptos.

programme.title: La carta
programme.desc: Lety lee la carta de Omar donde describe todo el plan para no perder Conceptos conquistando a Lety. La junta de consejo, Lety y Marcia tienen un fuerte desacuerdo.

programme.title: Junta de consejo
programme.desc: Toda la verdad sale a la luz en la junta de consejo; Lety presenta el balance, Ariel revela el tema del embargo y Fernando se ve obligado a explicar al comité cómo fue que se endeudó y para qué creó Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: Vergonzosa despedida
programme.desc: Lety se despide de sus amigas del cuartel; Marcia le exige que le muestre lo que se lleva y descubre todas las tarjetas que Fernando le escribió.

programme.title: Sin amor
programme.desc: Teresita intenta tranquilizar a Marcia diciéndole que nada de lo que Fernando hizo con Lety fue por amor; Fernando le dice a Omar por qué piensa que Lety los delató.

programme.title: Lágrimas al mar
programme.desc: Marcia le informa a Carolina sobre la cancelación de la boda; Lety las escucha y se culpa por todo lo que está pasando.

programme.title: La miserable
programme.desc: Irma busca pretextos para no regresar a casa, pero Luigi insiste en llevarla; Omar le dice a Fernando que no le gusta nada el hecho de que Lety haya desaparecido.

programme.title: Casarse con el mar
programme.desc: Luigi le pide a Irma que le cuente la historia de su vida con Rafael; Carolina se molesta con Lety porque le dice que quiere regresar a la ciudad; Lety se encuentra un anillo y hace un ritual con el mar.

programme.title: Espíritu intranquilo
programme.desc: Fernando mira con tristeza la oficina de Lety. Aldo le cuenta a Lety por qué se distanció de su padre y le dice que ve en ella un corazón con mucho dolor. Julieta se niega a darle a Fernando información sobre Lety.

programme.title: Con la muerte tan cerca
programme.desc: Irmita les da noticias a sus compañeros de trabajo: el doctor dice que Rafael puede morir en cualquier momento.

programme.title: Transformada
programme.desc: Aldo le dice a Carolina lo sorprendido que está con el cambio de Lety. Marcia se molesta al saber que Lety salió de la ciudad y se burla de Fernando, pero él le confirma que está enamorado de Leticia.

programme.title: Nuestra belleza
programme.desc: Fernando se molesta con Omar y le pide que deje de ponerle apodos denigrantes a Leticia; Lety ayuda a las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza a repasar sus conocimientos generales.

programme.title: Cuestión de confianza
programme.desc: Las concursantes de Nuestra Belleza le agradecen a Lety por darles confianza y Aldo la felicita por compartir lo que aprendió con él; Jorge le hace una visita a Rafael.

programme.title: No te rindas
programme.desc: Tomás se niega a decirle a Julieta por qué Lety abrió Filmo Imagen y embargó a Conceptos; Teresita le pide a Marcia no darse por vencida con Fernando.

programme.title: Ideales
programme.desc: Aldo le confiesa a Lety que su padre se molestó con él por convertirse en chef en lugar de ingeniero y ella le expresa su admiración por ser fiel a sus ideales; Fernando busca a Lety en el bar de un hotel.

programme.title: Sin ti
programme.desc: Fernando está desesperado sin Leticia; Lety le confiesa a Aldo que no puede dejar de pensar en Fernando.

programme.desc: Lindsey reaches her breaking point; Brittany's search for her mom takes a surprising turn; Destinie's revelation threatens her court date; Andrea's bold move risks everything with Lamar.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Payback Is a Snitch
programme.desc: Destinie goes rogue before court; Lindsey and Scott face off; Shane confronts Lacey when she lies about her ex; Amber tempts Puppy with a sexy night out.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Inmates & Playdates
programme.desc: John flirts with a dangerous temptation; Sarah's date is in jeopardy when she makes a shocking confession; Brittany gives her mom a surprising offer; Quaylon tries to win Shavel back, but her family has doubts; Amber's torn with a secret lover.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Good News, Bad News
programme.desc: John makes a shocking discovery about Lacey; Andrea faces Lamar's daughter; Kristianna has big news that changes everything; Scott uncovers the truth about Lindsey; Brittany's mom breaks down; Quaylon's bold move stuns Shavel.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Trick or Cheat?
programme.desc: Lacey's dad faces off with her ex; Shawn demands answers from Destinie; Puppy uncovers the shocking truth about her adoption; Amber is haunted by an old scam; John's sister-in-law makes trouble; Brittany takes a stand.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: It's Tow or Never
programme.desc: Shawn stuns Destinie when he makes an unexpected move; Quaylon faces off with his nemesis, Dmark; a crime trio reunites when Puppy plots revenge on Vince; Brittany is shocked by her mom's confession; Michael cozies up at Sarah's, but Emmy objects.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: 30 Day Fiancé
programme.desc: Shavel demands a wedding in 30 days, but Quaylon has doubts when their family objects; Kristianna's troubling suspicion about her husband and sister is sparked by her mom's shocking claim; John battles a risky temptation when he's burned by Lacey.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Dirty Little Secrets
programme.desc: Kristianna plans to have a risky rendezvous; Quaylon makes a shocking discovery; Andrea's Mormon friends question her faith; Amber is conflicted when faced with a surprise from her past; Shawn fears his relationship may have cost him his family.

programme.title: Life After Lockup: Life, Death, or Prison
programme.desc: Kristianna confronts her sister and husband about some shocking rumors; Andrea's birthday blowup with her Mormon friend causes a stir; Michael surprises Sarah; Destinie and Shawn expose revealing secrets; Shavel and Quaylon spiral out of control.

programme.title: Cheap Thrills & Big Dills
programme.desc: An ex-guard awaits her forbidden lover's prison release; Rachel's bad boy obsession worries her friends; Daonte's revelation stuns his mom; Britney keeps her inmate boyfriend a secret; Stan fears his prison girlfriend may not look like her pictures.

programme.title: Sugar Daddy or Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Josh is a reborn virgin at his release; Lisa shocks Stan with a big request; Britney's confession stuns her family; Daonte drops big bucks when he picks up his fiancée, Nicolle.

programme.title: Freak in the Sheets
programme.desc: Britney panics when Ray's release takes a shocking turn; Nicolle's secret complicates Daonte's big sex-pectations; Lisa's surprising confession leaves Stan worried if she'll show up; Rachel meets her husband in the free world.

programme.title: Imaginary Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Rachel and Doug consummate their prison wedding with a sexy reunion; Lisa's devastating call sends Stan into a rage; friends doubt Anissa's felon fiancé is real; Daonte crumbles when Nicolle's mom grills him, and he spills a shocking secret.

programme.title: Third Time's the Charm?
programme.desc: Nicolle keeps a scandalous secret; Stan loses it on Lisa and makes a shocking accusation; after 11 years waiting for Jeff, Anissa fears he may be a no-show for the third time; Doug reunites with his son, but gets grilled by his mother-in-law.

programme.title: The Halfway Handoff
programme.desc: Doug risks parole when a family feud breaks out; Nicolle's shocking confession stuns Daonte; Stan begs for forgiveness, but Lisa has demands; Britney is stunned when she's not the only woman at Ray's release; Anissa gets a devastating call.

programme.title: Sex Dolls & Booty Calls
programme.desc: Lisa's risky run-in with the cops spells trouble; Daonte's mom grills Nicolle; Jeff keeps a secret from Anissa; Courtney plans her wedding, but fears her relationship is on the rocks; Britney learns she's not the only woman fighting for Ray's love.

programme.title: Warriors of Kung Fu
programme.desc: Two brothers rendered blind and dumb by Chang must learn crippled kung fu, and with the help of a vengeful warrior lady set out to take on the gang and their villainous leader. Two sons of the head of gangsters and an expertise Kung Fu master, comes to Canton and kills Yu-Sing. In this incident, Yu's one son, Yu-Yung loses his eye-sight and his brother, Yu-Ho becomes dumb. They have to be trained in special cripple-Kung Fu. The two sons leave Canton to Fuchow to take revenge on the gangsters.

programme.title: Challenge of the Lady Ninja
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, a Chinese woman trains in the covert arts. When she arrives in Hong Kong, she learns that her brother fights for the Japanese cause. Soon she pulls together a team of women warriors to stop her brother.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 2
programme.desc: The fierce battle between Iemitsu and Tadanaga is getting more heated. Jubei leads a team on an ambush, which turns out to be a trap with dire consequences.

programme.title: Dragon Against Vampire
programme.desc: Terror from beyond the grave. Explicit sadistic sexuality. A fabric of perversion and witchcraft. Three friends rob a grave and evoke the wrath of a powerful practitioner of black magic, the Black Dragon, who is seeking the book of Shaolin Sorcery Martial Arts. Unknown to Tony, the surviving gang member, he has a magical power which, if given the right training, will overcome Black Dragon and his sadistic vampiric tendencies.

programme.title: Dragon's Snake Fist
programme.desc: Two competing kung fu schools, the Dragon Fist and the Jeet-Kune, battle it out for supremacy, with technique after technique being employed to get the upper hand. Will Snake Fist Lee vanquish the deadly Golden Needles of his arch-enemy Ho and bring honor to his clan? A duel to the death is the only inevitability!

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub: Episode 9
programme.desc: Lord Retsudou ordered teams of assassins to kill Ogami. The lone wolf made new allies and now he must fight his way through this journey full of betrayals and deceits.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub-Assassin on the Road to Hell (Kozure Ohkami)
programme.desc: The tale of Ogami Itto and his son Daigoro has come full circle with the greatest sword actor of all time, Wakayama Tomisaburo now playing Lone Wolf's mortal enemy, the evil Lord Yagyu Retsudo, who masterminded Ogami's fall from grace. Brilliant sword actor Takahashi Hideki takes over as the former shogunate decapitator, and his stunning swordsmanship is second to none! The story of Lone Wolf and Child has been told many times, but never before like this.

programme.title: Iron Fisted Eagle Claw
programme.desc: Kung Fu superstars Chi Kuan Chun and Bruce Liang, star in this brilliant kung fu flick. Local gangster San gets arrested by Police Officer Liu. While San's accomplices try to free him, the two rascals Chu and Pan foil their plan. Unfortunately, San still finds a way to escape and swears revenge on Liu and his family. Liu's wife gets murdered, Liu gets kidnapped and only Chu and Pan can save the day, but have to face the might of Chen Sing's deadly iron fist.

programme.title: 52 Masters: LOOKING BACK: Eps. 1-10
programme.desc: Will takes a look back at what he's learned so far- both on and off the training mat.

programme.title: Ninja vs Shaolin Guards aka Guards of Shaolin
programme.desc: Another action packed masterpiece from Robert Tai. After the Abbot of Shaolin is killed by their traitorous teacher a band of student monks embark on a mission to return the Golden Sutra to Tibet. They are joined on their quest by a beautiful female warrior - who aims to avenge her father's death. They traverse forests and mountains and weather challenges, all the while the students fight off deadly ninja assassins, vicious gangsters and even the undead.

programme.title: Cobra Against Ninja
programme.desc: Three best friends from the ninja army training school become embroiled in a gambling racket run by the Triads, which involve their former ninja instructor in ever more vicious battles against increasingly more powerful foes. With the law tailing their every move, Gordon and Cobra must fight their ultimate Ninja battle for the honor of the Ninja Empire.

programme.title: The Invincible
programme.desc: The infamous "Red Dragon" and his Mongolian counterparts invade China and massacre countless people. The situation looks terrible but then a hero emerges who wants to defy the Red Dragon; Li Mu-Bai (Wang Yu), the Invincible!

programme.title: 52 Masters: JKD KNIFE GRAPPLING with Burton Richardson
programme.desc: Guro Burton Richardson trains Will in combat self-defense techniques.

programme.title: Thunder Kids 1- Golden Adventure
programme.desc: The race for a treasure becomes and incredible free-for-all! The search for a priceless golden statue draws four groups of people together in an incredible and hilarious race against Ninjas to claim the treasure.

programme.title: Dynamite Shaolin Heroes: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 5
programme.desc: After the fall of the Ming Dynasty, China is thrown into turmoil. The loyalists seek the return of Ming; the government is determined to stay in power. The only difference between the two is one saves lives, while the other takes it away.

programme.title: Bruce Lee against Supermen aka Superdragon vs Superman
programme.desc: Scientist Dr. Ting has invented a secret formula that will help the world's food crisis, but refuses an offer to sell it. When Dr. Ting is kidnapped by a sinister organization, Alice's boyfriend, the renowned crime fighter Kato (Bruce Li) is called in to rescue him. However, Kato realizes he cannot fight alone and enlists the help of his two superhero friends collectively known as "The Green Hornet".

programme.title: Crystal Fist aka Jade Claw
programme.desc: After Wang Chen-Kang, a Kung Fu master of the "Shadow Gate School" is killed, his only son Wang Tsung-Wen (Billy Chong) is accepted as a pupil in the Cheong Hsing Martial Art School, working in the kitchen to pay for his lessons, he finds that the cook, Chang Tien Hsiang (Simon Yuen) is a veteran "Shadow Gate Boxer". His enemies join forces to take revenge on Chang, raid the school and beat up Wang. Chang is impressed by the by the boy's courage and agrees to teach him his Kung Fu skills.

programme.title: Bravest Fist: Sho Kosugi Ninja Theatre Vol. 2-WITHDRAWN
programme.desc: After intimidating numerous towns and bullying the residents, Chan Wai Man goes on a fierce attack against the thugs responsible.

programme.title: 8 Strikes of the Wildcat
programme.desc: A superb Wu Tang gem. Hard hitting action! Mouse and Mole, collectively known as the Three Rats, are looking for a two part treasure map and will kill anyone who gets close to them. A young girl named Shao Wa, seeks to avenge the murder of her father, and in order to defeat the Rats, she must learn the "Eight Strikes of the Wild Cat" from an old Kung Fu Master, while trying to evade his amorous assistant, Lee Ta Fa. A kung fu shapes classic!

programme.title: Call Me Dragon
programme.desc: Golden Sand City is filled with brothels and casinos funded by drug lord Yim Kung Ho (evil Mr. Yem) and policed by the iron fist of his henchman Panther (Yasuaki Kurata). Vigilantes Inspector Big Dragon (Bruce Liang), Little Mouse, and Black Cat plan to bring Yum Kung Ho and his evil empire to its knees, but face fierce opposition in the deadly Panther, who has the stolen pearls sought after by Big Dragon and his new ally a deadly China doll named Mei Ling.

programme.title: Ways of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A hapless student (Chi Kuan-Chun) is cast out of the Shaolin Temple after he suffers numerous humiliations at the hands of a deceitful monk. He is left to travel the countryside and along the way encounters a variety of Martial Arts masters. Over time, he masters the Ways of Kung Fu and returns to expose the evil monk. Training and martial arts mayhem follows.

programme.title: Thundering Ninja
programme.desc: A Ninja Organization and the C.I.A. are fighting each other for the plans of a missile.

programme.title: Warriors of Budo Episode Three: Aikido
programme.desc: "The only answer to aggression is love and harmony" he would say. The practice of Aikido continues today with his grandson Moriteru Ueshiba who inherited the title of Doshu. At his morning class which begins at dawn, Doshu teaches Irimi-nage, bringing the founders concepts alive. As the attacker moves forward to strike, he is not stopped. Instead Doshu avoids conflict by entering to his side, and in turning to face the same direction they harmonize.

programme.title: Ninja Operation - Knight and Warrior
programme.desc: Alvin, an anti-narcotic agent for Interpol, is on a mission to nail the key man in an international drugs ring. When his wife is murdered Alvin tracks Rudolf to Hong Kong and is sure to look up his long-time friend Gordon, a hard boiled cop who believes in 'an eye for an eye, violence against violence.' Together they combine their expert combat skills to take on the gangs in a bloody showdown.

programme.title: Shogun's Samurai Episode 4
programme.desc: "Iemitsu has been instated as Shogun, but there are still forces that want to target him. The Yagyus must now protect him from a ruthless ninja clan known as The Onibis"

programme.title: Shaolin Deadly Kicks
programme.desc: One of Flash Legs Tan's best films! A band of thieves, known as the Eight Dragons, commit murder in the process of a stealing a treasure map. They decide three years is long enough for the heat to die down and allow them to search for their hidden fortune. But none of the thieves trusts any of his brothers-in-crime to keep the map that long. Their leader's solution is to cut the map into eight pieces, one for each bandit. Meanwhile, a pair of relentless lawmen is after them.

programme.title: 52 Masters: MACHIDA KARATE with Chinzo Machida
programme.desc: Sensei Ford takes a class in the Machida style of karate under Chinzo Machida.

programme.title: Buddhist Fist and Tiger Claws
programme.desc: It's all out fists and claws kung fu action! 'Tiger Claws' Lau Fong steals a large quantity of gold bars from the Imperial Court, but a rival gang, The Flash Foxes, headed by 'Buddhist Fist' Kao Pa, vow to grab the gold from Lau's Black Tiger Gang at all costs.

programme.title: Men of the Hour
programme.desc: Shang Li runs away for he's suspected of murder. While the hunters search for him, they think of the murder suspect, and just maybe Shang Li is innocent? Isn't there someone else around with a much better reason to commit that murder? This takes us into the second half of the movie where a lot more kung fu fighting takes place than in the first.

programme.title: Ninja Terminator
programme.desc: The hunt is on to gain the fabulous super-strength of the ninja sorcery, after three top students of the Ninja Empire each steals one of the sections of the Golden Ninja Warrior statuette. On the case is Interpol agent, Jaguar Wong, who must make sure that whoever re-unites the pieces uses the power for doing good and not evil.

programme.title: Boxer's Last Stand
programme.desc: In this gripping tale of double revenge featuring some of the most brutal fighting you've ever seen, only one man, Chai Sing, holds the key to stopping this relentless evil.

programme.title: Martial Arts History Museum Biography: Michael Matsuda
programme.desc: This unique biography looks at the founder and president of the Martial Arts History Museum, Michael Matsuda. As a fifty-plus-year veteran of the martial arts, he lived through many historical events in martial arts history. A former publisher of Martial Art Magazine, Matsuda shares what it took to start the museum, what challenges he encounters and the steps he took to create the world's first and only museum dedicated to the martial arts.

programme.title: Ninja of the Magnificence
programme.desc: Ross, Farris and Lee are star pupils of the Ninja Master, but Ross is secretly building his own ninja empire and dealing in the slave trade, headed by two slave masters Old Fox and Kong. When Ross kills the master, the two brothers must battle their way through an army of ninjas to bring the wrongdoers to justice.

programme.title: Ninja in Action
programme.desc: A ninja fighter and his American girlfriend journey to Hong Kong in search of the man who murdered her father.

programme.title: Wild Panther
programme.desc: An action-filled martial arts film in which guerilla fighters and foreign spies clash in kung fu combat when important military secrets are at stake.

programme.title: Buddha Assassinator aka Buddha Killer
programme.desc: Lord Tsoi of the Manchus (Hwang Jang Lee) has used his Buddhist Fist expertise to destroy a great many Ming patriots. While visiting a temple, he is ambushed by a group of Ming freedom fighters, but is rescued by a naive kung fu fanatic, Shao Hai (Meng Hoi). In gratitude, Lord Tsoi makes Shao Hai his personal guard and educates him in the Buddhist Fist. Shao Hai, however, is also the student of his a Ming monk (Chien Yuet San) and disciple of the Buddhist Palm technique.

programme.title: 52 Masters: JINEN KAI with Chad Eagan
programme.desc: Sensei Ford trains with some beach kata, then comes back to the dojo for serious conditioning.

programme.title: Art of the Japanese Sword
programme.desc: The Japanese sword ... prized as much for its exceptional beauty as for its deadly cutting ability. It has endured for a thousand years as the pinnacle of Japanese culture. Now you can enter a world rarely seen by outsiders. To experience the true story of the Art of the Samurai Sword. A story told in the swordsmiths own words that separate the myth from the fact. Follow the swordsmiths dream of creating a masterpiece.

programme.title: Masters Of Attack
programme.desc: The real hard work for a physically powerful predator is in working out a strategy for attack.

programme.title: Devious Defenses
programme.desc: Whatever strategy an animal uses to withstand an attack, they will do what it takes to survive the wild.

programme.title: Rules Of The Realm
programme.desc: For many species the possession of territory is the ultimate goal. With good territory comes plentiful food, access to shelter, attraction to mates and safety to raise offspring - all tremendous strategic advantages in the wild. For a territorial species, their territory is their kingdom. Those that want it will stop at nothing to get it, and those that have it will fight fiercely to defend it.

programme.title: Nature's World Wide Web
programme.desc: To provide an edge to survive in their habitats, some animals have developed techniques that allow them to share information. Communication represents one of the most versatile and widely used strategies in the animal world. In both social and solitary species it is the transfer of information that lies at the heart of so many behaviours in the wild. For those that harness the power of communication, the advantage is theirs.

programme.title: Cunning Copulation
programme.desc: From microscopic single celled organisms to the largest animals on the planet, one goal is shared by all living things: to reproduce. For many creatures, finding a suitable mate to pass on strong genes and rear young that will survive to adulthood is a challenge that is met with a variety of strategies. In this episode we will observe the creative tactics animals employ to find the best mates and to win them over.

programme.title: Africa's Lost Wilderness - Kenya and the Big Animals
programme.desc: This documentary explores the displacement of lions, elephants and other big game animals from the savannas of Kenya. It is also an intimate depiction of the people who still strive to live in harmony with the natural world.

programme.title: Megeti - Africa's Lost Wolf
programme.desc: The story of the Ethiopian she-wolf Megeti, who lost her pack and is suddenly completely on her own. Since it is essential for the survival of the young wolf to rejoin a pack, she wanders through the Ethiopian highlands in search of a new home.

programme.title: Maasai Mara, The Big Cats Sanctuary
programme.desc: Wildebeest, zebra, antelope and gazelle roam the savannah. The herds, along with their cubs, are seen as the perfect food source for predatory big cats, such as lions, cheetahs and leopards.

programme.title: Go Ape
programme.desc: Having a look at different species of primates, how they live, feed and survive, as well as looking at the similarities between apes and humans.

programme.title: Uganda Through the Eyes of a Chimp
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating country of Uganda from the perspective of an endearing alpha male chimpanzee named Toti, who strives to protect his community and keep it together.

programme.desc: Journey into remote parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth about notorious snakes, toucans, howler monkeys and tapirs.

programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross and his loyal men take on what they think is a routine assignment: a covert operation to invade the South American country of Vilena and overthrow its dictator. But, when they learn that the job will be a suicide mission, they must choose redemption or the destruction of their brotherhood.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Mercenary leader Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone), Lee Christmas (Jason Statham) and the rest of the Expendables team reunite when Mr. Church (Bruce Willis) hires them for a seemingly easy job. But things go terribly wrong, compelling the mercenaries to seek revenge for a comrade's murder. With the odds against them, Barney and his team are hell-bent on payback and cut a path of destruction through opposing forces, only to encounter an unexpected threat: six pounds of weapons-grade plutonium.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Years ago, Barney Ross co-founded the Expendables with Conrad Stonebanks. After Stonebanks became an arms dealer, Ross was forced to kill him -- or so he thought. Now, Stonebanks is back, and he's on a mission to end the Expendables. Ross decides that the way to fight old blood is with new blood, so he assembles a team of younger, faster, more tech-savvy recruits. The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

programme.title: The Pearl
