programme.title: A Comforting Casserole
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Slow Cooking
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: My Italian American
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Summertime Fun
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Simply Lidia
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Simple Weekday Dinner Ideas
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: From Italy to America
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Fall's Flavorful Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: The Sweetest Hits
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: QUICK AND DELICIOUS BRAISES
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: A Frugal Feast
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Buonavia
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: My Family's Milk and Cheese
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Southern Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: The Vegetable Patch
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad

programme.title: BRAISING SMALLER CUTS
programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. She then makes a heartwarming Braised Chicken Thigh dish with Potatoes and Olives, a family favorite. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Cooking with Wine
programme.desc: Italians love to drink wine with their meals and cook with it as well. In this episode, Lidia shares a meal where wine plays a part of each delicious dish: Sausage Crostini: a toasted piece of bread topped with sweet Italian sausage and topped with taleggio cheese; Linguine with White Clam Sauce: a simple white wine clam sauce served with linguine pasta; Braised Beef Rolls: stuffed beef rolls oozing with the flavors of prosciutto, provolone and golden raisins served in a red wine tomato sauce.

programme.title: Trio of Heartwarming Pasta
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta! In this episode, Lidia starts with the simplest- a Spaghettini with Olive Oil and Rosemary, then moves on to a hearty dish of Tagliatelle with Metaballs and eggplant, and finishes with a delicious whole wheat pasta - Baked Whole Wheat Penne with Ceci Beans.

programme.title: What's For Dinner?
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: The Dinner Dance
programme.desc: Kale salad with avocado and pistachios; marinara sauce; no-mess cheesy baked chicken wings.

programme.title: Growing up Italian
programme.desc: Lidia talks about growing up and family traditions in this episode. Featured recipes include Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a Roasted Garlic Crostini and Papperdelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms. A refreshing "Panache" is shared with her mother Erminia.

programme.title: Everything Rice
programme.desc: Today is all about rice, and Lidia teaches viewers how to master the technique of making risotto. She starts with an Italian classic, Risotto with Mushrooms; next is Red Onions Stuffed with Rice. No food should be wasted, and Lidia shows viewers how to use risotto leftovers by making Fried Risotto.

programme.title: All in the Skillet
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Great Grains
programme.desc: Grains are back in style, yet Italians have been using them for centuries. Lidia shares some of her favorite grain based recipes in this episode including: Risotto with Mushrooms; Barley, Kale & Butternut Squash Risotto; and Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savory Cabbage.

programme.title: All About Chicken
programme.desc: This episode features a "Best of Chicken" with some of Lidia's favorite dishes from the oven to the stovetop. Recipes include a succulent Roasted Chicken; a simple and earthy Seared Chicken Breast with Mushrooms; and finally a dish with a little kick - Paprika Drumsticks with Peppers.

programme.title: Steak House Favorites
programme.desc: Steak is a favorite in many American households, and this episode is a tribute to the nice juicy dish and showcase not only one of Lidia's preferred preparations but two other recipes that work well for a special steak house evening at home. Featured recipes include Seared Steak with Mushroom Sauce and Braised Escarole; Baked Potatoes with Pancetta and Oregano; and an Almond Cake with Chocolate Chips.

programme.title: A Winter Garden
programme.desc: Italians love their seasons, and they know how to make delicious soups, salads and pastas with fall and winter vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares some winter garden menu ideas including a spicy Escarole and White Bean Soup, a unique and delicious Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens and a Cabbage Salad made with warm bacon dressing.

programme.title: Simply Dining In
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: GNOCCHI
programme.desc: If there were another name for Lidia's family, it would be the gnocchi family. They love making them together AND eating them. Lidia starts with a Butternut Squash Gnocchi that is as soft as a feather and served with a velvety sage and butter sauce. Next, she prepares a Marinated Bread of Chicken Seared with Shiitake Mushrooms, Rosemary and Sage. Her sautéed earthy Brussels Sprouts are made with pepperoncino, garlic and walnuts. They are nutty AND spicy.

programme.title: Corn: From the Kernel to the Husk
programme.desc: Today's episode is all about corn. Lidia often played in corn fields, helped with the harvests, and even slept on mattresses made from husks. Recipes for today include a refreshing Corn and Zucchini Minestra, a sweet and savory Polenta Cacio e Pere, and a combination of vegetables that can be served as a side dish or even the highlight of the dinner table- Grilled Corn, Apricots, and Portobellos.

programme.title: Switch up the Spice
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: Weeknight Dinner
programme.desc: Simple recipes are a must for weeknight dinners, and Lidia always looks for those that that deliver a burst of flavor. In this episode, she will share some of her favorite quick weeknight dinner ideas. She starts with a Sausage Crostini, made of sweet Italian sausage topped with Taleggio cheese. She then prepares a Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce; an iconic creamy Italian American pasta dish and then Arugula Salad with Porcini Mushroom & Shavings of Cheese.

programme.title: Simply Salads
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a colourful summer panzanella with roasted zucchini and onions, and a warm shrimp and squash ribbon salad.

programme.title: Savor The Moment
programme.desc: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

programme.title: Family Brunch
programme.desc: Today Lidia shares some new show-stopping dishes for the perfect family style brunch that include Crostata with Kale Butternut Squash and Ricotta - made of a flaky dough filled with a creamy colorful mix of ricotta, kale, butternut squash and golden raisins. Carrot and Orange Salad is the next item on the menu-a bright dish that adds color to any meal. Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: More Italian Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American classics have always been favorites at the family table and in this episode, there is reason to celebrate. Today's recipes include the most iconic Italian American dish, Spaghetti and Meatballs; a Broccoli Rabe with Garlic; and a holiday must - Zeppole.

programme.title: Restaurant Inspiration
programme.desc: Fresh pasta with pear and pecorino is a restaurant favorite at Felidia, and Lidia shows how to take that flavor combination and use it in a risotto. She also demonstrates Short Ribs Braised in Barolo with Orzo.

programme.title: Finding the Balance
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: I Love Eggs
programme.desc: Lidia loves eggs, and in this episode, she shares four super simple recipes that feature this amazing ingredient that Lidia recalls fondly from her own grandmother's courtyard in Istria. Oregano Eggs and Anchovy Frittata are delicious appetizers or main courses. The Rustic Salad is a great meal idea with lots of complex textures and flavors. For a sweet finish, Lidia whips up Zabaglione with Fresh Fruit.

programme.title: Fruit Desserts
programme.desc: Fruit desserts have always been an Italian tradition; they are simple, delicious and the perfect way to showcase nature's bounty. In this episode, the Lidia highlights some of her fans' preferred seasonal sweets with: Strawberries with Balsamic Vinegar, a light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Fresh Fruit; juicy Nectarines and Blueberries in Prosecco and a Plum Crostata, a free form Italian tart with juicy plums.

programme.title: Fruits and Sweets
programme.desc: In Lidia's courtyard, the fruit trees would blossom with flowers in spring. In the summer, it was time to play around the trees and wait for the fruit to ripen. Today, Lidia prepares a Fig and Prosciutto Bruschetta, a delicious combination of sweet and salty. She then transforms wafer cookies into Quick & Easy Truffles. Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.title: Colorful Inspiration
programme.desc: Panzanella with fennel and shrimp; orange and tropea onion salad; green salad with apples and provolone; cabbage salad with speck.

programme.title: Italian Taste for Bitter Vegetables
programme.desc: Italy is one big garden with a year round growing season. Vegetables are often the stars of the meal, and today Lidia will highlight the versatility of delicious bitter vegetables like broccoli rabe, radicchio and escarole.

programme.title: Never Enough Pasta
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Chocolate and Dinner
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares some of her favorite chocolate desserts and one deliciously creamy risotto recipe. First, she makes a Chocolate Hazelnut Bread Parfait, a special treat she had growing up. Lidia then makes a soft and creamy spoon dessert, Chocolate Zabaglione. Lastly, she prepares a rich and smooth Risotto with Artichokes, Sunchokes, and Mint.

programme.title: Foraging Adventures
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia would forage for ingredients that were not produced in the courtyard, garden, or field. Ingredients that were foraged included asparagus, mushrooms, clams, and mussels, and this seasonal adventure was always extremely exciting. Lidia begins with a hearty Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu. She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Seafood Symphony
programme.desc: Lidia has enjoyed clamming with the locals in Le Marche as well as in Long Island, and in this episode she shares two of her most popular dishes: Pappa al Pomodoro with Clams is based on the Tuscan classic-tomato and bread soup. Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Best of Zucchini
programme.desc: Zucchini sautéed with garlic, anchovies and capers; fried zucchini; orecchiette with clams and zucchini; sweet-and-sour zucchini.

programme.title: Restaurant's Greatest hits
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her flagship restaurant's favorite recipes that can be made at home. They include "gnudi" (Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings); and a flavorful Whole Roasted Branzino. She'll also be talking "restaurant secrets" with some of her chefs in this episode.

programme.title: Keep it Fresh
programme.desc: Shrimp and melon salad with basil mint pesto; peaches in white wine; mezze rigatoni with raw tomato sauce.

programme.title: The Fresh Catch
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table and today, Lidia shares a simple menu for a party based around fish. In the summertime, she likes to turn on the grill and make Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini with Tomato Salsa. She serves them with Seared Salmon Paillards with Arugula Salad; and finally, Cody Hogan from Lidia's Kansas City joins Lidia in the kitchen and they make Monkfish Meatballs served in tomato sauce.

programme.title: Soups On
programme.desc: Soups are a delicious and comforting way to warm up especially in the winter months. On the menu today is Spicy Italian Soup, Calabria's version of vegetable soup; The Perfect Simple Salad, a simple and light side that works for any kind of soup; and an easy-to-make Butternut Squash Soup, garnished with crispy crumbled bacon.

programme.title: Bread & Beans
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: My Goats & Ricotta
programme.desc: Lidia grew up around goats, who loved to play and run, but also produced the most delicious milk which would then be used to make ricotta. Here she makes light and pillowy "Naked" Spinach and Ricotta Dumplings. She then prepares an easy, sweet Open Cookie Cannoli. Finally, her Ricotta Meatloaf is topped with tomato sauce to give it some Italian flair.

programme.title: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Lidia tosses arborio rice with olives, roasted peppers, artichokes, and provolone to create a satisfying and vibrant "Antipasto" Rice Salad. She also pulls together a Sauteed Chicken dressed in a Bright Lemon Caper Sauce over Spinach.

programme.title: BRAISING
programme.desc: There are few things better than a great piece of meat braised in Barolo wine. When accompanied by some braised vegetables, you've got yourself a great meal. In this episode, Lidia prepares a crispy golden Italian Style Quiche followed by a fork tender Beef Braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a Braised Broccoli Rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil. This is a meal any family will love.

programme.title: Tried & True
programme.desc: Four cheese baked macaroni with asparagus and peas; cider vinegar spritz; spicy vinegar ribs and potatoes.

programme.title: Heartwarming Favorites
programme.desc: Today, Lidia creates the ultimate heartwarming dinner table filled with dishes that deliver flavor, comfort and love in every bite. She starts with a soothing Rice and Lentil Soup topped with cheese and olive oil; Roasted Olives with Orange and Rosemary are an exciting accompaniment to any meal and Ricotta Meatloaf, a family favorite packed with cheese and topped with fresh tomato sauce and even more cheese, is the star of the show.

programme.title: SEARED STEAK
programme.desc: When talking about a juicy steak, grilling often comes to mind but for Lidia, it's all about the sear. In today's episode, Lidia begins with a crispy Montasio Cheese Frico stuffed with potatoes and onions. She then makes a Seared Steak with a perfectly balanced sauce of rosemary, shallots and mixed mushrooms. Her side dish is a Braised Escarole with olive oil, pepperoncino and garlic -simple and delicious.

programme.title: A Fruitful Meal
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: An Italian Lunchbox
programme.desc: Shaved fennel, red onion and prosciutto cotto salad; cherry jam tart with wild cherries from the Emilia Romagna region of Italy; prosciutto, scallion and egg sandwich.

programme.title: My Fruit Trees
programme.desc: The fig tree at Lidia's current home reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. This brings back memories of eating the sweet fruits grown on the trees and playing amongst them. Recipes in this episode include a Roasted Pork Loin with Dried Cherry Sauce and an elegant Fennel and Asian Pear Salad that bursts with flavor.

programme.title: Our Courtyard Cantina
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia reminisces about her Grandma's cantina (cellar) and how she spent every summer helping her grandmother prepare the food from the bounty of the harvest for the fall and winter months. Lidia's cantina has evolved into a pantry, and in this episode she will prepare pantry friendly dishes.

programme.title: Craving Fresh
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shows how to mix and balance seasonal flavors from your own garden in order to create new recipes based on what's available.

programme.title: Heartwarming Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Who doesn't love comfort food? In this episode, Lidia shares some of her most requested and delicious comfort food recipes: Pasta and Bean Soup; Decadent ham in Marsala Sauce; and her italian version of one of America's favorites: Hamburger and Homemade Ketchup.

programme.title: Cold Weather Comforts
programme.desc: When it's cold outside, Lidia's kitchen kicks into high gear. The oven is on and the stovetop is always lit. On today's menu, she'll prepare her Turkey Meatloaf with Mushroom Sauce -a real family favorite that is smothered in mushroom sauce. Vin Brulee is a mulled wine infused with warm spices; it's the perfect choice to warm up on a cold night.

programme.title: BRODETTO
programme.desc: Brodetto is a savory, soup fish preparation that can be found up and down the coast of Italy. Lidia makes her Brodetto with onion, scallion, clams and mussels and lots of parsley and pepperoncino. Lidia's Walnut Cake is delicate and nutty with just enough espresso to make it truly Italian.

programme.title: Wheat Harvest and Pasta
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia talks about the harvest of wheat and the hard work involved with making flour and eventually bread and pasta. She fondly reflects on her moments with Grandma Rosa during her trips to the mill. Lidia turns leftover bread into croutons with her Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons. She then prepares a flavor-packed Fusilli with Spinach and Herbed Ricotta, as well as Lagane Pasta with Chickpeas.

programme.title: Love Your Vegetables
programme.desc: Italians love their vegetables, and so does Lidia! This episode will feature three healthy and delicious Italian vegetable dishes including: Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon & Mushrooms; Leek and Prosciutto Grain; and Butternut Squash Soup.

programme.title: Cocktail Party
programme.desc: Italians love to celebrate life, family and friends. Lidia teaches you how to keep your guests feeling happy with a few of her favorite party tricks. The menu includes Spicy Stuffed Clams with cheesy breadcrumbs, Italian Deviled Eggs made with salsa verde and Meatless Meatballs with Cheese and Quinoa, an addictive bite-size snack. For a little extra run, she'll also show you some of her favorite fruity spritzers.

programme.title: Meatballs
programme.desc: Meatballs are an all-time favorite, and Lidia creates some new versions to add to your meatball repertoire and make those parties memorable. On the menu today, she shares: Lamb Meatballs with Lemon Sauce; Leftover Meatball Panini, Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce, a crispy fried monkfish meatball made in a tomato sauce that includes raisins and pine nuts.

programme.title: Grow In The Kitchen
programme.desc: Shaved artichoke, spinach and mortadella salad; mussels, sausage and potatoes in white wine.

programme.title: Memories of the Mountains
programme.desc: Northern Italy has some of the most stunning mountains and scenery on the Italian peninsula. In this episode, Lidia explores some of the classic culinary traditions of this area including a hearty Minestrone soup that she freshens up with pesto. In addition, she makes a delicious Stuffed Cabbage with her grandson, Lorenzo. Desserts are quick and easy and include delicious Italian "gelato."

programme.title: Building Flavor
programme.desc: Winter minestrone; roasted squash and carrot salad with chickpeas and almonds.

programme.title: The 1980s Italian American "Evolution"
programme.desc: The 1980s brought a lot of Northern Italian cuisine to New York City. This made Lidia feel at home, as a lot of the flavors central to her childhood were now with her in America. Today's recipes include a Pasta Primavera "New School," which her kids always loved growing up, and the classic Raspberry and Walnut Cookies, a beloved Italian American staple.

programme.title: Plan The Menu
programme.desc: Dishes using ricotta, including bruschetta, crespelle manicotti and chocolate chip ricotta cookies.

programme.title: A Summer Shindig
programme.desc: Summertime is dinner party season, and Lidia loves to serve family style meals. Today, she'll create a summer menu fit for any celebration. The menu includes grilled skewers of Shrimp Spiedini with Zucchini and Tomato Salsa, steamed summery Green Beans with Mint Pesto and Berry Tiramisu - Lidia's summer berry twist one of the most famous Italian desserts!

programme.title: A Perfect Roast
programme.desc: Roasting enhances the flavor of any kind of meat and Lidia often makes a roast for family meals. Today's menu includes a Salad of Warm Greens with Bacon and Mushrooms; an easy and elegant Roasted Pork Loin with Cabbage and Dried Cherry Sauce; and Roasted Pear, Blueberry and Grape Compote for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich and six special guests at her holiday table: Christopher Walken, Rita Moreno, Ann Curry, Padma Lakshmi, Marcus Samuelsson, and Carlo Ponti, Jr. Hear the personal stories of each individual's journey to and in America, set against a backdrop in which they share a delicious meal that represents the diverse flavors that are part of celebrating the yuletide in New York.

programme.title: Party Favorites
programme.desc: Italians love entertaining and celebrating life with family, friends, and food. Today, Lidia shares recipes that fit any kind of party. She starts with Stewed Savory Peppers, a delicious antipasto, especially when served with lots of grilled or toasted bread. Next, she makes Pear Bellini, a fruity and bubbly cocktail guests can sip on while enjoying antipasti; and who doesn't love fried balls of rice? Lidia shows viewers how to make Rice Balls with Sausage Ragù.

programme.title: A Light Summery Meal
programme.desc: Today, Lidia serves a beautiful Striped Bass with Tomato Pesto over a bed of fennel as the star of the meal. She then creates a tasty dish of Mint String Beans. For dessert, summer is still the theme with Peach Granita, although the granita technique can be be made with all kinds seasonal fruits.

programme.title: MORE PASTA
programme.desc: When Lidia talks about pasta in her family, it's never "basta!" Today, she creates three new pasta dishes that everyone will love including a Linguine with Swisschard that is made with walnuts and creamy ricotta. She then makes a simple dish of Farfalle with Swordfish, prepared with tomatoes, fresh herbs and capers. And finally, there is nothing better than Lidia's Spaghetti and Meatballs!

programme.title: Elegant Eats
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Brunch Brilliance
programme.desc: Although Italians are not known for a brunch tradition, many of their recipes work beautifully for it. Today's brunch recipes include: Polenta with Honey & Berries; Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta; Rice Balls Stuffed with Sausage Ragu.

programme.title: Lemony Chicken- A Family Favorite
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a dish that is perfect for family and holiday gatherings. Packed with flavor, this crispy oven baked chicken is bursting with lemon goodness. As a side, she makes a Celery Gratin and a Belgian Walnut Salad.

programme.title: Back to Basics
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich shares the stories behind the great pantry-inspired recipes that her family has been eating for years--in both good times and challenging ones.

programme.title: Herbs and Spices
programme.desc: Fresh herbs are simply a must in Lidia's kitchen and today she makes three dishes that highlight herbs AND spices. She begins the menu with Pickled Carrots: a quick pickle of tiny carrots packed with the flavors of parsley, garlic and mint; Braised Beef in Guazzetto: rich, braised beef filled with enticing aromas and Skillet Cauliflower with Lemon and Mint: cauliflower florettes showered with lemon juice and a sprinkle of fresh mint.

programme.title: The Dessert Table
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite desserts-one spoon dessert, one seasonal fruit based dessert and of course a baked sweet to warm up the kitchen. Her Limoncello Tiramisu is a sweet pick-me-up made with delicious limoncello zabaglione. Fruit is a natural as an Italian sweet to end a meal, and she loves to simply serve Grilled Fruit to magnify their natural sweetness. A favorite Italian cookie is the Chocolate Anise Biscotti, made with a shot of espresso.

programme.title: Symphony of Flavors
programme.desc: Zucchini, peas and pancetta risotto; author Katie Parla's capellini and asparagus frittata becomes an involtini alla piazzetta; risotto cakes.

programme.title: By the Sea
programme.desc: The beautiful Adriatic Sea was a big part of Lidia's childhood, as she loved to play on the rocky beach and savor the bounty of the local waters. She prepares Linguine with Clams and Broccoli, a twist on the classic linguine con vongole. She then shows three authentically southern Italian styles of topping a piece of crusty bread for her Bruschetta Three Ways- using Mackerel and Burrata, Anchovy and Butter, as well as Broccolini di Rape and Burrata.

programme.title: Cheese
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and with over 460 varieties made in Italy, it leads to many mouth-watering cheesy recipes. In this episode, Lidia shares her Cheese Baked in a Crust: gorgonzola wrapped with puff pastry and baked as crispy cheesy bites; Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad: a flavorful and fresh mix of celery, artichoke and mortadella; and finally Meatloaf Ricotta: a family favorite meatloaf dish packed with three different cheeses.

programme.title: Quick and Delicious
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares recipes that are quick to whip up and ideal for days when you don't have much time to cook. She starts off by making Green Beans with Mint Pesto, a fresh alternative to the well-known green beans with butter. For a sweet treat, Lidia makes Chunky Cherry Bread Pudding, one of her favorite ways to recycle day-old bread. Next on the menu is Maremma-Style Steak, an impressive steak that anyone can make at home.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Weddings: Something Borrowed, Something New
programme.desc: From jumping the broom to tying the knot, wedding celebrations in America are as diverse as the nation itself, and Lidia cordially invites viewers to be her "plus one" on this cross-country matrimonial odyssey.

programme.title: Pizza Party
programme.desc: Lidia makes pizza the centerpiece for your next party. With a variety of toppings, a salad and dessert, you are ready to go. ON the menu is a classic Caesar Salad with Baby Kale and Focaccia Croutons; individual Pizzette with toppings like onion and cheese; chicken and mushroom; pear and gorgonzola and tomato & pecorino. While you have the dough, why not try a Dessert Pizza, topped with jams, Nutella, chocolate and fruit.

programme.title: Enough To Share
programme.desc: Pork guazzetto with beans; matalotta-style mixed fish stew.

programme.title: Ragu
programme.desc: The key to a delicious meal is coaxing a lot of flavor from an ingredient, whether it is meat or vegetables. In this episode, Lidia shares two ragu recipes: Lamb and Pepper Ragu: and a Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu: a heart, flavorful medley of chestnuts and mushrooms that make for a satisfying vegetarian ragu.

programme.title: Trattoria Favorites
programme.desc: We all love the rustic feeling of an Italian trattoria that serves delicious comfort food. This episode features some trattoria favorites incluing: Linguine with Clams and Broccoli; Burrata with Grilled Bread and a special Almond Tart from the heel of Italy.

programme.title: Sweet & Savory Fruit
programme.desc: A cheese plate with plum mostarda and gnocco fritto; a platter of cheese with seasonal fruits and plum mostarda; fluffy fried bread served with prosciutto cotto; sausage and apples; risotto with orange juice.

programme.title: Layering Italian Flavors
programme.desc: "Alla Parmigiana" is a technique applied in many southern Italian dishes that is all about layering simple bold flavors.

programme.title: Crispy Favorites
programme.desc: Fried foods are not eaten often in Italy, but Lidia shares some recipes no one can resist. She makes Crispy Shrimp, a huge hit in her house that is sure to become a favorite in yours too; Crispy Baked Tomatoes, plum tomatoes topped with bread crumbs and baked in the oven until crispy; and finally, Polenta Torta with Gorgonzola and Savoy Cabbage, an ideal main course for a hungry crowd.

programme.title: Home Cooked Restaurant Classics
programme.desc: There are some restaurant favorites that can be cooked at home in this episode! Lidia prepares delicious Butternut Squash Gnocchi and a Pan Seared Halibut with Balsamic Reduction. Delizioso!

programme.title: A Seaside Buffet
programme.desc: Fish is a staple in Lidia's kitchen and she loves planning dinner parties based on seafood. Today's menu includes Swordfish Skewers with a Sweet and Sour Sauce, made with balsamic vinegar and bay leaves; and Stuffed Calamari with bread crumbs, hard-boiled eggs, grated cheese, white wine, and parsley.

programme.title: Dinnertime Soup Sandwhich
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the Soup and Sandwhich concept shortly after she arrived in America. And soups are one of her favorite creations to make. In this episode, she prepares a velvety Spinach and ChickpeaSoup; an Italian style Baked Toast Sandwhich and to finish, she enjoys some oatmeal crepes with her grandson Ethan.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: Salting your food is an important step in any kitchen, and the type of salt used can make a huge difference in your meal. Today's menu includes: Salted Cod Fritters: Crispy chunky cod fritters made for the perfect salty snack; Penne Rigate in Vodka Sauce: an iconic Italian pasta dish with penne rigate in a creamy pink vodka sauce; Beef Chuck and Beer; a rick and flavorful braise that will beckon everyone to the table.

programme.title: Can't Go Wrong
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Agrodolce
programme.desc: Sweet and sour is a classic combination of flavors that can be found in almost every cuisine around the world, and in Italy it's called agrodolce and produces delicious, balanced dishes of savory and sweet.

programme.desc: Viva de milagro y huyendo de Baltasar Ojeda, la Doña llega a México y se une a Amado para enfrentarlo, poniendo en riesgo a los Casillas. El Chema se propone desenmascarar al doble de Aurelio.

programme.title: Diana muere de celos
programme.desc: Amado decide salir a un operativo con la Doña y Diana, pero ella decide no ir. Altagracia manipula a Águila Azul. Anaya comete otro crimen.

programme.title: La Doña y Amado se besan
programme.desc: En medio del operativo para cazar y matar al enemigo que tienen en común, Altagracia seduce a Amado. Diana llama a su familia para advertirles que redoblen la seguridad.

programme.title: Premio por Casillas y el Cabo
programme.desc: La DEA reparte diez millones de dólares por la captura de Aurelio Casillas y el Cabo; pero Ismael triplica la cifra y garantiza la lealtad al Señor de los Cielos. Esther combatirá al narco.

programme.title: Reaparece el hijo del Chema
programme.desc: Leonardo reaparece en Playa del Carmen y confiesa que huyó de Sinaloa, donde vivía con el Chema Venegas, su padre. Amado negocia con Maldonado a cambio de información.

programme.title: Amado embosca al Cabo
programme.desc: El cabo y los Casillas se enfrentan a balazos. Ismael somete a Milton Jiménez y le apunta a la cabeza. Maldonado burla la seguridad y desafía al árabe. El Chema va a por su hijo Leonardo.

programme.title: El Rojo debe elegir
programme.desc: Tras la aparición de Leonardo, los Casillas se preparan para enfrentar al Chema y piensan en el Rojo, como uno de los suyos. Debe decidir de qué lado se queda en esta guerra.

programme.title: El Chema va por su hijo
programme.desc: Aunque sus hombres le recomiendan mantenerse bajo perfil, el Chema decide ir a buscar a Leonardo. El Rojo se queda con los Casillas.

programme.title: Nuevo escondite para Aurelio
programme.desc: La casa en Tijuana ofrece las mejores condiciones para ocultar a Aurelio, por los túneles que tiene. Amado ordena a Diana que agilice la mudanza con los Casillas. Arrestan a Casasola.

programme.title: El Chema somete a Corina
programme.desc: Para ubicar a Casillas, el Chema somete a Corina, pero ella se resiste a ayudarlo. Valdés y el árabe tienen listo el proyectil para el ataque terrorista a EE. UU.

programme.title: Diana y Amado apasionados
programme.desc: Con la familia Casillas ya instalada en Tijuana, Diana y Amado disfrutan de una noche sin precedentes: el amor crece y promete ser duradero. Aurelio, aún en coma, podría oír lo que los demás dicen.

programme.title: Aurelio reacciona del coma
programme.desc: Mientras Amado se prepara junto a todos sus hombres para detener el ataque terrorista a Estados Unidos, Aurelio se mueve inesperadamente, cuando reconoce la voz de Corina. Casasola miente.

programme.title: Amado con pistas del atentado
programme.desc: Los árabes eliminan al espía de los Casillas. Amado descifra el mensaje del asesino, que le da claves del lugar del ataque terrorista, y lo amenaza de muerte.

programme.title: El Cabo condiciona a Terán
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un golpe de estado, Terán huye de Los Pinos y contacta al Cabo. Él lo busca en su avión privado y le exige la libre entrada a sus gatilleros. Amado deduce el blanco de los árabes.

programme.title: Amado evita ataque terrorista
programme.desc: Los Casillas sorprenden a los árabes. Rescatan a Casasola y Maldonado y encierran al cabecilla. Impiden que un misil impacte en EE. UU. El Chema se adueña de las narcotienditas en México.

programme.title: La Doña y Amado son aliados
programme.desc: Viva de milagro y huyendo de Baltasar Ojeda, la Doña llega a México y se une a Amado para enfrentarlo, poniendo en riesgo a los Casillas. El Chema se propone desenmascarar al doble de Aurelio.

programme.title: Diana muere de celos
programme.desc: Amado decide salir a un operativo con la Doña y Diana, pero ella decide no ir. Altagracia manipula a Águila Azul. Anaya comete otro crimen.

programme.title: El duelo de Amado y Ojeda
programme.desc: Luego de dos emboscadas, explosiones y tiroteos, Amado enfrenta a Baltazar Ojeda. Milena besa a Rutila. Los Casillas secuestran a Anaya. El Pulque está feliz con Alba.

programme.title: El Chema, enamorado de Rutila
programme.desc: Después de muchos años, el Chema se reencuentra con Rutila y trata de seducirla. Diana espera el ataque de los colombianos y Amado decide asistirla en el operativo.

programme.title: Diana y Amado contraatacan
programme.desc: Por aire y por tierra, Amado y Diana defienden con armas y granadas el rancho Ahumada. Rutila le dice al Chema que debe consultar con la familia si quiere hacer un pacto que acabe con el Cabo.

programme.title: La Doña pacta con los Casillas
programme.desc: La Doña lavará la fortuna de los Casillas a través de sus empresas constructoras. Diana, renuente, termina aceptando que trabaje para ellos. Carla denuncia a Terán y él manda a matarla.

programme.title: Molestos con Rutila
programme.desc: Rutila debe convencer a su familia de que la alianza con el Chema es una buena idea. Además, pelea con Javi al saber que estuvo con su ex.

programme.title: El Cabo fuera vivo o muerto
programme.desc: Para declararle la guerra a su enemigo en común, el Cabo, los Casillas pactan con el Chema. Javi estará al mando. La fiscal evita que la secuestren junto a Carla. Terán emprende su huida.

programme.title: Castillo arresta a Terán
programme.desc: Castillo pone a Terán tras las rejas y le jura que pagará por todos sus crímenes, en especial, por el de Mayra, su novia. El Cabo embaraza a sus mujeres y ambas se niegan a tener los bebes.

programme.title: Amado se entrega
programme.desc: Para proteger al cartel de Casillas, Amado se entrega a la justicia con la condición de ser procesado en México. Diana promete sacarlo de prisión. El Cabo huye.

programme.title: Nace una leyenda
programme.desc: Mientras Doña Alba lucha por revivir a Aurelio, los Casillas se apoderan de la ciudad para intentar liberar a Amado. Se alían con enemigos para enfrentar a los gobiernos de México y EE. UU.

programme.title: Amor y guerra
programme.desc: El Gobierno tiene rodeados a los Casillas, pero ellos no son presa fácil y les muestran a quienes pretenden eliminarlos que son indestructibles. Pío trama su venganza contra Súper Javi.

programme.title: La liberación
programme.desc: El rescate de Amado falla y el Gobierno americano lo traslada a EE. UU. Los Casillas vuelven al ataque con un plan de fuga, pero el operativo es de alto riesgo. Javi recibe noticias inesperadas.

programme.title: La sombra del pasado
programme.desc: Pío José Valdivia, el enemigo más peligroso de los Casillas, comienza a ejecutar su venganza para eliminarlos uno por uno. El primero en su lista es Súper Javi; él se prepara.

programme.title: Negocios en Grecia
programme.desc: Amado y Diana llegan a Grecia en busca de nuevos aliados para fortalecer el Cartel de los Casillas. Pero la mafia de Los Balcanes tiene otras intenciones. Pío y Jaime buscan la presidencia.

programme.title: Grand Theft Lizard
programme.desc: Ex-business partners fight over their snake-breeding venture; retaliatory theft of a lizard is caught on tape.

programme.title: Sword-Wielding Tenant
programme.desc: A man sues his former landlord for a false arrest after a heated argument.

programme.title: Modern Love Mayhem; Frenchie Fiasco
programme.desc: A young woman sues her ex-lover for damages over an alleged assault; a man's foray into the dog-breeding business ends in a lawsuit over a French Bulldog puppy he sold to his tenant.

programme.title: Photoshop Fiasco or Social Media Misfortune?
programme.desc: A woman sues a photographer for using photos from a bartered session to promote his business on social media.

programme.title: Truck Fight
programme.desc: A mechanic is accused of threatening a customer after a fight over truck repairs escalates.

programme.title: Checks and Balances; Roommate Fallout
programme.desc: After discovering eight thousand in forged checks, a woman sends a series of angry texts which leads a man to file for a restraining order; a woman is evicted days after moving in; she sues for return of rent and emotional distress.

programme.title: Wedding Planner Problem
programme.desc: Newlyweds sue their wedding planner for the 10k court max alleging their wedding party was ejected from a wedding venue; the planner says they still owe her money.

programme.title: Sister vs. Brother
programme.desc: A struggling mother of three claims her brother and his girlfriend disposed of her possessions without her permission.

programme.title: Washed Up Friendship; Time to Pay the Toll
programme.desc: A woman asks a friend to buy and install a washer/dryer in her home but refuses to pay him despite her continued use of the appliances; a woman purchases a used car from a friend, she leaves hundreds of toll charges in her wake.

programme.title: Phone a Friend
programme.desc: A farmworker must defend against his ex-boss's claims that he owes for a phone, rent and a personal loan.

programme.title: Brawl for Dogs
programme.desc: Ex-roommates fight over a violent assault involving a lockout and an emotional support dog; one man claims he blacked out after a chokehold, another says it was self-defense.

programme.title: Family Woes
programme.desc: After providing a home for her grandchildren while her son was in prison, a woman's relationship with her family falls apart after he and his fiancé move in.

programme.title: High Security Break-Up
programme.desc: A woman is granted a lifetime restraining order against an ex-boyfriend who sues her for thousands in personal belongings he says she never returned.

programme.title: Funeral Feud
programme.desc: Brothers clash over funeral expenses for their mother; accusations of defamation ensue.

programme.title: Don't Bully Me
programme.desc: An American bully breeder sues a man for the remaining balance on a puppy purchased for his seven-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Minor Crash; Trade Me Back
programme.desc: An unlicensed, uninsured teenage driver fails to yield and crashes into a vehicle carrying a mother and her toddler; two men sue each other for the court maximum after their car-trade agreement falls apart.

programme.title: Don't Go Fund Me
programme.desc: After an apartment fire made her homeless, a woman sues a former friend who offered her a place to stay, for a wrongful eviction and unwanted sexual advances while staying with him; he countersues for damages due to false accusations.

programme.title: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: After a fight with his pregnant girlfriend, a man invites a female acquaintance to move in; they clash over a personal loan, car damages and assault.

programme.title: Rag Doll Dog; Hairy Situation
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases; two Pit Bulls jump over a fence and maul a neighbor's small dog; the Judge speaks to the responsibility that comes with owning dangerous dog breeds; in the next case, a woman sues a hairstylist.

programme.title: Guns Between Friends
programme.desc: A firearms instructor seeks compensation for a valuable rifle he loaned to an ailing client; the defendant says he sold the weapon after the client passed away to satisfy a debt owed by the deceased.

programme.title: T-Shirt Throw Down
programme.desc: A fundraising effort via t-shirt sales goes awry when a woman is dissatisfied with sample shirts and asks for a refund from a small business owner; a heated incident and a defamation countersuit follow soon after.

programme.title: Holiday Dog Attack
programme.desc: A dog attack on Christmas day divides neighbors who fight over which of their dogs was the aggressor and who is responsible for vet bills.

programme.title: Cross Country Rescue and Wedding Debt Denied
programme.desc: A man drives 2,000 miles to come to the aid of his son and his son's teen fiancé, then is sued by the couple; a newlywed is sued by her sister-in-law for a trip and for wedding expenses.

programme.title: To Lease or Not to Lease
programme.desc: While away on vacation in Hawaii, a woman claims her roommate turned in a lease renewal without her permission; the roommate has another story.

programme.title: Family Divided
programme.desc: Both parties sue for the 10k court max when parents fight with their child over ownership of an 18-wheeler; the Judge throws out the countersuit after a heated exchange.

programme.title: Romantic Reunion Fail; Wolfdog
programme.desc: A couple reunites after 30 years only to be torn apart over personal loans after an ex-girlfriend comes back into the picture; both parties sue for the 10 thousand court maximum when the cost of a wolfdog and alleged loss of income fall into dispute.

programme.title: The Unseen Roommate
programme.desc: Relative strangers regret signing a lease together when one loses their job and the other decides not to move in.

programme.title: Wig Out in ATL
programme.desc: The owner of a wig business claims that a stylist has been making purchases in someone else's name.

programme.title: Sisters No More and The Fix Is In
programme.desc: Two sisters duel over a $10K lawsuit; a woman sues a close friend for damages to her car he allegedly caused by attempting to temporarily repair the vehicle for her.

programme.title: Tough Love Dad
programme.desc: After her father evicts her, a teenager sues him for the return of property she claims to be worth thousands; he accuses her of smoking pot and breaking promises to help out around the house.

programme.title: Roommate Hell
programme.desc: A man is evicted from his own apartment after a roommate files a restraining order against him; they fight over Covid relief, unpaid rent and alleged fraud.

programme.title: Side Hustle Fail and Truck-Astrophe
programme.desc: A man says he is hired by a former high school teammate to make auto-parts deliveries; their working relationship ends with a claim of unpaid wages; a mother of three claims she gave her children's uncle $2700 to buy a truck that never arrived.

programme.title: That's a Wrap! and Ex-Con; Author Seeks the Sentimental
programme.desc: A woman helps pay for her boyfriend's car; a man sues relatives for the return of treasured keepsakes from their family home.

programme.title: Water Damage Control
programme.desc: A woman claims a bathroom leak caused extensive water damage after a plumber made a house call; the owner of the plumbing company denies any wrongdoing.

programme.title: Chihuahua Fright

programme.title: Changes and Challenges
programme.desc: Change is in the air at the salon; Beth is dealing with the recent death of her younger sister and wants to find a dress that captures her sibling's spirit; Stacey looks for a gothic gown; Lynn comes in for her first fitting.

programme.title: In My Opinion
programme.desc: Everyone thinks they know what's best at the salon, especially brides; Erin and her crew meet celebrity designer Austin Scarlett; Susan seeks an elaborate ball gown; Cally wants her dress painted on her.

programme.title: Once Upon a Dress
programme.desc: The fairy-tale quest for the perfect gown doesn't always have a happy ending; Kate seeks one that fits her taste and budget; Adrianna searches for a perfect dress.

programme.title: Bridal Wave
programme.desc: Jessica brings scorecards to ensure an honest opinion of her gowns; eight friends and family members accompany Holly to the salon; Lydia has her first fitting; it's Blowout Sale time, but there are concerns about the event being a bust.

programme.title: Playing Dress Up
programme.desc: Nicole's sorority sisters surprise her with a weekend trip, but there's something fishy about an appointment; Grace brings her fiancé, Tate, who gets completely involved in the appointment; Lauren tries to please her aunt.

programme.title: The Dress Ties that Bind
programme.desc: Finding the right dress sometimes tests relationships; a relationship strained by religious differences; Lisa and her mom wage a budget battle; Keasha helps a friend; Rachel's final fitting.

programme.title: Seeing Red
programme.desc: New consultant Carmel has a tall order from her first bride of the day; an Indian bride wants an elaborate red dress for $2,000; Camille tries to help a reluctant shopper.

programme.title: Hot Dresses, Cold Feet
programme.desc: Sacha refuses to settle for a dress within her budget; Elizabeth brings a large and opinionated group; Madora finds a dress but struggles with the cost; Dorianne's dad gets emotional during her fitting.

programme.title: There's A First For Everything
programme.desc: Jessica wants a fairy-themed wedding complete with fairy wings on her dress; Marisa looks for the perfect ball gown wedding dress; Vicki and her twin sister return for a fitting.

programme.title: The Art of Negotiation
programme.desc: Brides on a budget in an unstable economy expect more bang for their buck; Melanie's dream dress has increased in price over time; Fofie finds her dress, but her father won't pay the $24,000 asking price; Jennifer adds new bling.

programme.title: Getting in the Spirit
programme.desc: Consultant Sarah gets engaged and must find a dress, but she can't maintain focus while she's at work.

programme.title: Second Time Around
programme.desc: Caitlin plans a military wedding after eloping; Lee and her husband search for a dress for the renewal of their vows; after Stefany loses weight, her dress doesn't fit; Jennifer looks to Vera to fix a collapsed bust.

programme.title: Clicking with Brides
programme.desc: Ex-model Leah is assigned to consult Dianne, who is challenged by her opinionated maid of honor; Audrey deals with differences of opinion between a 50-year-old bride and her daughter; Jennifer tries on a dress with "elegant cleavage."

programme.title: Two For One
programme.desc: Debbie and Carmel team up to sell dresses to sister brides; consultant Dianne is confronted by two brides during one appointment; Rozlynn has her fitting.

programme.title: Missing Mom
programme.desc: Alla, who lost her mother to breast cancer, battles an opinionated aunt; Ellen falls for a dress that may be beyond her budget; Liz and her mother find their tastes differ; Timoria's fitting gets emotional.

programme.title: Family Dynamics
programme.desc: Varying family dynamics; Julie and her mother don't hold back brutal opinions; Annie brings her adopted mom to the store; same-sex couple Joy and Beth have high expectations for their visit to the shop.

programme.title: Indecisive Brides
programme.desc: Indecisive brides; Jennifer claims she is "dress blind"; Christy's mom wants a ball gown for her; Susan bought a ballroom-style dress too hastily and wants something better suited to her edgy taste.

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: Carmel desperately needs a sale to hit her monthly goal; a consultant works with a bride who recently donated a kidney to her fiancé; a bride has an unlimited budget; Patricia has problems at her fitting.

programme.title: Overbooked
programme.desc: Bre, a former beauty queen, wants to be a traditional bride; Jennifer visits the shop with an undermining entourage.

programme.title: Practically Family
programme.desc: Tiffany's mother has trouble accepting her choice of a nontraditional hot pink dress; a woman and her mother have different tastes; a second-time bride has her fitting.

programme.title: Going the Extra Mile
programme.desc: Consultants go the extra mile to make sales in tough economic times; Audrey reconstructs a dress to make a sale; Debbie finds a dress for a bride who is getting married in five weeks; Vera reconstructs a neckline to save a fitting.

programme.title: Veterans vs. Rookies
programme.desc: Rookie consultant Jessica joins the team; a customer needs to walk out of the store with a dress on that day; a wedding planner who is getting married wants a dress to top all others.

programme.title: Ready or Not
programme.desc: Picky Bernadette finds something in every dress Sarah pulls; a nurse suddenly can't make a decision while in the shop.

programme.title: The Blowout Sale
programme.desc: Jessica dresses three brides simultaneously; Maria brings three generations of her family to an appointment.

programme.title: Voice of Reason
programme.desc: One bride has lost 120 pounds; a bride doesn't know what style she wants; a bride is accompanied by her fiancé, who is a style guru; a bride has dress problems on her wedding day.

programme.title: She's a Vision
programme.desc: Five outspoken bridesmaids accompany a bride; a rugby player visits the salon with her fiancé, mother and aunt; an unhappy bride undergoes alterations.

programme.title: Plan B
programme.desc: Sarah decides she hates the dress she bought more than a year ago; Meghan panics at her fitting because she does not recognize her dress; Jessica is challenged by Kelly, who is not familiar with dress shopping.

programme.title: Moms and Daughters
programme.desc: Tameka wants a simple dress, but her mother wants something sleek and glamorous; Karen admits picking a dress is hard without her mom; Gabrielle leaves the store vowing to lose weight before her final fitting.

programme.title: Two To Say I Do
programme.desc: After being pressured into purchasing a dress by her mother and stepmother, Jennifer is on a mission to find a new gown; Lisa uses her fiancé, John, as a guide to style; the dress Kate bought before getting engaged needs alterations.

programme.title: The Price of Beauty
programme.desc: A second-time bride brings her younger fiancé to the salon; Dianne and Randy team up to help a bride find a lacy sheath; a bride gets her first glimpse at her ball gown.

programme.title: Family Support
programme.desc: Susan's family flies to New York City for a dress intervention; Tiffany brings her large extended family; Susan is accompanied to her fitting by her mother, grandmother and prospective mother-in-law, who she's meeting for just the third time.

programme.title: Princess Brides
programme.desc: Jennifer believes her dress budget is $10,000, while her mother thinks she should spend less since her grandmother is paying; a toy designer wants to look like a princess; a woman's fitting goes into crisis mode over a curved band of fabric.

programme.title: Daddy's Little Girl
programme.desc: Fathers accompany their daughters to help find wedding gowns and offer fatherly advice; wedding fund.

programme.title: Cinderella Comes in All Sizes
programme.desc: A bride plans to lose 20 pounds before her wedding, so she's searching for a flattering dress; a consultant works with a plus-size bride.

programme.title: Seeing Eye to Eye
programme.desc: A bride tells Dianne and Randy her budget is $7,000, while her mother reveals it's actually $4,000; a pageant queen's mother wants her to wear a Cinderella dress; a bride's dress comes up seven inches too short during her fitting.

programme.title: Anything Goes -- in Bridal
programme.desc: A pageant queen is determined to have all eyes on her wedding day; a wannabe bride gets a jump on wedding dress shopping; a self-proclaimed goth girl returns to the salon.

programme.title: The Cardinal Rules
programme.desc: A bride already has the perfect dress, but can't stop shopping; a client doesn't disclose she's found a dress at another store; a bride tries on a Pnina Tornai dress that's beyond her budget.

programme.title: Wallet Woes
programme.desc: Donna can't find anything in her budget, so her father doubles the number; Daisy searches for a Spanish style gown; Heidi tries on her ball gown.

programme.title: Going Bridal
programme.desc: Danielle's aunt brings the family's "wooden spoon" to keep order; brides Erika and Devin want matching dresses; after eight months the fitter struggles to close Amy's dress.

programme.title: Family Ties

Characters include a district attorney (Brendan Fraser) and his casually prejudiced wife (Sandra Bullock), dating police detectives Graham (Don Cheadle) and Ria (Jennifer Esposito), a victimized Middle Eastern store owner and a wealthy African-American couple (Terrence Dashon Howard, Thandie Newton) humiliated by a racist traffic cop (Matt Dillon).

When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. There he hangs with rising superstar Prolifik during the day and works on his own music after hours. However, when Prolifik is kidnapped and his unreleased album is stolen, the record label's sleazy owner, Bobby Starr, assumes Erik and his friend Malik are responsible. programme.title: Ladrones de niños
programme.desc: Infames ladrones se van al extremo de separar niños de sus madres, con la intención de venderlos por una suma de dinero.

programme.title: Un trío de tres
programme.desc: Una secretaria forma una agencia de detectives privados, sus empleados creen que es una broma, pero actúan eficazmente.

programme.title: Guantes de Oro
programme.desc: Un vago es entrenado por varios ex campeones de boxeo y en su primera pelea noquea al contrincante con un solo golpe.

programme.title: Regalo de Reyes
programme.desc: Un hombre humilde patenta un experimento para crear hierro, el gobierno lo apoya y transforma su vida al lado de sus hijos.

programme.title: Rocambole
programme.desc: Un hombre escapa de la cárcel con su amigo, pues él sabe el paradero de la fortuna de la familia a la que sirvió.

programme.title: La vida inútil de Pito Pérez
programme.desc: Después de muchos años, un hombre regresa a su pueblo y planifica una gran recepción para hacer creer que le fue bien en todo.

programme.title: Blue Demon contra el poder satánico
programme.desc: Un hombre que fue sepultado vivo quiere vengarse del mundo y el Blue Demon tiene que salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: La batalla del domingo
programme.desc: La historia del futbolista argentino Alfredo di Stéfano en dos versiones.

programme.title: Sábado Negro
programme.desc: Un hombre casado busca pasar una divertida noche de soltero y por su infidelidad se enfrenta a la peor pesadilla de su vida.

programme.title: Usted tiene ojos de mujer fatal
programme.desc: Un mujeriego finalmente se enamora de una dama que lo hace sufrir y que luego de un tiempo lo acepta.

programme.title: Bala de Plata en el pueblo maldito
programme.desc: Un joven es herido y pierde su caballo, cuando sana reclama una mina hallada por su padre y recupera a su animal.

programme.title: Domingo salvaje
programme.desc: Un jubilado a quien sus padres no quieren queda accidentalmente desnudo fuera de su casa y un niño por correr a verlo se accidenta. Esto hace que el jubilado y la madre del niño se acerquen.

programme.title: Tres citas con el destino
programme.desc: El misterio de un hermoso anillo, joya maldita que causó tragedia y muerte a quienes lo tuvieron en sus manos.

programme.title: Los tales por cuales
programme.desc: Un ranchero llega a un pueblo donde se atribuyen varios delitos al cacique y lo salva de varios atentados.

programme.title: A ritmo de twist
programme.desc: Matusalén es encargado de la tienda de trajes de baño de su tío, junto a su amigo Beto. La competencia les envía a dos hermosas mujeres a espiarlos y robar las ideas y diseños del tío.

programme.title: Duelo en la cañada
programme.desc: Un hacendado defiende a la cantante que ama del tirano que intenta chantajearla con un crimen que ella no cometió.

programme.title: El luchador fenómeno
programme.desc: Resortes se enamora de una bella joven, sin imaginar que un gánster lo meterá en problemas y acabará involucrado en un torneo de lucha libre donde enfrentará a fuertes y ágiles luchadores profesionales.

programme.title: Carnaval en Brasil
programme.desc: Un productor hace un musical, basado en la literatura griega, para las fiestas de Río de Janeiro con el manuscrito de un profesor.

programme.title: Mi Alma por un Amor
programme.desc: Un viejo se enamora de una joven y vende su alma al diablo para ser joven, apuesto y rico para conquistarla en 6 meses.

programme.title: El gavilán
programme.desc: Un corrupto licenciado roba en una mina y despide al administrador sin motivos para poner a uno de sus ayudantes.

programme.title: Qué perra vida
programme.desc: Los músicos Viruta y Capulina tienen un amigo, un perro llamado Rayo, el que ha heredado una gran fortuna de su dueño.

programme.title: Mi Borinquen querida
programme.desc: Tras un accidente, una joven hereda una gran fortuna, por lo que un hombre se aprovecha del amor que despertó en ella.

programme.title: Tú y la mentira
programme.desc: La esposa de un cantante se vuelve vedette e intenta engañarlo con un cantante venezolano, que resulta ser su amigo.

programme.title: Tres melodías de amor
programme.desc: Una enamorada pareja realiza el tan añorado sueño que dos familias han tenido de unir oficialmente sus apellidos.

programme.title: El fantasma de la casa roja
programme.desc: Un hombre esconde cinco millones y los deja de herencia al familiar que descubra el lugar de la casa donde los escondió.

programme.title: Secretaria peligrosa
programme.desc: Una secretaria y un gánster planean asaltar al jefe de ella, pero un agente especial logra capturarlos luego del suceso.

programme.title: ¡Que seas feliz!
programme.desc: Una cantante se enamora de un jugador y se casa con él rechazando a su maestro de canto.

programme.title: El hombre de la isla
programme.desc: Una mujer va a una isla remota para casarse con un hombre que al principio la maltrata, pero al fin se enamora de ella.

programme.title: Rancho de mis recuerdos
programme.desc: Un caporal se luce en una fiesta brava junto a un torero andaluz y la hija del hacendado les hace competencia.

programme.title: Azahares para tu boda
programme.desc: La hija de una familia conservadora va a casarse, pero el novio socialista no acepta hacerlo por la iglesia.

programme.title: Muertos de miedo
programme.desc: Una joven contrata a dos detectives privados para encontrar a un famoso ladrón de joyas, conocido como Rostov.

programme.title: El pequeño ruiseñor
programme.desc: Un pequeño monaguillo tiene una voz prodigiosa así que en complicidad con el sacristán canta en bodas y bautizos.

programme.title: Vivir del cuento
programme.desc: Un empleado usa el nombre de su patrón para cometer fraude y es despedido, pero a su vez el patrón engaña a su ex-suegro.
